If you have any concerns or questions about communications you have received, please send them to  hrgroup@netdocuments.com  so our team members can review.

About NetDocuments 

At NetDocuments, we're shaping the future of legal work. We believe legal professionals should spend less time searching for information and managing documents, and more time solving complex problems, serving clients, and delivering meaningful outcomes. That's why we're building technology that helps organizations work smarter, collaborate more effectively, and unlock the full value of their institutional knowledge.

Our team is redefining what's possible for legal technology. NetDocuments is the trusted intelligent document management platform for legal professionals and the company behind the industry's first and only legal context graph—a breakthrough that gives legal professionals and AI a richer understanding of how matters, documents, people, and knowledge connect across an organization while respecting enterprise-grade security, governance, permissions, and ethical walls.

Innovation is only part of our story. We believe our greatest strength is our people. We foster a collaborative, inclusive, and high-performing culture where curiosity is encouraged, diverse perspectives are valued, and employees are empowered to make a meaningful impact. Whether you're building products, serving customers, or supporting the business, your work helps shape the future of one of the world's most trusted legal technology platforms.

That commitment to our employees and customers has earned us recognition as one of the nation's top workplaces, including:

- Four consecutive appearances on the Inc. 5000 list of America's Fastest-Growing Private Companies

- Five-time Top Workplace USA winner

- Five-time Salt Lake Tribune Top Workplace 

- Multiple Top Workplaces Culture Excellence awards recognizing innovation, employee appreciation, work-life flexibility, and compensation & benefits

If you're excited to solve meaningful challenges, work alongside talented colleagues, and help define the next generation of legal technology, we'd love to meet you.

What You’ll Do 

NetDocuments is seeking a Principal Software Engineer – Intelligent DMS to provide technical leadership across the next generation of our document management platform. This role will help shape the architecture connecting our new web and mobile experiences, design system, extended applications, Microsoft 365 integrations, desktop applications, and AI-powered capabilities into a cohesive platform. You’ll operate as a deeply hands-on technical leader, spending the majority of your time solving complex engineering problems while driving architectural decisions that span multiple teams and products. You’ll partner closely with Product, Design, platform engineering, and our AI teams to establish scalable patterns, simplify complex systems, and ensure the experiences we build meet the reliability, security, performance, and usability standards expected by the world’s leading legal organizations.

You will:

Technical Leadership & Architecture

- Provide technical leadership across the Intelligent DMS organization, establishing architectural direction and engineering standards that span multiple teams and product surfaces.

- Lead architectural decisions across web, mobile, backend services, Microsoft 365 integrations, desktop applications, and AI-powered experiences.

- Define shared technical patterns, component contracts, data models, permission models, and integration approaches that create a cohesive platform.

- Lead complex, cross-team engineering initiatives from early product ideation through architecture, implementation, and production.

- Evaluate architectural trade-offs across scalability, security, performance, usability, maintainability, and speed of delivery.

- Simplify complex systems and establish technical foundations that enable teams to move faster as the platform evolves.

Design & Build

- Contribute directly to the most complex and consequential areas of the Intelligent DMS platform.

- Design and build cloud-native applications, microservices, integrations, and customer-facing experiences at enterprise scale.

- Help architect the next-generation web and mobile applications and the backend services that support them.

- Establish patterns for integrating AI capabilities such as assistants, summarization, extraction, and intelligent search into everyday document workflows.

- Lead technical design for Microsoft 365 experiences, including co-authoring and integrations across Word, Excel, PowerPoint, and Outlook.

- Design solutions that maintain correctness, security, and matter-levl permissions across highly concurrent and distributed workflows.

Platform Evolution & Modernization

- Define technical strategies for evolving mature applications and integrations onto the next-generation platform without disrupting critical customer workflows.

- Establish migration patterns that allow legacy and next-generation experiences to operate effectively during platform transitions.

- Drive technical coherence across extended applications, desktop clients, sync, import, browser extensions, mobile applications, and Microsoft 365 integrations.

- Partner with platform and AI engineering teams to establish scalable integration patterns for shared services and capabilities.

- Set performance and reliability standards for customer-facing applications and drive systemic improvements required to meet them.

Cross-Team Technical Leadership

- Lead technical initiatives involving multiple engineering teams without relying on formal reporting authority.

- Build alignment across Engineering, Product, Design, Platform, and AI teams around architectural direction and implementation strategy.

- Translate ambiguous product opportunities into clear technical requirements, architecture, and executable plans.

- Document architectural decisions and ensure teams understand the reasoning, trade-offs, and standards behind them.

- Serve as a technical escalation point when teams encounter complex architectural or engineering challenges.

Engineering Excellence & Mentorship

- Mentor engineers across experience levels, including Senior and Staff Engineers, and provide guidance on architecture, system design, and engineering practices.

- Drive testing, quality, security, and reliability strategies across the Intelligent DMS organization.

- Establish and maintain architecture documentation, engineering standards, and technical patterns that scale beyond individual projects.

- Lead design and code reviews for complex or high-impact initiatives.

- Partner with other Principal Engineers and our Chief Architect to advance technical excellence across the broader engineering organization.

- Support recruiting and interviewing efforts to help build a high-performing engineering team.

Continuous Learning & Innovation

- Stay current with advancements in AI-native product development, distributed systems, cloud architecture, and modern software engineering.

- Evaluate emerging technologies and determine where they can meaningfully improve customer experience or engineering effectiveness.

- Validate new technical approaches with real users and production feedback before scaling them broadly.

- Champion engineering practices that prioritize simplicity, measurable customer value, and sustainable technical foundations.

What You’ll Need to Be Successful 

- Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or a related technical field, or equivalent practical experience.

- 10+ years of professional software engineering experience, with demonstrated experience operating at the Staff level or above.

- Proven experience setting architecture and technical direction across multiple products, systems, or engineering teams.

- Experience leading complex, cross-team technical initiatives without formal authority and driving alignment across engineering stakeholders.

- Deep expertise in system design, distributed systems, cloud applications, microservices, and enterprise-scale integrations.

- Strong full stack engineering experience with the ability to work across frontend and backend systems; our technology stack includes C#, .NET, React, and TypeScript.

- Experience designing and operating cloud-native systems using AWS, Azure, or comparable cloud technologies.

- Experience translating ambiguous product requirements into clear technical architecture and implementation plans.

- Demonstrated experience mentoring senior engineers and providing technical guidance across teams.

- Strong technical writing skills with experience creating architecture documents, design proposals, and technical decision records.

What Will Make You Stand Out 

- Experience shipping AI-native product experiences where AI is fundamental to the product workflow.

- Experience operating multi-tenant enterprise platforms with strict security, compliance, or data residency requirements.

- Experience with Microsoft 365 extensibility, including Office add-ins, Microsoft Graph, or co-authoring technologies.

- Experience modernizing legacy applications while maintaining heavily used production systems and managing complex customer migrations.

- Experience in legal technology, professional-services SaaS, or other regulated enterprise software environments.

- Public examples of technical leadership through conference speaking, technical writing, open-source contributions, or architectural patterns adopted by other teams.

What You’ll Love About NetDocuments

Compensation Transparency

The posted cash compensation includes on-target earnings. Some roles may qualify for overtime pay. Individual compensation packages are determined based on factors such as experience, skills, qualifications, and geographic location.

title: Software Engineer - PlanetScale Postgres
description:

PlanetScale is growing rapidly and reinventing the database space. The PlanetScale platform delivers a fully managed, multi-cloud Postgres service designed for the most demanding production workloads. We handle the complexity of provisioning, scaling, replication, and failover - so engineering teams can focus on building their products.

Our customers entrust us with their most precious digital asset, their data, so the stakes couldn't be higher. We're looking for a Software Engineer to join our Postgres engineering team and help us build a world-class managed Postgres offering.

What's the job to be done?

- You will design and build the control plane that provisions, scales, and heals Postgres clusters with minimal customer-visible downtime.

- You will build and maintain high availability, disaster recovery, and data protection solutions that keep customer databases safe through infrastructure failures.

- You will tune Postgres to operate at scale for some of the largest and most demanding workloads in the world.

- You will build tooling and automation for database operations, backup, restore, and migration workflows - and participate in an on-call rotation.

- You will work directly with customers to understand their workloads and translate real-world needs into platform improvements.

These attributes best describe you…

- You have strong experience building, operating, or maintaining large-scale Postgres deployments in production.

- You have an excellent understanding of low-level operating systems concepts including multi-threading, memory management, networking, storage, and performance.

- You have strong fundamental computer science skills and can reason about distributed, fault-tolerant systems.

- You thrive in a collaborative environment, enjoy mentoring other engineers, and communicate complex technical tradeoffs clearly.

- You are self-motivated and can work independently with minimal guidance while making sound technical decisions.

What you will need

- 5+ years of software engineering experience designing, building, and supporting large-scale systems in production.

- Strong proficiency in Go, with experience in other languages like Ruby, Python, Zig or Rust.

- Experience building and maintaining distributed, fault-tolerant services.

- Working knowledge of Kubernetes and containerized applications.

- Experience building and operating distributed systems at scale.

What else will help you be successful

- Experience building or operating a database-as-a-service or managed database platform.

- Experience with connection pooling and proxy layers for Postgres.

- Experience with cloud platforms (AWS, GCP, Azure) and infrastructure-as-code.

- Contributions to open-source projects, especially in the Postgres or database infrastructure space.

- Experience working with remote, geographically distributed teams.

- Previous experience at a high-growth technology company.

Why PlanetScale

We're redefining how high-growth companies manage data at scale—and we work with some of the most exciting brands in gaming, consumer tech, and B2B SaaS. title: Senior Backend Engineer – Energy Optimization & Platform
description:
At Priva Energy, we build software systems that help customers manage and optimize energy in real-world environments, from greenhouses to buildings. You'll join one of our Energy Solutions teams (spanning Building Automation, Horticulture, and Energy Flexibility Trading), landing wherever the need is greatest at the time, and you'll also carry some responsibility for the cloud infrastructure and scalability that benefits teams beyond your own. 

You'll work at the intersection of three things: shipping features end-to-end in Priva Digital Services (touching both backend and, where needed, the front end), integrating optimization and forecasting logic into production services , and strengthening the cloud/DevOps foundation the whole department builds on. You don't need to be equally deep in all three, but you do need to be comfortable moving between them, and you should genuinely enjoy the connective, systems-level work of making things run reliably in production. 

Come Shape the Future of Sustainable Energy with Priva 

Priva Energy is working to become the leading global lifecycle partner for high-performing, sustainable buildings, horticultural operations, and energy distribution and management companies. Energy systems are transforming fast: grid congestion, dynamic pricing, decentralized production, and tightening sustainability regulation are reshaping what our customers need from us. Our Digital Twin and optimization technologies exist to meet that shift at scale, delivering measurable results such as lower energy intensity, greater flexibility and reliability, reduced operating costs, and structurally lower emissions. 

As a Senior Backend Engineer, you'll help turn that ambition into production reality: building the services, integrations, and cloud foundation that put our optimization and forecasting capabilities to work for customers every day. 

Your work will directly contribute to: 

- Reducing and optimizing energy costs and emissions across Europe 

- Enabling customers to participate in future energy flexibility and trading markets 

- Optimizing multi-energy systems (heat, cold, electricity, storage, HVAC) 

- Driving the transition toward autonomous, intelligent buildings and greenhouses 

- Helping customers stay compliant with increasing regulatory pressure (e.g., CSRD) 

What You’ll Do 

Priva Digital Services & product engineering 

- Design and build backend services that process data and execute optimization logic for products across Neo Heat, Neo Light, Neo Building, and Neo Smart 

- Contribute to user-facing Priva Digital Services features end-to-end, including front-end work where it's the fastest path to shipping value 

- Build and maintain APIs for internal and external integration 

Optimization & forecasting integration 

- Implement and integrate optimization and forecasting logic into scalable, production-ready systems. You bring these models into production; you don't develop new optimization theory 

- Work on data processing pipelines, scheduling logic, and system orchestration 

Cloud infrastructure & DevOps 

- Own and improve cloud infrastructure (Azure) that supports scalability across Energy Solutions teams 

- Strengthen CI/CD, monitoring, and deployment practices so systems are reliable, performant, and maintainable in real-world operation 

- Collaborate with product, domain experts, and other engineers across teams to deliver end-to-end solutions 

- Contribute to technical design decisions within your domain, and participate in the full software lifecycle: ideation → design → development → testing → deployment → monitoring 

What you will NOT do 

- This is not a research or modelling role. You implement and integrate optimization and forecasting models rather than developing new theory 

- You are not expected to be a dedicated front-end specialist or a dedicated DevOps specialist. The role spans these areas by design, so depth in every direction isn't the bar 

- A bachelor's degree in an IT-related field 

- Around 5 years of experience in a software engineering role, with demonstrated range across at least two of the following: backend/production systems, cloud infrastructure, front-end, or optimization integration. Versatility across these areas matters more here than deep tenure in a single one 

- You've taken systems into production and kept them running, and can show or talk us through examples (work projects, open source, side projects) 

- Experience with one or more of the following is a significant advantage: Python, Azure, Docker, Kubernetes/CI-CD tooling, SQL, KQL, Linux, and front-end frameworks (e.g., React/TypeScript) 

- You are based in the Netherlands and are available to be in the office two to three days per week 

- Strong problem-solving skills and a willingness to work with complex, unfamiliar systems 

- A passion for creating customer value through high-quality engineering 

- Curiosity, ownership, craftsmanship, and the drive to keep learning 

- Good communication skills, able to explain trade-offs clearly to both engineers and non-technical stakeholders 

- A good vibe: you bring energy to the team and make collaboration genuinely enjoyable, not just effective 

What We Offer You 

💶 Excellent remuneration, competitive and aligned with experience 

🌴 30 days holiday per year, with the option to buy 5 extra at half price  

🏦 Excellent pension contribution  

🎓 €1,000 education budget per year  

⏰ Flexible working hours, and location.  

🍱 On-site canteen (e.g., poke bowl for €2)  

🏋️ Free onsite gym- with personal trainer.  

🎉 A vibrant, open culture where you can be yourself  

🌿 Human- and values-driven work, not corporate bureaucracy

title: Senior Backend Engineer - Introducer Tech
description:
Senior Backend Engineer - Introducer Tech - DE

Hybrid in London / Remote within the UK

We’re looking for a Senior Backend Engineer 

You'll own the Lending API in Germany, which banks, fintechs, brokers, and comparison sites build on to offer iwoca's finance to their customers. You'll decide how it evolves and help build the features that make partners choose iwoca.

The company 

Small businesses move fast. Opportunities often don’t wait, and cash flow pressures can appear overnight. To keep going, and growing, SMEs need finance that’s as flexible and responsive as they are.

That's why we built iwoca. Our smart technology, data science and five-star customer service ensures business owners can act with the speed, confidence and control they need, exactly when it's needed.

We’ve already cleared the way for 100,000 businesses with more than £5 billion in funding. Our passionate team is driven to help even more SMEs succeed, through access to better finance and other services that make running a business easier. Our ultimate mission is to support one million SMEs in their defining moments, creating lasting impact for the communities and economies they drive.

The team 

Introducer Tech builds the systems that partners in Germany use to refer businesses to iwoca. The aim is to get new partners integrated quickly and to make applying simple for their customers. The team also looks after how partners earn commission.

Its work covers three main areas:

- The Lending API. Developing the versioned API and the webhooks that keep partners up to date on their customers.

- The Introducer Portal. Building the web app that German brokers log in to, to submit applications and upload documents.

- The sign-up journey. Improving how businesses apply and how well they convert, after a partner referral.

The team is growing to have two product managers, who each focus on either the broker or the partner flow, and three engineers across the backend and frontend, including this hire.

The team currently works in sprints, with three stand-ups a week and planning every two weeks. However, there is room to adapt how it works as it grows.

The role 

You'll be the senior engineer behind iwoca's broker and partner channels in Germany, from the tools partners integrate with to the internal systems that broker account managers use.

Ownership and autonomy 

- Own the Lending API in Germany end to end, deciding what to build, when to release a new version, when to retire an old one, and what iwoca can promise partners.

- Own the developer portal and every tool partners use to integrate, from documentation that their developers and coding agents can build from to self-serve testing that needs no help from iwoca.

Impact 

- Ship the features that make partners choose iwoca, starting with pre-qualification, which shows a customer what they could borrow before they apply.

- Make integration quick and simple, so a partner can go live with few questions and little hand-holding.

- Automate parts of the broker funnel and the internal CRM that broker account managers use, cutting friction and the lag between a decision and the action that follows, and building agents wherever they help.

Growth trajectory 

- Set the team's technical direction and shape the product and technical roadmap alongside the product manager.

- Align designs with the UK engineers who share the API, so German requirements shape the design from the start.

- As well as being hands on, you’ll develop your mentoring and coaching skills. You’ll help lead the team as the most senior engineer.

You'll work with the commercial colleagues who bring in new partners, and join the team's weekly support rotation.

The requirements 

Essential:

- Backend engineering. You've designed and built production backend systems in Python – ideally with Django, though FastAPI or Flask count too. You've used PostgreSQL or another relational database in production, and kept it fast and maintainable.

- API design. You've built and evolved APIs that other teams or companies depend on, and made the decisions on structure, versioning, and change.

- Ownership. You've taken work from a commercial problem through to production – scoping the solution, making the trade-offs, and iterating based on how people use it.

- Mentoring. You've helped other engineers grow through code reviews and design sessions.

- AI leverage. You've built agentic workflows, or used AI to scale your engineering output beyond what you could deliver alone. You judge when to use it and when not to.

- Communication. You write and speak clearly, directly, and concisely. You adapt technical detail to your audience.

Bonus:

- Partner onboarding. You've helped external developers integrate with an API – through documentation, test environments, or working with them directly.

- Full-stack. You've contributed to frontend codebases, particularly in React or TypeScript.

- CI/CD. You've set up or maintained the pipelines that test and release a production service.

- Measurement. You've used data, metrics, or A/B tests to check whether a change had the effect you intended.

The salary 

We expect to pay from £80,000 to £100,000 for this role. But, we’re open-minded, so definitely include your salary goals with your application. We routinely benchmark salaries against market rates, and run quarterly performance and salary reviews.

The culture 

At iwoca, the best idea wins. We model our culture on independent thinking, challenging untested logic, and evidence-based decisions. We prioritise learning and growth, and give people the autonomy to develop in the direction that makes them most effective.

We're a tech company and believe in the power of AI to help us work faster and better. We provide the infrastructure where every iwocan always has access to the best models and where those models have access to all of our data. We will help our people to learn how to use and grow with the new tools available to them.

The offices 

We put a lot of effort into making iwoca a great place to work:

- Offices in London, Leeds, Berlin, and Frankfurt with plenty of drinks and snacks.

- Events and community-led groups, including running groups, padel, and monthly ping-pong and pool competitions.

The benefits 

- Flexible working hours.

- Medical insurance from Vitality, including discounted gym membership.

- A private GP service (separate from Vitality) for you, your partner, and your dependents.

- 25 days’ holiday per year, an extra day off for your birthday, the option to buy or sell an additional five days of annual leave, and unlimited unpaid leave.

- A one-month, fully paid sabbatical after four years.

- Instant access to external counselling and therapy sessions for team members that need emotional or mental health support.

- 3% pension contributions on total earnings.

- An employee equity incentive scheme.

- Generous parental leave and a nursery tax benefit scheme to help you save money.

- Electric car scheme and cycle to work scheme.

- Two company retreats a year: we’ve been to France, Italy, Spain, and further afield.

And to make sure we all keep learning, we offer:

- A learning and development budget for everyone.

- Company-wide talks with internal and external speakers.

- Access to learning platforms like Treehouse.

Compensation: £80K – £100K

We are seeing enthusiastic and accelerated growth of the travel industry, and with that comes both opportunities and growing pains. The equipment in your backpack

title: Forward Deployed Engineer
description:
About SANOVIO 

SANOVIO makes buying and selling medical supplies easier. On our AI platform, hospitals, purchasing groups and suppliers work together in one place instead of juggling emails, Excel lists and disconnected systems. Hospitals can buy together, and suppliers reach that bundled demand more easily.

Our software, SANOVIO aOS, uses AI agents to take over the tedious work: cleaning up product data, comparing requests and offers, bundling demand and keeping orders on track. It connects to the systems our customers already use.

When needed, SANOVIO Fulfillment also takes care of the physical side: finding manufacturers worldwide, quality checks, financing, warehousing and delivery. The goal is simple: less admin work, and more time and money for patient care.

About the Role 

As a Forward Deployed Engineer , you are the bridge between our customers and our product, on both sides of the platform: healthcare providers and purchasing groups on one side, suppliers on the other. At its core, this role is about talking to customers . You work directly with procurement, logistics and IT teams, understand how they really work and make SANOVIO work inside their world: you connect our platform to their ERP, materials management and supplier systems , untangle their data and processes , and ship the solutions that make them successful.

This role is for builders who are just as comfortable in a customer workshop as in a code editor. Whether you studied business informatics, industrial engineering, computer science or mathematics , or bring experience in technical product management , product engineering or software engineering with a strong design sense : what matters is that you love solving messy real-world problems end to end. We hire for skills, not for degrees.

Tasks 

- Talking to our customers every day: leading workshops with procurement managers, IT departments and suppliers, and being a trusted partner for our customers

- Owning customer implementations end to end , from kickoff and process analysis to go-live and continuous improvement

- Analyzing and redesigning procurement processes on both sides, from requisition and ordering at healthcare providers to order handling at suppliers, and uncovering optimization potential

- Designing, building and running integrations between SANOVIO and our customers' ERP systems (such as SAP), materials management and supplier systems

- Onboarding and harmonizing customer data (e.g. article master data, catalogs, order histories) and building robust data pipelines and mappings

- Configuring and extending our AI agents for customer-specific workflows such as data matching and order automation

- Prototyping and shipping customer-facing workflows, tools and dashboards with a strong focus on usability for non-technical users

- Bringing customer insights back into the product and turning recurring solutions into product features together with our engineering team and the founders

Communication and customer focus 

- You enjoy talking to customers : you listen carefully, ask the right questions and explain technical topics in plain language

- Native-level German and very good English, so you can confidently lead conversations and workshops with our customers

- Confident with all kinds of stakeholders, from procurement managers to IT departments

- Willing to work on-site in Munich and to travel regularly to customers in Germany and Switzerland

General Profile 

- Degree in Business Informatics (Wirtschaftsinformatik), Industrial Engineering (Wirtschaftsingenieurwesen), Computer Science, Mathematics or a similar field. Skills matter more to us than your degree, so equivalent hands-on experience counts just as much

- Strong process understanding : you enjoy mapping, analyzing and improving business processes such as procure-to-pay or supply chain

- High ownership, structured problem-solving and the drive to deliver fast in ambiguous environments

- This is a junior role: a great fit if you're a recent graduate or have up to five years of professional experience . Internships and working student jobs count too

Technical skillset 

- First hands-on experience with system integrations and interfaces (e.g. REST APIs, webhooks, EDI or file-based interfaces), whether from work, internships or university projects

- Solid coding skills (e.g. TypeScript/JavaScript or Python) and good SQL and data skills

- Product and design affinity : you care about UX and can turn complex workflows into simple, intuitive interfaces. Experience with Figma or building UIs is a plus

Bonus if you 

- Worked at a startup or software company focused on SAP/ERP , integration platforms, process mining or procurement software (internships and working student jobs count too)

- Have first experience as a Technical PM, Product Engineer, Solutions or Implementation Engineer, or ERP consultant

- Have built with LLMs or AI agents, e.g. for data extraction or matching

- Bring domain knowledge in healthcare, hospitals, procurement or supply chain

- Can share a portfolio, GitHub or case studies of projects you shipped

Benefits 

- A steep learning curve: you learn integration work, process consulting and product building at the same time, working closely with the founders

- Real ownership and direct impact on how we work with our customers

- Great central office in Munich with regular team events and dinners

- Monthly wellness budget

- Access to the AI and productivity tools you need

- Regular customer visits across Germany and Switzerland

- Compensation package including cash, performance bonus and shares

About the interview process 

Step 1: Intro call 

Casual intro call to get to know each other, introduce SANOVIO and talk about your experience.

Step 2: Case study 

A practical case based on a real-world challenge from our platform, for example how you would connect a hospital or a supplier to SANOVIO and redesign its ordering process. You'll present your approach to the team, just like you would to a customer.

Step 3: Personal fit 

Meet one of our co-founders to get a feel for our culture and working style.

Step 4: Offer & reference checks 

If we see a great fit, you will get an offer, including a competitive compensation package. We'll also ask for two to three references.

title: Senior Full Stack
description:
Headquarters: Tallinn, Estonia

URL: https://toggl.com/jobs/ 

We are looking for a Senior Full Stack Engineer to join one of our Product Tribes, the cross-functional units that own the end-to-end experience for a specific Toggl user role. You'll join the Tribe building for managers, the people who plan work, protect margins, and keep projects on time and on budget.

You own significant parts of that experience end-to-end, working hands-on with product and design to ship work that matters. You'll do this as we build and launch Toggl 2.0, our consolidated planning, time tracking, and time intelligence product.

The salary for this position is €83,000 annually. 

You can work from anywhere in the world as long as your main location is between UTC-4 and UTC+4. 

The Role 

As a Senior Full Stack Engineer, you own meaningful parts of the product end-to-end, from the data model and the API to the interface someone actually clicks: the technical approach, the quality of what ships, and whether it actually works for the people using it. You are accountable not for tickets closed, but for clarity, craft, and outcomes.

You'll work in the Tribe serving managers, across planning and capacity management, dashboards, and billable work. This is some of the most data-dense, interaction-heavy surface area in the product: schedules and capacity views, reports, and visualizations that have to stay fast and readable at real customer scale. The interesting problems live on both sides of the API here - the query behind a capacity view matters as much as how that view renders. You'll build with React and TypeScript on the frontend and our backend services (mostly Golang) and data layer (Postgres) behind them, alongside a product manager, a designer, and engineers who are used to owning their work and pushing back when something isn't right. In a tribe of 5 other engineers, your impact and visibility are high.

Our team meetings are scheduled between 11:00 and 16:00 UTC. Your availability and commitment to participate in these sessions are essential for effective collaboration and team alignment.

Your main responsibilities will be:

Ownership and delivery 

- 
Take projects from problem to production. Own the technical approach for major features front to back, break the work down sensibly, sequence it, and ship in slices rather than one big drop.

- 
Make the technical calls in your area. Choose between options, name the tradeoffs, and decide without waiting for permission or escalating routine judgment.

- 
Keep your work visible without being chased. Flag risks and slips early, keep the Tribe in the loop, and unblock yourself.

Craft and quality across the stack 

- 
Build interfaces people trust with dense, real-world data. Planning views, dashboards, and reports that stay fast, accessible, and readable when the dataset gets ugly.

- 
Design the data and API layer those views depend on. Model it so the feature you're building now doesn't make the next three harder.

- 
Own performance as a feature, end to end. Profile, measure, and fix the slow query and the slow render instead of hoping the data stays small.

- 
Write code others can work in. Sensible components and services, real test coverage where it earns its keep, and a codebase that's easier to change after you touch it.

Working with product and design 

- 
Shape solutions, don't just implement them. Push on the problem, question requirements that don't hold up, and propose simpler paths when you see one.

- 
Partner closely with design. Prototype early, spot the edge cases in a flow before it's built, and hold the bar on UX quality with your designer rather than after handoff.

- 
Stay close to users and evidence. Join user tests, read the feedback, look at the data, and let it change what you build.

Raising the bar 

- 
Review code with intent. Give precise, actionable feedback that makes the change and the person better.

- 
Mentor and interview. Help other engineers grow, and help us hire well.

- 
Improve things across team boundaries. Spot shared components and duplicated work between Tribes, and raise it before we build the same thing twice.

AI as core leverage 

- 
Use AI tools extensively in your daily work for exploration, prototyping, code generation and review, debugging, research, and writing. AI fluency is not optional. It's part of how you increase your speed, depth, and impact - and you're expected to help the rest of the Tribe get better at it too.

About You 

You will thrive in this role if you:

- 
Have significant experience building and shipping production web applications end to end, and can lead major projects rather than just contribute to them.

- 
Are genuinely comfortable on both sides of the stack. You're deep on one side and properly capable on the other, not someone who hands off at the API boundary.

- 
Have deep, practical knowledge of JavaScript, TypeScript, React, and modern CSS - including state management and side-effect handling in large applications.

- 
Are solid on backend fundamentals: at least one backend language you know well, API design, relational data modelling, and enough instinct for query performance to spot the problem before production does. Prior Golang experience is not mandatory but you have to be willing to adopt it and become comfortable with it fast. 

- 
Hold an extremely high bar for quality. You know what great looks like, you notice the details others miss, and you don't ship work you wouldn't put your name on.

- 
Have a knack for data-heavy product surfaces - performance, readability, and the principles behind a chart that actually communicates something.

- 
Care about the user's problem, not just the ticket. You start from what someone is trying to get done and work back to the implementation.

- 
Own outcomes, not output. You follow your work into production, watch how it behaves, and fix what needs fixing.

- 
Thrive in ambiguity and move fast. You make confident decisions with incomplete information, adapt when things change, and course-correct without drama.

- 
Are hands-on with AI tools. You actively use AI as a core part of how you build, not a side experiment, and you have opinions about where it helps and where it doesn't.

- 
Don't need to be managed. You set your own direction, keep people in the loop, and ask for help when it matters.

- 
Have excellent written and verbal English communication skills. You write clearly, explain technical tradeoffs to non-engineers without jargon, and default to async communication that others can follow.

- 
Are eager to contribute to the engineering team's growth - code review, mentoring, and interviewing included.

- 
Value transparency, ownership, and speed over perfection. You ship, learn, and improve rather than waiting for the perfect plan.

- 
Nice to have: 

- 
Experience with TanStack is a bonus, and so is a real understanding of frontend caching and eventual consistency, we'd love to hire someone who's dealt with that tradeoff directly.

- 
Experience with capacity planning, scheduling, reporting, or other complex B2B SaaS products.

- 
Experience working with distributed or microservice systems, a basic understanding of infrastructure and infrastructure as code, and some experience creating, improving, or debugging CI/CD pipelines.

This Role Is NOT 

- 
A ticket-taker role. If you want fully specced work handed to you, this isn't the right fit.

- 
A pixel-pusher translating finished designs into code with no say in the problem or the solution.

- 
A role where you hand off at the API boundary. If "that's a backend ticket" is your instinct, this will frustrate you.

- 
A role where quality is someone else's job. Toggl doesn't have a dedicated QA
team or layer: there's no separate team that will catch your bugs, write your
tests, or own your performance regressions.

- 
A place to work in isolation from users. You'll be expected to know who you're building for and why.

- 
A role for people who need heavy process, frequent approvals, or top-down direction to do their best work.

The Team 

We are a global team of ~80 awesome people working from over 40 countries around the globe. We hire globally, you work locally—in the heart of London, a beach outside of Río de Janeiro, or a quiet village near Florence, the choice is yours. Every few months we travel to meet up somewhere in the world and spend some quality time together. We place a huge amount of trust in our people, and we measure the outcomes rather than the work itself. Our values fuel our results.

What's Happening at Toggl 

Toggl is at an exciting turning point. We're taking our best-in-class time tracking - trusted and loved by millions of users worldwide - and expanding it into something bigger: Toggl 2.0 . One product that brings together time tracking, planning, capacity management, reporting, and insight. The idea is simple: better time tracking creates better data, which powers everything else. We call it time intelligence. We build with AI throughout, and we think it's a real multiplier for strong engineers rather than a substitute for them. The judgment, the tradeoffs, and the accountability for what ships stay with people.

Benefits 

- 
Freedom to choose when and how much you work—we only measure results

- 
24 days of paid time off a year, plus your local holidays

- 
Unlimited sick leave

- 
In-person meetups for team-building (expenses covered)

- 
4-6 weeks paid sabbatical (depending on tenure)

- 
Laptop budget up to 2,500€ and it renews every 3 years

- 
€2,000 budget to set up your home office and an additional €300 every year after 3 years of tenure

- 
€3,000 per year for co-working space membership and/or internet service at home

- 
€4,000 per year contribution to use for training, workshops, and conferences

- 
€2,400 per year contribution for any equipment or services to improve and/or maintain your physical and mental health

- 
Support for buying tools you need for doing your best work (even eyeglasses if you need a new pair)

title: Software Engineer, AI Coding Tasks (Contract)
description:
Headquarters: Australia 

URL: https://www.askablelabs.com/ 

We're looking for experienced software engineers to build AI coding tasks from a codebase they know well. US$1,000 per task, and you can do as many tasks as you want.

You turn a real change from a repository you know into a task that today's best AI coding models struggle with: hard for the models, but fair for a skilled engineer. Your tasks are used to measure and train AI coding models.

Remote, any location. US$1,000 per task that passes review. Minimum of one task a week, about 10 hours a week.

How it works 

- Apply. Complete a short screener interview and upload your resume.

- Propose. Once you're selected, pick a change from a repository you know and submit a short proposal. We approve it or suggest a better candidate.

- Build. In our platform, set up the repository as it was before the change, then write the brief, the correct solution and the grading checks.

- Stress-test. Try lazy, incorrect and shortcut solutions and make sure your checks catch them.

- Model testing. Run your task against leading AI models until strong models often fail but a skilled engineer can clearly solve it.

- Review. A reviewer checks your task and you revise it. Most tasks take more than one round.

- Next task. Once your task is accepted, start another.

Requirements 

- 2+ years of professional software engineering

- Code merged into a public open-source repository, ideally one you know well. A private codebase you own may also qualify (not employer or client code)

- Strong in at least one of Python, TypeScript, Go, Rust, Java or C++

- Solid with Docker, Linux, Git and automated testing

- Regular use of an AI coding tool

- Experience writing tests, rubrics or evaluation criteria, ideally for AI models

- You can explain a change clearly and concisely, in your own words

- At least 10 hours a week, starting now

- A secure personal or work computer (no public or shared machines)

Nice to have 

- Deep expertise in one area, such as databases, compilers, distributed systems, security or infrastructure

- Experience building agent tasks or RL environments

Terms 

- US$1,000 for each task that passes our quality review, paid directly to you

- Once your proposal is qualified, you sign Askable's contract and accept its terms

- The work is used for AI training. The change and your solution must be your own, and you must be free to license them to us

- Don't publish the work anywhere: no public pull request or public fork

title: Commercial Data Scientist
description:
Headquarters: San Francisco, CA or Remote (U.S.)

Commercial Data Scientist 

Doximity is the leading clinical AI company with the largest network of U.S. clinicians. Doximity’s AI-powered workflow platform is trusted by over 85% of U.S. physicians and 300+ health systems. Doximity's mission is to help clinicians be more productive so they can provide better care for their patients. 

At Doximity, we value curiosity, ownership, inclusion, and a commitment to making a meaningful impact. If you're excited about solving complex problems that improve healthcare, we'd love to hear from you.

This role can be filled in the Northeast (New York, NJ, Philadelphia, Boston), our San Francisco headquarters, OR other remote locations in the U.S. 

As a Commercial Data Scientist , you’ll work within cross-functional delivery teams alongside other analysts, engineers, and commercial stakeholders in discovering data insights to help improve healthcare.

How you’ll make an impact: 

- Deliver novel and impactful insights for client organizations using machine learning and AI technologies.

- Work closely with our Product, Platform Data, Insights & Strategy, and Sales teams to create client-facing analyses.

- Showcase your engineering skills by creating data products from scratch and automating code so they can be re-used by other teammates and future projects.

- Leverage Doximity's extensive datasets to identify and classify behavioral patterns of medical professionals on our platform.

- Embrace the challenge of a fast-paced environment to exceed client expectations

The Core Values of the Client Intelligence team 

As an organization we value diversity - in backgrounds and in experiences. Healthcare is a universal concern, and we need people from all backgrounds to help build a better future for all. Below are additional core values specific to the Insights Team.

- Collaboration —The best candidates and teammates are not only strong in their own aptitudes but care deeply about supporting each other's growth.

- Passion for Data —You’re going to help our clients and team members with data-driven decision making. We need someone that can manipulate millions of rows of data and also ask the right questions to find the important insights.

- Reliability – Our team is efficient, flexible, and agile only because we trust the reliability of each member. We need self-starters and goal-oriented individuals for our continued success.

- Curiosity – Continuous learning is a cornerstone at Doximity, and curious individuals thrive in our environment. We’re looking for someone who is curious enough about data to go above-and-beyond the task for the true insight.

- Respect – A key dynamic that allows our team to flourish is respect: for ourselves and our quality of work, for our teammates, and for our internal clients who are under the pressure of deadlines and finance goals.

About you: 

- At least 4 years of professional experience as a Data Scientist or other related roles working with complex, high-volume, structured and unstructured datasets.

- Prior experience in a data science consulting role at firms such as ZS, Trinity, IQVIA, BlueMatter, etc., where you thrived in a fast-paced environment

- Advanced knowledge of statistical concepts — particularly exploratory data analysis, experimental design, and probability theory.

- Deep understanding of modern machine learning techniques

- Proven ability to design, train, and evaluate large-scale production models using frameworks such as PyTorch or TensorFlow.

- Advanced SQL proficiency — skilled at writing and optimizing complex queries across multiple tables and data relationships.

- Advanced Python skills, including understanding of object-oriented programming, production-grade code design, and modern data science libraries.

- Hands-on experience with distributed data processing tools and concepts for scalable analysis and model training.

- Excellent data visualization and storytelling abilities, with the capacity to translate technical insights into clear, compelling narratives for internal and client stakeholders.

- Curious, fast learner with a demonstrated passion for data, continuous learning, and staying current with advances in machine learning research.

Fun Facts About the Client Intelligence team 

- We have access to one of the richest healthcare datasets in the world, with deep information on hundreds of thousands of clinicians and their connections.

- Business decisions at Doximity are driven by our data, analyses, and insights.

- The members of our team bring a diverse set of technical and cultural backgrounds.

- We like to have fun - company outings, team lunches, and other social events!

Compensation 

The anticipated total compensation for this role is $119,333 - $172,800 depending on factors such as experience, skills, location, and internal equity.

Our total compensation package may include:

- Base salary

- Equity (where applicable)

- Annual bonus or incentive compensation (where applicable)

Specific compensation details will be discussed during the interview process.

Benefits 

In addition to competitive compensation, Doximity offers a comprehensive benefits package for full time employees. Some of our offerings include:

- Medical, dental, and vision insurance

- 401(k) with company match

- Flexible paid time off and company holidays

- Paid parental leave

- Professional development and learning opportunities

- Wellness and mental health resources

- Remote work support and home office stipend (where applicable)

Why You'll Love Working Here 

At Doximity, you'll join a mission-driven company where your work has a meaningful impact on healthcare. We believe great ideas come from empowered teams, and we're committed to creating an environment where people can do their best work.

- Make a real impact. Help build products that support over a million healthcare professionals and ultimately improve patient care.

- Work with exceptional teammates. Collaborate with thoughtful, talented colleagues who value curiosity, humility, and continuous learning.

- Enjoy flexibility and trust. We support flexible ways of working and empower employees with the autonomy to own their work.

- Grow your career. Take on meaningful challenges, develop new skills, and shape your career through mentorship and professional development.

- Bring your authentic self. We're committed to fostering an inclusive culture where diverse perspectives are welcomed, respected, and celebrated.

Our Hiring Process & AI Tools 

Doximity may use artificial intelligence (AI)-enabled tools throughout the hiring process to help improve the candidate experience and support our recruiting team. These tools may assist with administrative tasks such as scheduling, general communication, interview coordination, note-taking, or summarizing interview feedback. Human recruiters and hiring managers make all hiring decisions. We are committed to using AI responsibly, transparently, and in accordance with applicable laws.

Equal Employment Opportunity

Grafana Alerting is trusted by major organizations worldwide, monitoring essential medical devices and critical infrastructure. We thrive on collective creativity and diverse perspectives, every team member is encouraged to contribute ideas that shape our product into a dependable tool.

title: Machine Learning Engineer - IV (Computer Vision)
description:
Headquarters: India (remote)

Machine Learning Engineer IV – (Computer Vision) 

We’re looking for a Staff/Senior Machine Learning Engineer with deep expertise in computer vision and biometrics to lead the design and scaling of face recognition systems in production. You’ll build and train models, and own ML systems end-to-end on AWS. The final job level for this role will be determined following the interview process.

What You’ll Do 

- Lead the design and development of computer vision systems for biometrics (face attributes, detection, quality, and recognition)

- Rigorous fairness analysis and benchmarking of biometric models across various datasets and operating conditions.

- Architect, train, and optimize models using PyTorch, Tensorflow, and/or JAX

- Own and evolve end-to-end ML pipelines, from data ingestion to deployment. Design automated pipelines (Airflow) for data ingestion and cleaning. You will be responsible for curating balanced training sets and generating synthetic data to address both quality and diversity gaps.

- Production Engineering: Own the path to production. Optimize models for low-latency inference (quantization, distillation, TensorRT/ONNX) and manage deployment on AWS.

- Mentor ML engineers, conduct code/design reviews, and drive technical best practices across the Computer Vision team.

What We’re Looking For 

- Strong industry experience in Machine Learning, dedicated to Biometrics or Face Analysis.

- Deep expertise in computer vision and biometrics, especially face recognition.

- Fairness & Ethics: You understand the sources of algorithmic bias in Computer Vision and have practical experience measuring and mitigating disparate impact.

- Strong Engineering: Expert proficiency in Python (both machine learning and vision libraries such as Pillow, OpenCV, PyTorch, etc). You write clean, modular, production-ready code.

- Systems Architecture: Experience designing end-to-end ML pipelines (Data to Train to Deploy) and working with workflow orchestrators like Airflow.

- Cloud Native: Hands-on experience scaling training jobs on multi-GPU clusters and deploying services on AWS (SageMaker, EC2, EKS).

Nice to Have 

- Research Publications: Papers in CVPR, ICCV, ECCV, or FG related to face recognition, image quality assessment, or fairness.

- Large Scale Search: Experience with vector databases (e.g., Milvus, Faiss) and approximate nearest neighbor (ANN) search algorithms.

- Familiarity with privacy, security, and compliance in biometric systems.

- Mobile/Edge Experience: Experience porting models to edge or mobile devices utilizing frameworks such as CoreML, LiteRT, and/or TFLite.

- Synthetic Data: Experience using GANs or diffusion models to generate synthetic faces for training.

- Strong communication skills.

Jumio Values: 

IDEAL: Integrity, Diversity, Empowerment, Accountability, Leading Innovation 

Equal Opportunities : 

Jumio is a collaboration of people with different ideas, strengths, interests and cultures. We welcome applications and colleagues from all backgrounds and of all statuses. 

About Jumio: 

Jumio is a B2B technology company dedicated to eradicating online identity fraud, money laundering and other financial crimes to help make the internet safer. We leverage AI, biometrics, machine learning, liveness detection and automation to create solutions that are trusted by leading brands worldwide and respected by industry thought leaders. 

Jumio is the leading provider of online identity verification, eKYC and AML solutions. With a global footprint, we’re expanding the team to meet strong client demand across a range of industries including Financial Services, Travel, Sharing Economy, Fintech, Gaming, and others.

Applicant Data Privacy 

We will only use your personal information in connection with Jumio’s application, recruitment, and hiring processes, as described in Jumio’s Applicant Privacy Notice. If you have any questions or comments, please send an email to privacy@jumio.com .

title: Analytics Engineer
description:
Headquarters: Remote - United States

Reddit is a community of communities. It’s built on shared interests, passion, and trust, and is home to the most open and authentic conversations on the internet. Every day, Reddit users submit, vote, and comment on the topics they care most about. With 100,000+ active communities and approximately 130 million daily active unique visitors, Reddit is one of the internet’s largest sources of information. For more information, visit www.redditinc.com .

We are looking for a talented and driven individual to be a key part of our Analytics Engineering team within the Data Science organization. We are looking for someone who can work closely with Data Scientists and Engineers across diverse areas of the organization (Consumer, Ads, and Marketing) to curate, develop, and deploy the right data and analytic tooling to drive Reddit’s product forward and provide a data and tooling foundation that will last decades. Your work will empower thousands of your colleagues to improve the user experience and grow our consumer base.

Successful candidates have a strong track record of understanding and deeply caring about the purpose of data to support business goals, and can act as an effective conduit between Data Producers and Data Consumers. This role sits at the intersection of Data Science and Data Engineering, and the ideal candidate has skills, experience, and passion in both areas.

Responsibilities: 

- Be a key contributor and collaborator to the success of data quality, performance, reliability, and automation initiatives.

- Manage a portfolio of data products that deliver high-quality, trustworthy data

- Develop and maintain robust data pipelines and workflows for data ingestion, processing, and transformation. Work closely with engineering to ensure the quality and reliability of these data pipelines.

- Develop and implement data quality checks, conduct QA and implement monitoring routines

- Create and manage new data integrations across internal and external systems

- Create tools and applications for internal use that streamline data analysis and reporting. Drive widespread adoption of these tools and applications with a relentless focus on automation, consistency, and reliability.

- Serve as a thought partner for data scientists, engineering managers, and leadership on data foundations, communicating and shaping the data foundations roadmap and strategy for Reddit.

Qualifications: 

- Bachelor's degree in computer science or a quant educational field

- 3+ years of experience working with large-scale ETL systems (implementation, strategy, and maintenance), building clean, maintainable code and systems (Python preferred) in a production environment.

- Strong programming proficiency in Python, SQL, Spark, Scala, etc.

- Experience with data modeling, ETL and ELT concepts, and patterns for efficient data governance. Experience with manipulating massive-scale structured and unstructured data.

- Experience with data workflows (such as Airflow), data modeling, front-end or back-end engineering.

- Experience in data analysis and dashboard design.

- Deep understanding of technical and functional designs for relational and MPP Databases.

- Proven track record of cross-functional execution and collaboration. 

- Agentic AI-assisted development experience.

- Excellent communication skills to collaborate with cross-functional stakeholders at all levels of the company, of differing levels of technical acumen.

- Self-starter, ability to work independently and autonomously, as well as part of a team.

title: Developer Relations Engineer
description:
About Supabase 

Supabase is the Postgres development platform, built by developers for developers. We provide a complete backend solution including Database, Auth, Storage, Edge Functions, Realtime, and Vector Search. All services are deeply integrated and designed for growth.

About the Role 

We’re looking for a Developer Relations Engineer based in San Francisco to join our team and to help more developers discover, learn, and build with Supabase. You’ll create high-impact content, build real-world projects, and represent Supabase across communities and events. If you’re equally energized by writing code and teaching others, this is the role for you.

Why this role matters

Supabase is growing fast with 350,000+ developers , 1,000+ OSS contributors , and a thriving open source ecosystem. Our users are builders, startup founders, weekend hackers, and engineers scaling to millions of users. DevRel is how we meet them where they are: through content, community, and code.

We’re building a community of communities that brings together developers from many backgrounds, including first-time open source contributors. As a DevRel Engineer, you’ll be a bridge between Supabase and the broader developer ecosystem, helping people get started, go deep, and feel connected.

What you'll do

- 
Make content 

Publish compelling technical content, especially video, to help developers learn Supabase quickly

- 
Build demos and tutorials 

Ship real-world apps using Supabase and tools like Next.js, React, and Stripe. Write guides that others can follow and remix

- 
Represent Supabase 

Speak at meetups, livestream builds, and engage with the developer ecosystem. You’ll be a visible and trusted voice of the platform

- 
Support and grow the community 

Celebrate contributors, answer questions, highlight cool projects, and bring developer feedback to the team

- 
Collaborate across the company 

Work with engineering, product, and growth to amplify launches, prioritize content, and reduce friction for new users

You might be a fit if:

- 
You’ve built full-stack apps and enjoy sharing your knowledge

- 
You create content that makes people want to open their code editor

- 
You’re equally comfortable writing a video script and TypeScript

- 
You’re energized by community whether it’s on Discord, Twitter, YouTube, or in person

- 
You’re self-directed, organized, and excited to contribute to open source

Requirements

This role is based in San Francisco to support regular in-person devrel video shoots, attend local events, and be an active presence in the SF tech ecosystem.

- 
Strong engineering skills, especially with JavaScript or TypeScript, Postgres, and modern frontend frameworks (React, Svelte, Vue, etc.)

- 
Experience creating technical content (written or video)

- 
Comfortable representing a product publicly (on camera, on stage, or online)

Bonus points if you have:

- 
A growing audience on YouTube, Twitch, or Twitter

- 
Prior experience in DevRel or open source

- 
Have used (and loved) Supabase

What We Offer 

- 
Fully Remote 

We hire globally. We believe you can do your best work from anywhere. There are no Supabase offices, but we provide a WeWork membership or co-working allowance you can use anywhere in the world.

- 
ESOP 

Every team member receives ESOP (equity ownership) in the company. We want everyone to share in the upside of what we’re building together.

- 
Tech Allowance 

Use this budget to set up your ideal work environment—laptop, monitor, headphones, or whatever helps you do your best work.

- 
Health Benefits 

Supabase covers 100% of health insurance for employees and 80% for dependents, wherever you are. Your wellbeing and your family’s health are important to us.

- 
Annual Off-Sites 

Once a year, the entire company gathers in a new city for a week of connection, collaboration, and fun. It’s a highlight of our year.

- 
Flexible Work 

We operate asynchronously and trust you to manage your own time. You know what needs to be done and when.

- 
Professional Development 

Every team member receives an annual education allowance to spend on learning—courses, books, conferences, or anything that supports your growth.

About the Team 

Supabase was born-remote and open-source-first. We believe our globally distributed team is our secret weapon in building tools developers love.

- 
~400 team members

- 
60+ countries

- 
20+ languages spoken

- 
Over $1B raised (including our $500M Series F)

- 
540,000+ community members

We move fast, build in public, and use what we ship. If it’s in your project, we probably use it in ours too. We believe deeply in the open-source ecosystem and strive to support—not replace—existing tools and communities.

title: Principal Software Architect
description:
Location: This is a 100% remote role open to those who reside in the US, UK, or EMEA region.

About the job 

Testlio 's fully managed crowdsourced testing platform, powered by our proprietary intelligence technology - LeoCore™, integrates expert, on-demand testers directly into your release process. Ship faster and more confidently with global coverage across 600,000+ devices, 800+ payment methods, 150+ countries, and 100+ languages. To learn more, visit testlio.com . 

We are hiring a Principal Architect to serve as a hands-on individual contributor who will shape our application and platform architecture, driving production-ready systems that directly enable our next generation of intelligent, distributed software testing solutions.

Why will you love this job? 

- High Ownership and Autonomy: Be a foundational technical leader steering a profound platform transformation, making critical structural decisions that balance immediate system delivery with long-term enterprise scalability.

- Pragmatic AI & System Innovation: Step past the hype to integrate actionable AI capabilities directly into high-throughput surfaces, modernizing our core monolith into a robust distributed network alongside our product and executive leaders.

Why you will love being a part of Testlio? 

- Great Culture : Testlio is a female-founded company, and half of our team identifies as women. We’re proud of our inclusive, purpose-driven culture where people genuinely enjoy collaborating. As part of our team (we call ourselves TestLions), you’ll help create exceptional digital experiences for our customers, while also contributing to our freelance network.

- Remote Work : Our culture is built around remote work. We’ve created systems to allow us to successfully work together asynchronously as a fully remote and globally distributed team . Testlio provides the tools and guidance for everyone to succeed in their careers in a fully remote setting. Our working style encourages everyone to make decisions, communicate effectively, and work at a sustainable pace. 

- Investment in You : Your growth and well-being matter to us. You’ll have flexible paid time off—including national holidays, personal days, and sick days—plus stock options so you can grow with Testlio. We also provide a $300 annual learning stipend to support your personal and professional development.

- Winning Business : Testlio is growing, profitable, and cash-strong. We are leading our industry with exceptional clients who provide us with a high NPS score and a 4.7 rating on G2. Our business model is global, enterprise, and subscription-based. Several of our largest clients have been with us for 7+ years, and many spend $500K+/year with Testlio. 

What would your day look like? 

- Architect, develop, and deploy scalable, production-grade services directly across the core Testlio software platform.

- Author clear architectural standards and reference patterns that define domain boundaries, decoupling our current codebase into modular services.

- Partner with the Director of Engineering to execute frontend framework consolidation, improving operational performance and observability.

- Safeguard system efficiency and regulatory posture by designing with security, cost-efficiency, and ISO 27001 expectations at the center.

- Integrate secure AI/LLM patterns into customer-facing surfaces, establishing strict operational guardrails and failure modes for our Quality API.

- Advise executive, product, and engineering teams on major technical tradeoffs, translating business needs into clean technical strategies.

What do you need to succeed? 

Technical Skills 

- 15+ years of hands-on software development experience building cloud-native, business-critical platforms.

- Advanced mastery of distributed system patterns, data modeling, event-driven design, and database technologies (Relational and NoSQL).

- Proven track record designing and migrating application infrastructures, specifically moving from monolithic architectures to modular services.

- Deep experience establishing enterprise-ready patterns in AWS, emphasizing high availability, cost optimization, and secure infrastructure.

- Strong familiarity with modern full-stack code environments, including front-end web frameworks, scripting languages, and CI/CD pipelines.

- Practical, production-grade experience deploying AI/ML or LLM-based solutions with an emphasis on observable, safe automation patterns.

Human Skills 

- Fluency in English with exceptional written and verbal communication skills, especially when presenting advanced architecture concepts to business leaders.

- Ability to operate effectively as an individual contributor in fast-paced, ambiguous environments, showing proactive problem ownership.

- Strong collaboration and alignment focus, capable of guiding distributed engineering teams and technical peers without direct authority.

- Outstanding analytical thinking, balancing a broad long-term technology vision with practical, short-term implementation constraints.

- Natural inclination for remote-first work, successfully communicating and documenting technical decisions asynchronously across global time zones.

What is the application process? 

At Testlio, we aim to hire individuals who are excited about their role, thrive in a fully remote environment, and have strong long-term potential with our team. Because we are a fully distributed company, our interview process includes conversations with several team members so you can get a well-rounded understanding of the role, the people you’ll work with, and how we collaborate. As a result, our interview process typically takes 3–4 weeks to complete.

Interview Process: 

- Application

- Recruiter interview

- Stakeholder Interview

- Technical Exercise 

- Offer & background check

Diversity and Inclusion 

Testlio is an equal-opportunity employer deeply committed to creating an inclusive environment for people of all backgrounds and identities. We are female-founded, and half of our team members identify as women. For more information, see the DEI section of our website.

title: Senior Software Engineer
description:
Who we are 

At Twilio , we’re shaping the future of communications, all from the comfort of our homes. We deliver innovative solutions to hundreds of thousands of businesses and empower millions of developers worldwide to craft personalized customer experiences.

Our dedication to remote-first work , and strong culture of connection and global inclusion means that no matter your location, you’re part of a vibrant team with diverse experiences making a global impact each day. As we continue to revolutionize how the world interacts, we’re acquiring new skills and experiences that make work feel truly rewarding. Your career at Twilio is in your hands.
.

Hiring and how we work 

We use Artificial Intelligence (AI) to help make our hiring process efficient. That said, every hiring decision is made by real Twilions! 

Also, while we are a remote-first company, you may be asked to report in person on an ad-hoc basis for team gatherings, functional off-sites or customer meetings. 
.

See yourself at Twilio 

Join the team as Twilio’s next Senior Software Engineer.

About the job 

This position will be part of a team of talented engineers within our Commerce Platform Team, who build services and products that operate at a massive scale. This platform is central to Twilio's core business as it is responsible for managing the billing lifecycle and payment experience for our customers, while also acting as a gateway for discovering and selling our products. Billing is going through a transformational journey, and we are introducing new and exciting capabilities. The engineer in this role will be part of a team that focuses on the control plane, billing experience and account lifecycle management.

The successful candidate will design, build, and operate core billing platform services that help transition our platform and our customers to the next generation architecture. These services work for all Twilio customers, regardless of their scale and billing complexity.

The ideal candidate will build high-quality, innovative and fully performing software that complies with high levels of coding standards and technical design. This is to build and integrate services that continuously improve our ability to provide products to customers while simultaneously delivering industry leading availability. We do this by leveraging technologies that include AWS cloud infrastructure and APIs, Apache Kafka, Rest APIs (OpenAPI compliance), while also building our own services.

Responsibilities 

In this role, you’ll:

- Improve your knowledge of highly available and scalable distributed systems and use this knowledge to build new features into our platform.

- Design, implement, and operate both new features on our current services as well as new services that will be built from scratch.

- Leverage your excellent communication and written skills to articulate the "why" of the solution you are proposing, and have a good understanding of your team’s priorities and the customer impact.

- Troubleshoot and fix operational issues and have the opportunity to improve the troubleshooting procedures and tools.

- Execute full software development life cycle (SDLC).

- Develop flowcharts and documentation to identify solutions.

- Write well-designed, testable code.

- Document and maintain software functionality.

- Troubleshoot, debug and upgrade existing systems.

Qualifications 

Twilio values diverse experiences from all kinds of industries, and we encourage everyone who meets the required qualifications to apply. If your career is just starting or hasn't followed a traditional path, don't let that stop you from considering Twilio. We are always looking for people who will bring something new to the table!

As a Commerce Platform engineer, you will design and build core platform services, REST APIs and take part in transitioning our platform to next generation architecture. We run on AWS cloud infrastructure and use AWS cloud data store, EKS, Glue, Kafka, Aurora RDS etc.

*Required: 

- 5+ years of work experience building highly scalable products.

- 5+ years of programming experience in object-oriented language (Java or similar) with clean code practices.

- Expert knowledge in Object-Oriented Programming with a successful track record.

- Experience contributing to architecture and design (architecture, design patterns, reliability and scaling) of new and current systems.

- Experience working closely with our Product team to understand requirements and help to define technical work for the team.

- Experience working with stakeholders at all levels - be able to dive into the nuts-and-bolts of how things work as needed.

- Experience with relational and non-relational databases.

- Experience delivering high levels of observability and proficiency in improving early warning systems, for example: has worked with Grafana/DataDog/Prometheus.

- Collaborating with internal/external teams/engineers and fostering an inclusive environment, where all points of view are welcomed and encouraged.

- Own and lead multiple domains of the platform (microservices, REST APIs, infrastructure) from inception to deployment and maintenance, while making best in class technical decisions that impact the success of the company.

- Familiarity in Cloud Solutions, AWS, Kubernetes/EKS, CI/CD pipelines, Testing & Automation. 

- Self driven - you take complete ownership of your tasks and champion efforts to get your tasks to completion.

- Clear written and spoken communication skills.

- Degree in Computer Science or a related field, or equivalent work experience.

Desired: 

- Experience with on-call support for mission-critical customer systems.

- Experience optimizing and debugging complex SQL queries.

- Experience working on customer-facing applications.

title: Senior Infrastructure Engineer
description:
