title: Lead Data/ETL Engineer
description:
Overview

DecisionPoint seeks a Lead Data/ETL Engineer to provide technical leadership and hands-on engineering for data ingestion, transformation, integration, and delivery under the USMEPCOM ENLIST program. 

This SME-level position will maintain and optimize SQL Server Integration Services (SSIS), implement approved API integrations and incremental loading approaches, and build raw, standardized, and curated data layers. The engineer will establish reliable processes for reconciliation, retries, schema changes, identifier mappings, lineage, and failed-record handling. 

The Lead Data/ETL Engineer will collaborate with database administrators, architects, governance personnel, AI/ML engineers, BI developers, testers, and Government stakeholders to deliver accurate, traceable, and maintainable data pipelines supporting mission analysis, AI capabilities, and reporting. 

This position is remote, with Chicago-area candidates preferred. 

Note: By applying to this position, you acknowledge and consent to having your resume included in an active competitive government contract bid. 

Duties & Responsibilities

The Lead Data/ETL Engineer will: 

- Lead the design, implementation, maintenance, and optimization of enterprise data integration and ETL pipelines. 
- Maintain and optimize SSIS packages, configurations, schedules, dependencies, and execution processes. 
- Develop SQL queries, stored procedures, transformations, and reconciliation logic. 
- Use Python or another approved automation language to support ingestion, orchestration, validation, monitoring, and recovery. 
- Implement approved API integrations, including authentication, pagination, rate-limit handling, retries, and error processing. 
- Design incremental loading strategies and implement change-data capture where appropriate and approved. 
- Build and maintain raw, standardized, and curated data layers with documented transformation rules. 
- Establish source-to-target mappings, common identifier mappings, and consistent handling of reference data. 
- Implement reconciliation checks to verify record counts, totals, completeness, and transformation accuracy. 
- Develop restartable processing, controlled retries, checkpoints, and recovery procedures. 
- Implement failed-record handling, quarantine processes, error logging, and controlled reprocessing. 
- Assess and manage schema changes and their effects on pipelines, datasets, analytical models, and reports. 
- Maintain data lineage, transformation documentation, interface specifications, and pipeline dependencies. 
- Monitor pipeline execution, throughput, freshness, resource utilization, and operational failures. 
- Troubleshoot complex issues involving source systems, APIs, SSIS packages, SQL logic, data quality, and downstream integrations. 
- Optimize pipeline performance while maintaining data integrity, traceability, and approved security controls. 
- Coordinate with governance personnel on definitions, ownership, authoritative sources, metadata, and approved data uses. 
- Work with independent testing personnel to support reconciliation, regression testing, defect resolution, and release validation. 
- Coordinate pipeline changes with database, application, AI/ML, warehouse, and BI teams. 
- Maintain version-controlled code, deployment instructions, rollback procedures, and operational runbooks. 
- Review technical designs and code, guide engineering practices, and provide knowledge transfer to other engineers. 
- Communicate pipeline health, risks, dependencies, corrective actions, and improvement recommendations to technical leads and Government stakeholders.
Qualifications

Required Qualifications

The following must-have qualifications are drawn from the supplied position requirements: 

- Active Secret clearance or higher. 
- Minimum of 12 years of relevant professional experience. 
- Bachelor’s degree in computer science, information systems, or a related field, or a permitted equivalent. 
- Experience maintaining and optimizing SQL Server Integration Services (SSIS). 
- Strong SQL skills. 
- Experience with Python and data engineering automation. 
- Experience implementing and supporting API integrations. 
- Experience developing incremental data loads. 
- Experience documenting and maintaining data lineage. 
- Experience troubleshooting complex data pipelines. 
- Ability to build raw, standardized, and curated data layers. 
- Ability to manage reconciliation, retries, schema changes, identifier mappings, and failed-record handling. 
- Ability to implement change-data capture where appropriate. 
- CompTIA Security+ CE or another approved IAT Level II certification when applicable to assigned duties. 
Preferred Qualifications

The following qualifications are preferred but are not required: 

- Relevant data engineering or cloud platform certification. 
- Experience supporting federal or Department of Defense data environments. 
- Experience modernizing legacy SSIS integrations or transitioning pipelines to approved cloud platforms. 
- Experience with enterprise data warehouses, analytical datasets, BI platforms, or AI-ready data. 
- Familiarity with data catalogs, metadata management, data governance, and automated lineage tools. 
- Experience developing automated data-quality checks, reconciliation frameworks, and pipeline regression tests. 
- Experience integrating data engineering workflows with CI/CD, version control, and automated deployment. 
- Experience implementing secure service accounts, secrets management, encryption, and pipeline audit logging. 
- Strong technical mentoring, documentation, troubleshooting, and stakeholder communication skills.

title: Staff Backend Engineer - Grafana Alerting | Spain | Remote
description:
Grafana Labs is the company behind Grafana Cloud, the fully managed observability platform trusted by more than 10,000 organizations to ensure reliability, resolve incidents faster, and optimize telemetry at scale. Built on open source and open standards and designed for interoperability across any stack, Grafana Cloud brings AI to observability and observability to AI, giving teams (and their agents) unified visibility so they can see, understand, and act on all their disparate data, wherever it lives, and move at the speed of their ambitions. Morgan, CapitalG, and Lead Edge Capital. Learn more at grafana.com and follow us on LinkedIn and X . 

We’re scaling fast and staying true to what makes us different: an open-source legacy, a global collaborative culture, and a passion for meaningful work. Our team thrives in an innovation-driven environment where transparency, autonomy, and trust fuel everything we do.

The Opportunity: 

The Grafana Alerting squad operates at the core of the Grafana open-source project (link) , and our mission is to provide the most in-depth way to let users manage their alerts. The backend-focused team works closely with customers and the Grafana Cloud teams to make Alerting work on-prem and at infinite scale in Cloud. The team's scope spans both Grafana Alerting and the SLOs product, so engineers get to work across two products that are deeply connected in how they help users detect and respond to problems.

Grafana Alerting is trusted by major organizations worldwide, monitoring essential medical devices and critical infrastructure. We thrive on collective creativity and diverse perspectives, every team member is encouraged to contribute ideas that shape our product into a dependable tool.

Our domain is quite large, so to get an idea of the kind of work we do, here are some projects we recently worked on:

- Build distributed systems to scale alert ingestion and delivery of Prometheus-based alerts

- Unify Alerting setup and delivery to work the same for Grafana and Prometheus-based alerts

- Build distributed systems to scale alert evaluation of Grafana-managed alerts, reaching over 500 evaluations per second in production.

Grafana Alerting is trusted by major organizations worldwide, monitoring essential medical devices and critical infrastructure. We thrive on collective creativity and diverse perspectives, every team member is encouraged to contribute ideas that shape our product into a dependable tool.

What You’ll Be Doing: 

- Take an active role in influencing our roadmap and your own career objectives 

- Work with your team to deliver new features, then use the results to iterate and improve.

- Drive projects from initial ideation all the way to operations once it is in the hands of customers

- Embrace our open-source culture and contribute to other projects that may not directly fall within your team’s scope

- Design, build, operate, and maintain critical systems, owning the reliability, performance, and availability

- Mentor and support other team members, participate in design discussions and collaborate with the team

- Learn new skills by gaining a deeper understanding of our cloud product and our customers and getting to know the codebase of a large distributed system

As we are remote-first and our engineering organization is largely remote, we provide guidance and meet regularly using video calls, so an independent attitude and good communication skills are a must.

What Makes You a Great Fit: 

- You are a motivated self starter with a bias towards action

- You are customer focused

- We build everything with our users in mind.

- You have a passion for creating intuitive products that fit customers’ needs 

- Pragmatism: You are able to take on complex challenges and break them down to achieve short feedback loops: to analyze, design, and build modular solutions, deliver MVPs, gather data and feedback and then progress iteratively

- Collaboration and communication: The smallest unit we have is a team. You’ll be working with your teammates in a fully remote setup. Good communication skills are a must

- Solid experience with at least one programming language. We use Go, but if you have familiarity with Python, Java, C++, Rust or similar then that translates well

- Some experience with delivering projects from gathering requirements, brainstorming ideas all the way to shipping a product to the customer’s hands in a self-driven way

- Some experience with developing software that runs in the Cloud or some experience with systems engineering

- Experience writing clean, robust, and performant software that is easily maintained by others

Compensation & Rewards: 

In Spain, the compensation range for this role is EUR 94,025 - EUR 112,830. Actual compensation may vary based on level, experience, and skillset as assessed throughout the interview process. All of our roles include Restricted Stock Units (RSUs), giving every team member ownership in Grafana Labs' success. We believe in shared outcomes—RSUs help us stay aligned and invested as we scale globally.

*Compensation ranges are country specific. If you are applying for this role from a different location than listed above, your recruiter will discuss your specific market’s defined pay range & benefits at the beginning of the process. 

Why You’ll Thrive at Grafana Labs: 

- 100% Remote, Global Culture - As a remote-only company, we bring together talent from around the world, united by a culture of collaboration and shared purpose.

- Scaling Organization – Tackle meaningful work in a high-growth, ever-evolving environment.

- Transparent Communication – Expect open decision-making and regular company-wide updates.

- Innovation-Driven – Autonomy and support to ship great work and try new things.

- Career Growth Pathways – Defined opportunities to grow and develop your career.

- Approachable Leadership – Transparent execs who are involved, visible, and human.

- Passionate People – Join a team of smart, supportive folks who care deeply about what they do.

- Balance is Key - We operate a global annual leave policy of 30 days per annum. 3 days of your annual leave entitlement are reserved for Grafana Shutdown Days to allow the team to really disconnect. *We will comply with local legislation where applicable.

title: Cloud Solution Architect
description:
Cloud Solution Architect - Data & AI

Location: UK (Hybrid)
Practice: Data & AI

About HSO

HSO is a Business Transformation Partner with deep industry expertise and global reach. As one of Microsoft's leading partners, we help organisations unlock the full potential of Microsoft Dynamics 365, Azure, Data and AI technologies to deliver meaningful business outcomes.

With operations across Europe, North America and Asia, HSO combines industry knowledge, technical excellence and a people-first culture to help customers modernise their businesses, transform operations and embrace innovation with confidence.

As demand for Data & AI solutions continues to accelerate, we're expanding our Data & AI practice and looking for experienced Cloud Solution Architects to help shape the next generation of customer transformation programmes.

The Role

As a Cloud Solution Architect - Data & AI , you'll play a pivotal role in shaping and qualifying customer opportunities across the Microsoft cloud ecosystem.

This is a highly visible role that sits at the intersection of sales, enterprise architecture and delivery , combining technical leadership with commercial thinking. You'll work closely with customers, Microsoft and internal stakeholders to understand business challenges, identify opportunities, design compelling solutions and create clear pathways from initial discovery through to successful delivery.

You'll help organisations transform the way they use data, analytics and artificial intelligence, translating business ambition into practical, costed and deliverable solutions.

Success in this role requires more than technical expertise. You'll need strong consulting and stakeholder management skills, the confidence to challenge assumptions, and the commercial awareness to ensure opportunities are both valuable for clients and aligned with HSO's delivery capability.

What You'll Be Doing

Opportunity Qualification & Solution Shaping

- Lead Data & AI opportunity qualification alongside Account Managers, Business Development teams and Enterprise Architects.

- Facilitate customer discovery workshops, architecture assessments and strategic discussions.

- Understand customer business drivers, challenges and desired outcomes.

- Help customers define realistic transformation roadmaps aligned to business priorities.

- Qualify opportunities using structured sales and consulting methodologies, including MEDDIC/MEDDICC approaches.

Solution Architecture & Advisory

- Design end-to-end Data & AI solutions using Microsoft technologies and best practices.

- Shape modern analytics, AI and data platform architectures that are commercially viable and technically deliverable.

- Provide architectural leadership across data platform modernisation, analytics, AI and automation initiatives.

- Ensure alignment with Microsoft Cloud Adoption Framework and Azure Well-Architected principles.

- Communicate architectural trade-offs and recommendations to both technical and non-technical audiences.

Commercial Leadership

- Translate customer requirements into proposals, statements of work, delivery plans and business cases.

- Produce solution estimates, cost models and phased implementation approaches.

- Support customers in understanding ROI, value realisation and investment considerations.

- Challenge unclear scope and identify delivery, cost and commercial risks early in the sales cycle.

- Work closely with delivery teams to validate assumptions before commitments are made.

Growth & Go-to-Market

- Contribute to the evolution of HSO's Data & AI propositions and repeatable offerings.

- Develop demonstrations, accelerators, sales collateral and industry-specific solution narratives.

- Support RFPs, bid responses, executive presentations and proof-of-concept engagements.

- Collaborate with Microsoft stakeholders to drive pipeline growth and co-sell opportunities.

- Keep up to date with emerging Microsoft technologies and industry trends across Data & AI.

What We're Looking For

The ideal candidate combines strong technical capability with exceptional commercial awareness.

You'll be equally comfortable discussing board-level business outcomes with executive stakeholders as you are diving into architecture decisions with technical teams.

Commercial & Consulting Experience

You'll have:

- Proven experience in a Solution Architecture, Pre-Sales, Consulting or Technical Advisory role.

- Experience working within a Microsoft partner, consultancy or enterprise technology environment.

- Strong commercial acumen and experience creating proposals, business cases and Statements of Work.

- The ability to qualify opportunities and challenge assumptions constructively.

- Excellent workshop facilitation, discovery and stakeholder management skills.

- Experience presenting to senior business and technical audiences.

- The ability to translate complex technical concepts into clear business value.

- Understanding of opportunity qualification methodologies such as MEDDIC or MEDDICC.

Experience across industries such as manufacturing, retail, financial services, healthcare, public sector, not-for-profit, utilities or professional services would be advantageous.

Technical Experience

We recognise that few candidates will have expertise across every area listed below. We're primarily looking for strong Data & AI architecture experience across the Microsoft ecosystem.

Essential

Data & Analytics

- Microsoft Fabric

- Lakehouse architecture patterns

- Power BI and self-service analytics

- Semantic modelling and reporting solutions

- Data platform modernisation and analytics strategy

Azure Data Platform

- Azure Data Lake Storage (ADLS)

- Azure Synapse Analytics

- Azure Databricks

- Azure SQL Database

- Azure Cosmos DB

- Azure Data Factory

AI & Automation

- Azure AI Services

- Azure OpenAI Service

- Azure AI Foundry

- Copilot Studio

- Agentic AI patterns and intelligent automation solutions

- Document intelligence and AI-driven business use cases

Data Engineering & Platform Delivery

- SQL

- Python and/or PySpark

- Data pipelines and transformation frameworks

- CI/CD concepts and deployment automation

- Azure DevOps and/or GitHub

- Infrastructure as Code awareness

- Environment promotion and release management approaches

Advantageous

Data Governance & Security

- Microsoft Purview

- Data governance frameworks

- Data lineage and catalogue solutions

- Information protection concepts

- Role-based access control

- Azure Key Vault

- Secure platform design principles

Integration & Application Connectivity

- Azure Logic Apps

- Azure Functions

- Azure Service Bus

- Azure API Management

- Enterprise integration patterns

- Operational and analytical workload integration

Certifications

Microsoft certifications are not essential but are highly desirable, particularly across:

- Microsoft Azure

- Microsoft Fabric

- Data & Analytics

- Artificial Intelligence

- Security

As a leading Microsoft partner, HSO actively invests in certification, specialisation and continuous learning, helping our consultants stay at the forefront of Microsoft's rapidly evolving technology landscape.

Why Join HSO?

This is an exciting opportunity to join one of Microsoft's most respected global partners during a period of significant growth in Data & AI.

You'll have the opportunity to:

- Shape the future of HSO's Data & AI propositions and offerings.

- Work alongside Microsoft on strategic customer initiatives.

- Influence major digital, data and AI transformation programmes.

- Help organisations realise measurable value from data and artificial intelligence.

- Work with some of the most innovative technologies in the Microsoft ecosystem.

- Collaborate with highly skilled consultants, architects and delivery professionals across the globe.

- Benefit from continuous professional development, certification support and access to Microsoft's latest technologies.

Most importantly, you'll have the freedom to combine commercial thinking, architectural leadership and innovation to create meaningful outcomes for customers and make a real impact on the future of Data & AI transformation.

Ready to help shape the future of Data & AI? We'd love to hear from you.

title: Sr. Software Engineer, AI Tools (MXC)
description:
Do work that matters. 

At AlertMedia , we help organizations protect their people, operations, and brand. Our modern Risk Intelligence and Response platform empowers teams to detect emerging threats, assess impact, and respond with confidence. We believe building resilience should be simpler—and it starts with bringing critical information and workflows together in one unified platform. 

Our core values drive us in our important mission of keeping people safe & informed: 

- We’re humans not robots 

- Customers always come first 

- We work better together

As one of the fastest growing software companies in the country, we’re looking for a Sr Software Engineer with strong experience building AI development tools to help accelerate an AI-first development model that's already well underway. 

This role focuses on designing and extending the agents, skills, and automation that take on engineering work — and on steadily widening what they can own, from planning and implementation through code review and CI. title: Field Integration Engineer
description:
Applied Intuition , Inc. is powering the future of physical AI. Founded in 2017 and now valued at $15 billion, the Silicon Valley company is creating the digital infrastructure needed to bring intelligence to every moving machine on the planet. Applied Intuition services the automotive, defense, trucking, construction, mining and agriculture industries in three core areas: tools and infrastructure, operating systems, and autonomy. Eighteen of the top 20 global automakers, as well as the United States military and its allies, trust the company’s solutions to deliver physical intelligence. Applied Intuition is headquartered in Sunnyvale, California, with offices in Washington, D.C.; San Diego; Ft. Walton Beach, Florida; Ann Arbor, Michigan; London; Stuttgart; Munich; Stockholm; Bangalore; Seoul; and Tokyo. Learn more at applied.co .

We are an in-office company, and our expectation is that full-time employees primarily work from their Applied Intuition office 5 days a week. However, we also recognize the importance of flexibility and trust our employees to manage their schedules responsibly. This may include occasional remote work, starting the day with morning meetings from home before heading to the office, or leaving earlier when needed to accommodate family commitments. This in-office expectation does not apply to contractor positions 

About the Role 

We are seeking Field Integration Engineers who excel at connecting software engineering, customer interaction, and hands-on field operations. In this position, you will drive the full-stack integration and deployment of our software solutions across customer hardware, physical vehicles, and test benches.

Serving as the key technical expert on-site, mainly in the great Chicago area, you will ensure our software operates seamlessly on customer vehicles. You will bring up target hardware, SIL, and HIL setups; troubleshoot integration challenges spanning software, firmware, and vehicle networks; and partner directly with customer systems and software engineering teams to deliver production-ready autonomous and intelligent vehicle technology.

Travel Expectation: This position requires significant travel (30%–50%+) to customer facilities, proving grounds, test tracks, and active field deployment sites.

At Applied Intuition, you will: 

- 
Deploy, configure, and integrate vehicle software stack, middleware, and application-level code on customer target hardware, HIL simulators, and vehicle platforms.

- 
Serve as the primary technical escalation point on-site. Collect logs/telemetry, bisect software pipelines, debug system crashes, and isolate root causes across software-hardware boundaries.

- 
Debug and validate communication interfaces (CAN, LIN, Automotive Ethernet, J1939) and verify end-to-end data flow between sensors, ECUs, and application software.

- 
Partner closely with internal core software/firmware engineering teams to reproduce complex field issues, validate fixes, and push continuous system improvements.

- 
Write Python scripts, Bash automation, and internal tooling to streamline deployment, automated diagnostics, and log collection in field environments.

- 
Work directly with customer engineering leadership to define target integration use-cases, articulate system constraints, and establish clear integration milestones.

We're looking for someone who has: 

- 
BS or MS in Computer Engineering, Electrical Engineering, Mechatronics, Computer Science, or a related technical field.

- 
Strong programming skills in embedded C and/or C++, with solid software engineering practices in Linux development and command-line environments.

- 
2+ years of hands-on experience integrating, testing, and debugging software applications on physical target platforms or embedded hardware.

- 
Practical understanding of automotive or industrial network topologies, protocol analysis (CAN, Ethernet, J1939), and diagnostic standards (UDS, DoIP, OBD-II).

- 
Strong analytical skills to systematically isolate faults across multi-component software pipelines and hardware interfaces.

- 
Strong written and verbal communication skills with the confidence to represent the engineering team in fast-paced, high-stakes customer environments.

- 
Ability and willingness to travel 30%–50%+ to domestic and international customer locations and testing sites.

Nice to have: 

- 
Experience with vehicle platforms, autonomous systems, robotics, or active industrial/field environments.

- 
Familiarity with AUTOSAR platform concepts (RTE, SWCs, ARXML), SIL/HIL test rigs, or ROS/ROS2 architecture.

- 
Experience using network analysis tools (e.g., Vector CANoe/CANape, Wireshark, PEAK-System) or hardware debugging tools (oscilloscopes, multimeters).

- 
Scripting capability in Python for data processing, log parsing, or test automation.

Don’t meet every single requirement? If you’re excited about this role but your past experience doesn’t align perfectly with every qualification in the job description, we encourage you to apply anyway. You may be just the right candidate for this or other roles.

title: Software Engineer AI Coding Tasks
description:
We're looking for experienced software engineers to build AI coding tasks from a codebase they know well. US$1,000 per task, and you can do as many tasks as you want.

You turn a real change from a repository you know into a task that today's best AI coding models struggle with: hard for the models, but fair for a skilled engineer. Your tasks are used to measure and train AI coding models.

Remote, any location. US$1,000 per task that passes review. Minimum of one task a week, about 10 hours a week.

How it works 

- Apply. Complete a short screener interview and upload your resume.
- Propose. Once you're selected, pick a change from a repository you know and submit a short proposal. We approve it or suggest a better candidate.
- Build. In our platform, set up the repository as it was before the change, then write the brief, the correct solution and the grading checks.
- Stress-test. Try lazy, incorrect and shortcut solutions and make sure your checks catch them.
- Model testing. Run your task against leading AI models until strong models often fail but a skilled engineer can clearly solve it.
- Review. A reviewer checks your task and you revise it. Most tasks take more than one round.
- Next task. Once your task is accepted, start another.

Requirements 

- 2+ years of professional software engineering
- Code merged into a public open-source repository, ideally one you know well. A private codebase you own may also qualify (not employer or client code)
- Strong in at least one of Python, TypeScript, Go, Rust, Java or C++
- Solid with Docker, Linux, Git and automated testing
- Regular use of an AI coding tool
- Experience writing tests, rubrics or evaluation criteria, ideally for AI models
- You can explain a change clearly and concisely, in your own words
- At least 10 hours a week, starting now
- A secure personal or work computer (no public or shared machines)

Nice to have 

- Deep expertise in one area, such as databases, compilers, distributed systems, security or infrastructure
- Experience building agent tasks or RL environments

Terms 

- US$1,000 for each task that passes our quality review, paid directly to you
- Once your proposal is qualified, you sign Askable's contract and accept its terms
- The work is used for AI training. The change and your solution must be your own, and you must be free to license them to us
- Don't publish the work anywhere: no public pull request or public fork

Apply at https://www.askable.com/experts/roles/senior-software-engineer

title: Senior IT Consultant Power Platform (m/w/d) - bundesweit
description:
Gestalte mit uns, wie Technologie Unternehmen verändert – und deine Karriere gleich mit.   

HSO gehört seit über 21 Jahren zum Microsoft Inner Circle – der exklusiven Top 1 % aller Partner weltweit – und wurde 26-mal als Microsoft Partner of the Year ausgezeichnet. Mit über 30 Jahren Erfahrung, 2.800 Mitarbeitenden aus 43 Nationen und 33 Standorten weltweit verbinden wir technologische Exzellenz mit tiefem Branchenverständnis.   

Wir gestalten die digitale Zukunft des internationalen Mittelstands und von Großunternehmen. Als treibende Kraft für digitale Transformation implementieren wir komplexe, globale  Microsoft Dynamics 365 Multiworkload-Architekturen  (Finance, Supply Chain, Manufacturing, CE). Dabei gehen wir neue Wege: Wir verknüpfen klassische Projektmethodik mit den modernsten  KI- und AI-Werkzeugen , um Projekte schneller, transparenter und effizienter zum Erfolg zu führen.

- Architektur & Entwicklung 
In deiner täglichen Arbeit entwickelst du professionelle, unternehmenskritische Anwendungen auf Basis der Power Platform. Du setzt anspruchsvolle Model-Driven Apps um, modellierst hochwertige Dataverse-Strukturen, implementierst Geschäftslogiken und automatisierst Prozesse mit Power Automate. Dabei nutzt du Technologien wie Power Pages, AI Builder, Copilot Studio und Solution Layers, um robuste und gleichzeitig flexible Lösungen zu gestalten, die echten Mehrwert liefern.

- Integration & Schnittstellenentwicklung – dein Schwerpunkt 
Ein wesentlicher Teil deiner Rolle besteht darin, Power-Platform-Lösungen tief in bestehende Systemlandschaften einzubinden. Du entwickelst Integrationen zwischen der Power Platform und Dynamics 365 (CRM/ERP) sowie anderen Backend-Systemen, arbeitest mit REST-APIs, OData, virtuellen Entities, Custom Connectors und Azure Web APIs und sorgst dafür, dass Daten sicher, performant und zuverlässig fließen. Du konzipierst Integrationsarchitekturen, entwirfst Datenflüsse und stellst sicher, dass Power Platform und Dynamics nahtlos zusammenarbeiten.

- Governance, Landing Zones & ALM 
Du hilfst Kunden dabei, eine stabile und zukunftsfähige Power-Platform-Umgebung aufzubauen. Dazu gehört das Ausarbeiten von Governance-Konzepten, die Planung und Umsetzung von Landing Zones, die Strukturierung von Environments sowie die Definition von Sicherheits- und Compliance-Standards. Gleichzeitig treibst du strukturiertes Application Lifecycle Management voran, baust durchdachte Solution-Strukturen auf und nutzt DevOps-Pipelines, um Entwicklungs- und Deploymentprozesse zu professionalisieren.

- Geschäftsprozessanalyse & Lösungsdesign 
Du analysierst Kundenprozesse, identifizierst Optimierungspotenziale und entwickelst daraus skalierbare technische Designs. Im engen Austausch mit Stakeholdern übersetzt du fachliche Anforderungen in saubere Datenmodelle, Logiken, Automatisierungen und Integrationsarchitekturen. Dabei kombinierst du Low-Code- und Pro-Code-Ansätze so, dass Lösungen nachhaltig wartbar und technisch fundiert sind.

- Datenmanagement, virtuelle Entities & Dataflows 
Du arbeitest mit relationalen Datenbanken, entwirfst Datenmodelle und entwickelst Datenarchitekturen, die optimal zu den Geschäftsanforderungen passen. Du bindest externe Systeme über virtuelle Entities an, nutzt Dataflows und Power Query für ETL-Prozesse und sorgst für konsistente und saubere Datenstrukturen innerhalb von Dataverse. Die Kombination aus Datenmodellierung, technischer Integration und Plattformwissen ermöglicht dir, komplexe Datenlandschaften ganzheitlich zu gestalten.

- Workshops & Enablement 
Du führst Workshops durch, schulst Fachbereiche und ermöglichst Kundenteams, die Power Platform kompetent und sicher einzusetzen. Dabei vermittelst du Best Practices, erklärst Lösungsansätze verständlich und baust eine langfristige Kompetenz bei den Nutzern auf.

Qualifikationen

- Power-Platform-Erfahrung (≥ 2 Jahre) 
Du entwickelst professionelle Model-Driven Apps, modellierst Dataverse-Strukturen, setzt Geschäftslogiken mit Power Automate um, arbeitest mit Power Pages und nutzt Custom Connectors, AI Builder und erste Funktionen aus Copilot Studio. ALM und Solution-Management sind dir vertraut.

- Integrationserfahrung (Dynamics 365 & APIs) 
Du hast Power-Platform-Lösungen idealerweise an Dynamics 365 oder andere Enterprise-Systeme angebunden, arbeitest sicher mit REST-/OData-APIs, virtuellen Entities und Dataflows und entwickelst stabile Integrationen. Erfahrung mit Azure Web APIs, Functions oder Logic Apps ist ein Plus.

- Starke Datenbank- & Datenmodellierungskenntnisse 
Du beherrschst SQL Server oder vergleichbare Systeme, entwirfst saubere ER-Modelle, arbeitest mit Normalformen und erstellst komplexe SQL-Abfragen. Datenstrukturen kannst du logisch planen, dokumentieren und konsistent in Dataverse übertragen.

- Analytische & konzeptionelle Stärke

title: Cloud Security Engineer
description:
A little about us

incident.io is the AI software reliability platform trusted by engineering teams at Netflix, Etsy, and 2,000+ companies who can't afford downtime.

The stakes are real, the talent is insane, and somehow it's a genuinely lovely place to work. We all pull our weight, go the extra mile, and put in the bit of magic most companies don't have time for, all while having fun and never taking ourselves too seriously.

We've raised $100+ million from Index Ventures, Insight Partners, and Point Nine, and we're growing fast. There's never been a better time to join.

The role in one line 

Being a Cloud Security Engineer at incident means being the person who keeps the one thing customers rely on when their systems are on fire both up and safe, turning “is this secure?” into “yes, and here’s the proof.”

What that looks like day to day 

As a Cloud Security Engineer at incident, you own the security of the cloud infrastructure that runs our platform: how it’s built, hardened, monitored and defended. It’s a genuinely varied role. One day you’re tightening IAM across our Google Cloud projects, the next you’re building a Terraform guardrail so engineers get a safe path instead of a ticket, the next you’re leading an investigation into something odd in the audit logs.

You’ll own cloud posture and hardening across GCP and GKE, identity and access, security as code in our Terraform and CI/CD pipelines, detection and response, isolation of customer data in our multi-tenant platform, and the cloud-side controls around our AI features.

We formed our security team this year and there are three of us. We’re hiring a Cloud Security Engineer to give the team real depth in cloud, which means little process, no approval chains, and your fingerprints on everything. We say yes wherever we genuinely can, and you’ll have the authority to block a release when it matters.

We run on Google Cloud and AWS, with Kubernetes, Terraform, Go, Postgres and TypeScript/React. We lean on Claude and other LLMs to move faster.

Who you are 

- You’ve got deep, hands-on cloud security experience, ideally on Google Cloud. Strong AWS or Azure depth that transfers is fine.

- You design least-privilege IAM properly, and you’ve secured Kubernetes or container platforms in production.

- You write code to fix problems, not just report them. Terraform is second nature.

- You’ve built cloud detection or investigated cloud incidents, and you enjoy following the thread until you find the answer.

- You can give hard feedback to an engineer and have them thank you for it.

- You’re comfortable with high autonomy. Nobody’s going to hand you a detailed spec, you’re trusted to figure out what needs doing and just do it.

- Bonus: Go or Postgres security, policy-as-code, supply chain security, or securing AI/LLM-powered products.

Supporting you 

We work hard and we think life outside work matters just as much. Our benefits pack is built to support both.

- Private medical insurance. Seriously good cover - we want you and the people you love to be looked after.

- Competitive annual leave. Showing up at your best requires switching off, and we make sure you have time to do that.

- First Friday of every month off. Yes, seriously.

- Enhanced pension. We put real money in, because future-you deserves better than an afterthought.

- Meaningful equity. We're rapidly scaling, and everyone who helps shape the outcome should share in it.

- Unlimited AI spend. For everyone, not just engineers. We're all-in on AI across the company, and we expect you to be too.

- Generous parental leave. The early days with a new baby matter more than anything we're doing here, and we want you to be present for them.

- Two budgets that have your back. £1000 to invest in your setup, £500 a year to invest in yourself.

Compensation: £110K – £200K • Offers Equity

- Collaboration Platform: GitHub

- Framework: Odoo (ORM, Workflows, Report Engine, BI, AI)

Das bringst du mit

Bei Odoo schätzen wir deine Fähigkeiten mehr als den Lebenslauf. 

- Sprachkenntnisse: Sehr gute Deutsch- und Englischkenntnisse (C1-C2).

- Hintergrund: Ein abgeschlossenes Studium der (Wirtschafts-)Informatik, eine Fachinformatiker-Ausbildung oder eine vergleichbare technische Qualifikation sowie fundierte praktische Erfahrung in der Softwareentwicklung.

Langweilige 0815 Jobs, mit komplizierten Entscheidungswegen, starren Hierarchien und Micromanaging sind nicht so dein Ding? Cool, unser auch nicht!

Außerdem ist unser Produkt natürlich super cool und generiert einen wirklichen Mehrwert für unsere Kund:innen.

title: AI Experience Engineer (Conversational AI)
description:

About the Role: 

An AI Experience Engineer owns the full lifecycle of the journeys our customers have with Upgrade's AI agent on chat, voice and email: creation, optimization, edge case handling and containment growth. They build journeys in Sierra's no-code tooling, partner with Upgrade's product groups to bring their servicing flows to the agent, and are accountable for whether the agent resolves the customer's issue safely, accurately and without a human. 

We are hiring an AI Experience Engineer to own Upgrade's customer-facing AI agent. You will sit between engineering, product and customer operations. You will turn servicing workflows, such as making a payment, checking loan details, updating an address or enabling autopay, into production journeys and keep improving them after launch. You will build and own the journeys end to end, from first draft to steady state. The work is part builder, part analyst: design the flow, handle the edge cases, read the transcripts, and keep raising containment. Containment, CSAT, transfer quality and hallucination rate are your metrics. 

Within your first year, you will own a portfolio of journeys across products (Personal Loans, Card, BNPL, HELOC, Deposits) and help set the standards for how Upgrade builds, tests and ships AI experiences. 

Our Core Technologies 

Sierra Agent Studio (no-code journeys), Sierra simulations and conversation analytics, GraphQL and REST APIs (as journey tools), Genesys (contact center handoff), SumoLogic, Grafana, SQL, Javascript/Typescript, Claude and other LLM tools. 

What You'll Do 

• Journey creation: Design and build Sierra journeys in Agent Studio for chat, voice and email, from discovery with operations through production rollout 

• Optimization: Review transcripts, recordings and analytics every week, find where conversations fail or transfer, and ship fixes to journey logic, instructions and knowledge 

• Edge case handling: Map the unhappy paths (failed payments, mismatched identity, delinquent accounts, unsupported requests) and make sure each ends in a correct answer or a clean handoff 

• Containment: Own containment and CSAT targets per journey, run staged rollouts (1% → 100%), and prioritize the work that moves those numbers most 

• Product partnership: Work with product groups (Personal Loans, Card, BNPL, Deposits) to scope new journeys, keep journeys current as products change, and define the APIs the agent needs 

• Safety and compliance: Apply tiered authentication and step-up verification, verbatim compliance language and guardrails against hallucination and off-policy answers 

• Handoffs: Design transfers to human agents in Genesys with accurate summaries and auth context 

• Testing: Build simulation and regression suites so every journey change ships with evidence it did not break existing behavior 

• Monitoring: Watch latency, errors and drop-offs in SumoLogic and Grafana, and own the alerts 

• Voice tuning: Latency, filler phrases, interruptions, personality and tone 

• Sierra relationship: Be the technical owner on our side, escalate platform issues and shape roadmap asks 

What We Look For: 

• 3–5 years of Frontend Software Engineering experience, or equivalent experience in Solutions Engineering, Conversational AI or Technical Product roles 

• Working knowledge of how LLM agents behave: instructions, tool calls, knowledge retrieval, and where each one fails 

• Experience building evaluations for non-deterministic systems: test sets, simulations, LLM-as-judge, regression gates 

• Enough technical depth to read API specs, work with backend engineers on REST and GraphQL integrations, and reason about authorization and permission scopes 

• Working knowledge of JavaScript/TypeScript, with the ability to build and maintain coded journeys and integrate APIs within conversational AI platforms. 

• Product and customer mindset: you understand ops procedures, you read transcripts, care about tone, and measure success by whether the customer's problem got solved 

• Ownership in production: rollouts, monitoring, log analysis and incident response 

• Clear writing and the ability to work with non-engineers in operations, compliance and legal 

Nice To Have: 

• Hands-on experience with Sierra Agent Studio, or a comparable no-code agent platform (Decagon, Ada, Kore.ai, Google CCAI, Amazon Lex/Connect) 

• Voice AI experience: speech-to-text, text-to-speech, latency tuning, barge-in handling 

• Contact center systems such as Genesys, and agent handoff design 

• Background in fintech or another regulated industry (UDAAP, FDCPA, TCPA, PCI, SOC 2) 

• Conversation design or UX writing experience 

What We Offer You: 

• Competitive salary ($140K-$180K CAN) and stock option plan 

• Paid coverage of medical, dental and vision insurance 

• Flexible PTO 

• Opportunities for professional growth and development
• Paid parental leave 

• Health & wellness initiatives

title: Senior Software Engineer, Infrastructure Platform
description:

This is Engineering at Lattice 

Lattice’s Engineering team is continuously working to better both our product and our craft. We use a modern, cutting-edge tech stack and love experimenting with new technologies. We strive for maintainable, robust, and performant code. We’re highly collaborative and continuously iterative, and work closely with designers and product managers. We prioritize not only great technical architecture but also an amazing product experience.

The Infrastructure Platform team focuses on the cloud services, infrastructure, and internal platforms that power Lattice’s products. We build reliable, scalable pathways that make it easier for product engineers to develop, deploy, operate, and troubleshoot their services. 

What You Will Do 

As a Senior Software Engineer on the Infrastructure Platform team, you will work across a broad technical footprint, including AWS infrastructure, Kubernetes, distributed systems, observability, deployment tooling, and internal developer platforms.

You will use your prior experience to understand how systems and services interact, identify gaps or sources of friction, and build platform capabilities that improve reliability and developer productivity.

- Design, build, and operate AWS-based cloud infrastructure and platform services.

- Create reusable internal platform capabilities that improve how engineers build, deploy, and operate services.

- Work across AWS, Kubernetes, IaC, CI/CD, observability, and distributed systems.

- 5+ years of software or infrastructure engineering experience.

- Deep AWS experience in production environments.

- Experience with cloud infrastructure, distributed systems, and system design.

- Experience building internal platforms, developer tooling, or shared services.

- Hands-on Kubernetes and infrastructure-as-code experience (Terraform a plus).

- Strong programming skills and ability to debug production systems (TypeScript a plus).

- Experience with CI/CD and automated deployment workflows.

- Experience with observability (metrics, logs, traces, alerting, SLOs).

- Ability to reason across complex systems and understand cross-component interactions.

- Experience leading technical initiatives with multiple stakeholders.

title: Senior Software Engineer, Processing
description:
Headquarters: Remote 

Lithic is the modern card issuing and processing platform empowering ambitious financial companies to build the future of payments.

Our infrastructure powers card programs for 100+ innovative clients, from fintechs reimagining credit and digital banking to platforms transforming disbursements and spend management. Companies like Mercury, Flex, and Novo rely on Lithic's developer-friendly APIs, direct network connections, and flawless reconciliation to launch and scale card programs in weeks, not years.

We're building a future where access to better financial products materially improves people's lives, free from the constraints of 30-year-old mainframes and legacy processors. We're proud to be backed by world-class investors who share that vision, including Bessemer Venture Partners, Index Ventures, Spark Capital, Stripes, and Mastercard, along with many others. 

We're a team of 170+ across 26 states and 7 countries, headquartered in New York City. 

Position: Senior Software Engineer, Processing

Location: Remote

We are hiring a Senior Software Engineer for our Processing team to lead Lithic’s next phase of growth.

The Processing team builds and maintains the real-time interfaces between Lithic and external payment networks. Every card authorization, clearing message, and settlement file flows through systems this team owns. The team manages both online and batch transaction flows across Mastercard, Visa, and Amex, along with transaction enrichment, disputes processing, and network compliance. The systems we maintain have strict latency and uptime requirements, because they sit on the critical path for every card transaction. The team also manages the physical network peering with card network partners, so infrastructure and networking expertise are important. The team primarily uses Java, Python, and Kotlin on AWS.

What you'll do: 

- Ensure high reliability, low latency, and correctness for Lithic's transaction processing interfaces and related services

- Develop new capabilities across authorization, clearing/settlement, disputes, and network integration surfaces

- Ensure that the team is delivering reliable, secure, and scalable code with minimal tech debt

- Evolve the infrastructure supporting physical network peering with card network partners, ensuring connectivity, failover, and capacity meet reliability requirements

- Own initiatives from planning to launch, keeping stakeholders informed and aligned along the way

- Participate in the team on-call rotation

- Lead efforts to improve systems and processes both within the team and across engineering

- Help drive strategic planning in collaboration with the engineering manager and product manager

What you'll bring: 

- 8+ years experience shipping code in fast paced production environments

- Advanced distributed system instincts and design skills

- Experience driving large cross-functional projects across engineering, product, and operations teams

- A proven commitment to empathy and inclusion

- Excellent communication skills

- Growth mindset and continuous desire to learn and improve is a must

- An interest in fintech and the payments space is preferred

The annual US salary range for this role is $160,000 - $200,000 plus equity. This salary range may be inclusive of several career levels at Lithic and will be narrowed during the interview process based on the candidate’s experience and qualifications. 

This is a remote position. However, candidates must be located in the United States, Canada (Ontario or British Columbia), Netherlands, Poland, or Czech Republic. We do not offer visa sponsorship or assistance.

This is a hybrid position. Candidates must be located within a commutable distance to our NYC office in Soho. We do not offer visa sponsorship or assistance.

title: Senior Data Engineer - Capital Markets (R13923)
description:
Headquarters: Remote - MX

Who We Are 

Oportun (Nasdaq: OPRT) is a mission-driven financial services company that puts its members' financial goals within reach. With intelligent borrowing, savings, and budgeting capabilities, Oportun empowers members with the confidence to build a better financial future. Since inception, Oportun has provided more than $22.7 billion in responsible and affordable credit, saved its members more than $2.5 billion in interest and fees, and helped its members set aside an average of more than $1,800 annually. 

The Opportunity 

As a Sr. Data Engineer at Oportun, you will be a key member of our team, responsible for designing, developing, and maintaining sophisticated software / data platforms in achieving the charter of the engineering group. Your mastery of a technical domain enables you to take up business problems and solve them with a technical solution. With your depth of expertise and leadership abilities, you will actively contribute to architectural decisions, mentor junior engineers, and collaborate closely with cross-functional teams to deliver high-quality, scalable software solutions that advance our impact in the market. This is a role where you will have the opportunity to take up responsibility in leading the technology effort – from technical requirements gathering to final successful delivery of the product - for large initiatives (cross-functional and multi-month-long projects). 

At Oportun, we move fast and we hold each other to a high bar. If you care about doing your best work while actually moving the needle for real people, you'll fit right in. 

What You'll Do 

Your day-to-day 

- You’ll design and implement scalable, efficient, and reliable data architectures that support business and analytical needs. 

- You’ll build and maintain data pipelines, ETL processes, and integration solutions for large volumes of structured and unstructured data. 

- You’ll optimize data pipelines, databases, data warehouses, and data lakes for performance, reliability, scalability, and security. 

- You’ll partner with stakeholders to understand data requirements, develop domain expertise, and translate business needs into effective data models and solutions. 

- You’ll establish and improve data quality standards, validation rules, documentation, and governance practices. 

- You’ll implement monitoring and observability practices to identify bottlenecks, improve performance, and strengthen platform reliability. 

- You’ll provide technical leadership on architecture, scalability, reliability, monitoring, integration, and extensibility. 

- You’ll lead and contribute to code reviews, helping maintain high standards for code quality, performance, and maintainability. 

- You’ll mentor junior engineers and support a culture of continuous learning and technical excellence. 

- You’ll take ownership of production issues, including troubleshooting, root-cause analysis, escalation, and long-term resolution. 

- You’ll independently lead multiple features and projects, coordinate work across engineers, and keep stakeholders informed of progress, risks, and dependencies. 

- You’ll help evolve engineering tools, platforms, and practices and encourage adoption of better ways of working. 

- You’ll look for practical ways to use AI tools to improve engineering productivity, analysis, documentation, and problem-solving. 

Who You Are 

The right fit looks like this 

You’re a hands-on data engineer who enjoys solving complex technical problems and building systems that others depend on. You combine strong technical depth with a practical understanding of business needs and know how to turn ambiguous requirements into scalable solutions. 

You take ownership, communicate clearly, and are comfortable leading technical work without relying on formal authority. You enjoy mentoring others and helping teams make stronger technical decisions. 

What You Bring 

Skills & experience 

Required 

- 8+ years of experience in data engineering, with strong experience in data architecture, ETL, and database management. 

- Strong programming skills in Python or PySpark, plus experience with Java or Scala. 

- Experience building complex end-to-end data pipelines and data integration solutions. 

- Strong knowledge of SQL and experience with relational and NoSQL database technologies. 

- Experience with big data technologies such as Spark, Kafka, Hadoop, or similar platforms. 

- Experience with orchestration and scheduling tools such as Airflow, Databricks, Jenkins, or similar technologies. 

- Experience designing and operating scalable, reliable, and secure data systems. 

- Familiarity with cloud platforms such as AWS, Azure, or GCP and associated data services. 

- Experience working in Agile environments such as Scrum, Lean, or Kanban. 

- Strong problem-solving and decision-making skills. 

- Experience mentoring junior engineers and contributing to technical leadership within a team. 

- Strong written and verbal communication skills with the ability to work effectively across technical and non-technical teams. 

Nice to Have 

- Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Computer Science, Data Science, or a related field.

- Databricks experience or certification.

- Experience with AWS Redshift, S3, Azure SQL Data Warehouse, or comparable cloud data services.

- Experience implementing data governance, data quality, or observability frameworks.

- Experience leading cross-functional or multi-month engineering initiatives.

- Experience using AI-assisted engineering tools to improve development, troubleshooting, documentation, or productivity.

Our AI Mindset 

We build with AI. We lead with judgment. 

AI isn't a feature here. It's how we work. 

We're excited about what AI makes possible, and we're looking for people who share that curiosity. You don't need to be an expert. You need to be open to experimenting , willing to learn, and able to apply new tools in ways that actually move the needle. 

In this role, you'll be encouraged to explore AI tools, find practical use cases for your function, and bring ideas for working smarter. We believe the best outcomes come when human judgment and AI capability work together.

title: Senior Mobile Developer
description:
About Ping Identity : 

At Ping Identity, we believe in making digital experiences both secure and seamless for all users, without compromise. We call this digital freedom. And it's not just something we provide our customers. It's something that inspires our company. People don't come here to join a culture that's built on digital freedom. They come to cultivate it. 

Our intelligent, cloud identity platform lets people shop, work, bank, and interact wherever and however they want. Without friction. Without fear. 

While protecting digital identities is at the core of our technology, protecting individual identities is at the core of our culture. We champion every identity. One of our core values, Respect Individuality, reminds us to celebrate differences so you are empowered to bring your authentic self to work. 

We're headquartered in Denver, Colorado and we have offices and employees around the globe. We serve the largest, most demanding enterprises worldwide, including more than half of the Fortune 100. At Ping Identity, we're changing the way people and businesses think about cybersecurity, digital experiences, and identity and access management. 

Senior Mobile Engineer - iOS

We’re looking for a Senior Mobile Engineer - iOS to help build the next generation of Ping Identity products. You’ll partner with product, design, backend, QA, and other engineering teams from planning through release, shaping reliable, intuitive mobile experiences used in demanding enterprise environments.

We value engineers who combine deep technical judgment with curiosity and initiative. You’ll use modern development practices—including AI-assisted tools, coding agents, and reusable skills where they add value—to explore solutions, accelerate routine work, and improve quality. You’ll remain accountable for the results: understanding generated changes, validating them, and ensuring that code is secure, maintainable, accessible, and ready for production.

What you’ll do

- Design, build, test, and maintain high-quality iOS applications and SDKs using Swift, Xcode, and Apple’s platform frameworks.

- Shape robust mobile architecture and make sound decisions about object-oriented design, design patterns, concurrency, threading, and lifecycle management.

- Create polished interfaces and interactions using UIKit and SwiftUI, including custom UI components and animations.

- Work closely with cross-functional partners throughout discovery, implementation, acceptance testing, and release.

- Use AI-enabled development tools thoughtfully—for example, to explore code, generate or refine tests, investigate unfamiliar areas, and automate repetitive tasks—while reviewing outputs critically and verifying behavior.

- Contribute to engineering practices that make AI-assisted work dependable, including clear context and instructions, focused changes, automated checks, and appropriate human review, all as part of our SDLC.

- Protect customer trust by considering security, privacy, performance, reliability, and compatibility across supported iOS versions and devices.

- Share knowledge, provide constructive feedback, and help raise the technical bar across the team.

What you’ll bring

- A B.Sc. in Computer Science, Software Engineering, or relevant military training.

- At least 7 years of application development experience, including substantial hands-on iOS development with Swift and Xcode.

- Strong experience in mobile system design, object-oriented design, design patterns, multithreading, and application architecture.

- Deep understanding of iOS frameworks, view and application lifecycles, object lifetimes, and concurrency.

- Strong UI engineering skills with UIKit and SwiftUI, including the ability to build custom components and animations.

- Experience integrating with HTTP, JSON, and RESTful web services.

- Working knowledge of Objective-C and the ability to work with codebases that include it.

- Familiarity with differences across iOS versions and devices, and the ability to build resilient experiences across them.

- A self-directed approach: you can work independently, identify what needs attention, and communicate early when alignment or support is needed.

- Clear written and spoken English, strong interpersonal skills, and a collaborative mindset.

- Curiosity about AI-assisted software development, sound judgment about where it helps, and a commitment to validating code and tests regardless of how they were produced.

Bonus points if you have

- Experience with Git and collaborative code review.

- Experience developing SDKs or reusable mobile components.

- Experience with Android development or cross-platform mobile work.

- Experience building security-sensitive applications or working with identity and authentication.

- Practical experience creating or using coding-agent workflows, reusable agent skills, or other AI-enabled engineering tools.

title: Forward Deployed Engineer, Applied AI
description:
Join SE3 Labs as Forward Deployed Engineer, Applied AI 

Help bring applied AI into the real world by building Python and LLM-powered solutions for defence customers, owning client relationships and turning real operational needs into software that works.

About SE3 

SE3 Labs builds spatial intelligence and autonomy software for unmanned systems. We combine 3D computer vision, state estimation and AI to help autonomous platforms perceive their surroundings, know where they are and operate when GPS and other sensors become unreliable. Defence is a core application of our work today.

We are growing to a team of 100+ people. Join at a stage where you can shape our Forward Deployed team, help build the team and grow your responsibilities as the company expands.

Our founding team’s research has received more than 90,000 citations. You will work closely with technical founders and engineers with deep experience in computer vision and autonomous systems, turning that research depth into systems that work in the field.

About the Role 

As a Forward Deployed Applied AI Engineer at SE3 Labs, you’ll work at the intersection of software engineering, applied AI and customer delivery. title: Senior Backend Engineer
description:
About Us 

Tebi is creating the first Connected Restaurant Management System that makes hospitality flow. In one seamless platform, Tebi embeds sales, reservations, kitchen prep, payments, and all the data that powers it, creating smooth service and intuitive insights.

Founded by Arnout Schuijff, co-founder of Adyen, and backed by €50 million in funding from Index Ventures & CapitalG, Tebi is built in service of hospitality first. Thousands of restaurants, cafés, bars, and coffee shops across the Netherlands, UK, Italy, Spain, Germany, Denmark and Finland already love running on Tebi.

About the role: 

We’re looking for a Senior Backend Engineer to help us build powerful, delightful features that empower restaurant teams. You’ll work across the stack to bring new ideas to life, whether it’s building intuitive interfaces, scalable backend services, or the glue in between that makes everything feel seamless.

You’ll collaborate closely with design, product, and other engineers to rapidly ship impactful features. As an early team member, you’ll also help shape our engineering culture, tooling, and technical direction.

This role is perfect for someone who thrives in fast-paced environments, loves solving real user problems, and wants to help modernize an underserved industry with thoughtful, elegant software.

Responsibilities: 

- Build, test, and ship end-to-end features across the stack—from APIs and data models.

- Collaborate with designers and PMs to translate user needs into working, intuitive product experiences

- Own projects from concept to launch and beyond, balancing speed, quality, and scalability

- Improve system performance and reliability across frontend and backend systems

- Help evolve our codebase and technical architecture as we scale

- Contribute to shared tooling, component libraries, and best practices that level up the whole team

What you’ll need: 

- 8+ years of professional experience as a fullstack or backend engineer in a product-focused environment

- Deep expertise in either Kotlin, Java, or Scala.

- Significant experience with distributed systems. You know how to build and maintain scalable, resilient services that work together.

- Experience with event-driven architectures (e.g., Kafka).

- Good experience of relational databases, such as Postgres.

- Comfortable working with APIs, relational databases, and docker

- A product mindset, you care about the why behind what you’re building and optimizing for user impact

- Ability to work collaboratively across functions and communicate clearly with both technical and non-technical stakeholders

- Strong attention to detail and a sense of pride in crafting great user experiences

What is Restaurant Software? 

Restaurants and other merchants use various software systems such as Point of Sale (POS), Reservations, Kitchen Display Systems (KDS), Payments, Inventory, Staffing, and the list goes on. These systems all need to speak to each other which they frequently don’t. It’s a mess, and we are fixing it.

From buying a croissant at a cafe to having dinner with friends, it’s a €4 Trillion+ global market and a critical part of everyday life in today's economy.

How we use AI at Tebi 

We use AI the way our merchants use Tebi, to cut out the friction and get to what matters faster. We believe in a world where AI increases quality, efficiency and speed.

At Tebi, AI isn't a policy or a checkbox, it's just part of how we work. It helps us write, analyse, build, and improve but doesn’t make the last call. If there's a smarter way to do something, we want to find it.

title: Staff Forward Deployed Engineer
description:
TL;DR – We’re looking for an experienced, Staff Forward Deployed Engineer to help build the future of AI-powered software creation. You will be a founding member of our FDE function, working directly with our customers to translate ambitious ideas into real products. This is a hands-on software engineering role: you will design, write, and ship production code. It’s a unique opportunity to scale a new discipline from scratch and solve problems with AI that no one has solved before.

Why Lovable? 

Lovable is the software creation platform that gives people the power to act on the problems closest to them. For decades, turning an idea into software required so much capital, technical fluency, and time that many ideas never came to life. Lovable is the counterargument: a platform for all people with ideas, ambition, and problems worth solving. From solopreneurs to small business owners to teams at companies like Adidas and Zendesk, people have built over 60 million projects on Lovable since its launch in November 2024. And we’re just getting started.

We’re building a generational company from Stockholm, with growing teams in London, Boston, New York, and San Francisco. Our team is small, talent-dense, and moving quickly, with a culture rooted in extreme ownership, high velocity, and low-ego collaboration. We look for people who care deeply, ship fast, and are eager to make a dent in the world.

Lovable is one of TIME’s 100 Most Influential Companies and has been recognized on the Forbes AI 50 and CNBC Disruptor 50, reflecting our momentum as one of Europe’s fastest-growing AI companies and one of the most ambitious places to build in this next era of software.

About the role 

Most engineering roles place you either close to the product or close to the customer. This role gives you both.

You’ll build alongside customers at the frontier of what Lovable can do, solving technically difficult problems across our frontend, backend and AI systems. The goal isn’t simply to make individual deployments successful: it’s to identify what should become part of the Lovable platform and then build it.

As one of our first Forward Deployed Engineers, you’ll also help define the function - from its engineering standards and ways of working to how it collaborates with customers and our core product teams.

If you want to stay deeply hands-on while shaping a product, a team and a new engineering discipline, this is that role. As you’ll be working directly with customers, travel up to 50% could be required depending on needs.

What we’re looking for 

- 8+ years of hands-on experience building and shipping production software

- Extensive software engineering skills across the application stack with a track record of writing maintainable, well-tested code and owning what you build in production

- Strong architectural thinking and familiarity with distributed systems

- Ability to prototype rapidly and turn successful experiments into production-quality solutions

- Exceptional product intuition and ability to work directly with users

- Comfort operating with high ambiguity, agency, and end-to-end ownership

Bonus if you’ve: 

- Worked on agentic AI systems or built with LLMs before

- Led zero-to-one product development

- Worked in a founding or early startup environment

What you’ll do 

- Work directly with customers to understand their workflows, needs, and problems

- Turn ambiguous requirements into clear technical designs and working production systems

- Design, code, test, deploy, and operate solutions across Lovable’s frontend and backend

- Translate insights from real usage into foundational platform improvements

- Own projects end-to-end—from discovery and architecture through shipping and iteration

- Debug complex issues across application, infrastructure, and AI-system boundaries

- Shape how Forward Deployed Engineering operates at Lovable, including its engineering standards, rituals, and playbooks

- Contribute to core product strategy, technical decisions, and cultural foundations

Our Tech Stack 

- Backend: Golang & Rust

- Frontend: React, Typescript

- Cloud: Cloudflare, GCP, AWS, multiple LLM providers

- Tooling: Github Actions, OTEL, Grafana, Terraform, and more

How we hire 

- Fill out a short form and hop on a brief intro call with our recruiting team.

- Complete a quick live coding exercise.

- Show us how you approach problems during several technical interviews.

- Show us something you’ve built that makes you proud.

About your application 

- Please submit your application in English - it’s our company language

- We treat all candidates equally - if you’re interested please apply through our careers portal.

title: Autonomy Engineer Intern, Reinforcement Learning, 2027 (Zurich)
description:
Skydio is the leading US drone company and the world leader in autonomous flight, the key technology for the future of drones and aerial mobility. The Skydio team combines deep expertise in artificial intelligence, best-in-class hardware and software product development, operational excellence, and customer obsession to empower a broader, more diverse audience of drone users, from utility inspectors to first responders , soldiers in battlefield scenarios , and beyond .

About the role: 

Skydio builds the world’s most advanced autonomous drones used across inspection, public safety, defense, cinematography, and more. Your research won’t languish in a paper: it will fly , shaping how pilots and operators complete real missions in complex environments. Develop and deploy reinforcement learning (and adjacent policy-learning methods) that make Skydio aircraft plan, navigate, and control themselves more intelligently, safely, reliably, and efficiently across our ecosystem: handheld apps, ground control, cloud autonomy services, and fleet workflows.

How you'll make an impact: 

- Navigation & avoidance in the wild: Train policies that adapt online to cluttered 3D scenes (forests, bridges, urban canyons), complementing our stack for robust obstacle avoidance and dynamic goal-seeking.

- RL-augmented planning: Fuse learned cost shaping / value functions with trajectory optimization for smooth, agile flight with tight safety envelopes and mission constraints.

- Sim to Real at scale: Build scalable datasets and training loops with Isaac Lab, domain randomization, residual learning, and safety filters; validate on real drones weekly.

- Human-in-the-loop shared control: Learn assistive policies that blend pilot intent, autonomy priors, and uncertainty-aware behaviors for intuitive control handoffs.

- Fleet & multi-agent: Explore decentralized coordination for coverage, pursuit, and collaborative mapping with minimal comms.

What makes this internship different: 

- Real hardware cadence: Prototype in sim, then flight test on production-ready aircraft and edge compute. Your work is meant to make a difference in the real world, not just in simulation.

- Safety-first learning: We pair RL with formal constraints, estimation of uncertainty, and conservative action filters for dependable deployment in human environments.

- Cross-disciplinary mentorship: Collaborate with perception, mapping, controls, and product teams to close the loop from research to field ops.

What makes you a strong fit: 

- PhD student in Robotics, Machine Learning, Controls, or related field.

- Strong fundamentals in RL , control theory, and motion planning; comfort with safety/robustness concepts.

- Proficient in Python (PyTorch/JAX/Ray RLlib) and at least one of C++ or CUDA.

- Hands-on experience with robotics simulation (Isaac Lab/MuJoCo/PyBullet) and sim2real techniques.

- Experience training/deploying policies for navigation, manipulation, or locomotion on real robots or autonomous vehicles.

Nice-to-Haves: 

- Publications (CoRL, ICRA, IROS, RSS, NeurIPS).

- Experience with onboard inference optimization (TensorRT, quantization, sparsity).

- Familiarity with modern policy learning beyond vanilla RL: diffusion policies, IL/BC, offline RL, model-based RL.

- Experience with multi-agent RL or distributed training.

Compensation: The hourly rate for this position is $47/hr for Undergrad, $53/hr for Masters, and $70/hr for PhD students*. Compensation will vary based on factors, including skill level, proficiencies, transferable knowledge, and experience. In addition to base salary, Skydio full-time employees are eligible to enroll in our benefit plans and take advantage of a variety of incentives and stipends.

title: Senior Software Engineer (YDB Team)
description:
About Nebius : 

Nebius is leading a new era in cloud infrastructure for the global AI economy. We are building a full-stack AI cloud platform that supports developers and enterprises from data and model training through to production deployment, without the cost and complexity of building large in-house AI/ML infrastructure.

Built by engineers, for engineers. From large-scale GPU orchestration to inference optimization, we own the hard problems across compute, storage, networking and applied AI.

Listed on Nasdaq (NBIS) and headquartered in Amsterdam, we have a global footprint with R&D hubs across Europe, the UK, North America and Israel. Our team of 1,500+ includes hundreds of engineers with deep expertise across hardware, software and AI R&D.

The role

The YDB Development Team at Nebius is hiring mid- and senior-level software developers with C++ expertise.

YDB is an open-source platform with two roles within Nebius: 

- Providing the binary object storage foundation for S3 Object Storage, Shared Filesystems and Network Block Storage

- Serving as a distributed relational database and message broker for services such as IAM, billing, audit trails and logging

We operate YDB clusters in more than 10 regions using HDD and NVMe storage. Individual clusters span tens of thousands of nodes, manage hundreds of petabytes of data and deliver terabytes per second of throughput. Our infrastructure includes x86 and Arm-based systems, including NVIDIA GB300 nodes.

What you’ll work on 

- Evolve YDB’s architecture for new hardware, redesigning core components when incremental optimization is insufficient:

- QLC NVMe drives: increase storage density while controlling RAM/CPU consumption and write amplification

- Dual 800 Gb/s network adapters: reduce CPU overhead and memory bandwidth consumption to utilize the available NIC bandwidth

- NVIDIA GB300-based systems: ensure efficient operation on Arm-based hosts and offload storage and networking processing to BlueField DPUs

- Support high-capacity SMR HDDs by designing data placement, sequential writes, garbage collection and recovery around zoned-write constraints

- Develop wide erasure-coding schemes to reduce space aplimfication while maintaining durability and availability

- Reduce recovery and rebalancing times after device outages while limiting the impact on foreground workloads

- Prevent, detect and recover from silent data corruption across memory, networking and storage

- Provide the system capabilities and interfaces required by fleet-wide automation so that hundreds of production clusters can be deployed, configured, upgraded, diagnosed and operated consistently

We move quickly and focus on delivering practical value. Features and optimizations merged into the production branch are typically deployed within weeks. You’ll see your work solving real problems in live clusters—not waiting years to make an impact.

Requirements: 

- 5+ years of professional experience developing high-load systems in C or C++. Candidates with 3+ years will also be considered if their experience includes relevant work on distributed storage systems

- Experience developing high-performance, low-latency software components

- Understanding of core dumps, flame graphs and sanitizer-enabled builds

- Understanding of CPU caches, atomic operations and NUMA architectures

Nice to have: 

- Experience designing and developing production-grade distributed storage systems and/or databases

- Experience with on-disk data structures such as LSM trees and B+ trees, and storage algorithms such as erasure coding and checksumming

- Understanding of NVMe, conventional HDD and SMR HDD internals

- Experience with debugging and profiling tools such as perf, VTune, bpftrace and gdb

- Familiarity with the Linux kernel, SPDK/DPDK, libaio and io_uring

- Knowledge of IP, TCP, UDP and DNS, and ideally InfiniBand or RoCE/RDMA

- Experience with Kubernetes and Grafana

- Experience responding to production incidents

- Knowledge of availability and durability calculations

For Senior candidates , we offer hybrid working or the flexibility to work remotely within EU.

Benefits & Perks: 

- Competitive compensation

- Career growth and learning opportunities

- Flexibility and ownership

- Collaborative and innovative culture

- Opportunity to work on impactful AI projects

- International environment and talented teams

What's it like to work at Nebius: 

Fast moving - Bold thinking - Constant growth - Meaningful impact - Trust and real ownership - Opportunity to shape the future of AI
