title: Senior Manager, Technology Risk Assurance
description:
About Airwallex 

Airwallex is the AI-native financial operating system for a real-time, intelligent economy. More than 675,000 businesses, including McLaren Racing, Qantas, SHEIN, and TikTok, use us, directly or through our platform partners, to run their financial operations or build and monetize financial products of their own.

We started in Melbourne in 2015 to build the infrastructure global commerce runs on. We're the regulated backbone behind global payments: not by accident, but by design. A decade plus, 85+ licenses, and a financial infrastructure spanning North America, Europe, the Middle East, and Asia-Pacific.

We're co-headquartered in San Francisco and Singapore, with more than 2,700 people across 27 offices. We hire builders with founder-level energy, people who move fast with good judgment, dig in with real curiosity, and make calls from first principles rather than waiting to be told what to do. Read our operating principles to see it in full.

How you'll make impact

You’ll build and scale a practical Second Line of Defence technology risk assurance function for a fast-growing, regulated fintech.

- Recruit, mentor, and lead a lean, high-performing team of technology risk engineers and assurance specialists, fostering technical depth, code-first assurance, and cross-functional agility.

- Lead second-line assurance across ITGCs and IT application controls, cloud infrastructure and database management, CI/CD and change enablement, IAM and privileged access, API and automated data pipeline integrity, and business continuity and disaster recovery.

- Build an automation-first assurance engine using AI agents, automated workflows, and custom Python and SQL scripts for continuous control testing, evidence retrieval, and remediation validation.

- Establish automated finding lifecycle and remediation governance, surfacing control failures to engineering leads and validating fixes without drawn-out re-audit cycles.

- Design and execute control frameworks for generative AI, LLMs, agentic workflows, machine learning models, and automated decision engines.

- Partner with external auditors and global regulators to defend autonomous testing scripts and AI-agent methodologies, ensuring automated evidence is trusted and relied upon.

- Translate complex technology risk into clear recommendations for engineers, senior executives, and board-level risk committees, drawing on frameworks and expectations including NIST, ISO 27001, SOC 1, SOC 2, DORA, MAS TRM, FCA, HKMA, ASIC, and FinCEN.

You’ll work from our Amsterdam or London office three days a week.

What we're looking for

Essentials 

- 8+ years of progressive experience in technology risk, IT audit, information security assurance, or technology compliance, including proven experience in a Second Line of Defence risk assurance capacity.

- Big Four background.

- Experience building and testing risk controls.

- A track record of recruiting, mentoring, and leading high-performing technical risk or assurance teams.

- Deep practical expertise in ITGCs, IT application controls, automated business controls, and SOX compliance within complex distributed architectures.

- Hands-on experience assessing cloud risks across AWS or GCP, particularly IAM, privileged access and segregation of duties, Firefighter workflows, CI/CD pipelines, database controls, and modern API security.

- Practical ability to write and use SQL, Python, or API scripts to query databases, automate evidence extraction, and reduce manual sampling.

- Strong conceptual and practical understanding of risks and controls around AI/ML systems, LLMs, and automated decision engines, including data drift, access guardrails, and model integrity.

- Proven ability to constructively challenge First Line engineering leads while maintaining the credibility to defend automated testing methodologies to external auditors and regulatory examiners.

- Solid working knowledge of industry control frameworks such as SOC 1/2, ISO 27001, and NIST CSF.

Preferred 

- Direct experience building or deploying AI agents, LLM-driven audit assistants, or automated compliance and testing pipelines.

- Fintech experience, particularly within a high-growth fintech, payments platform, digital bank, or cloud-native technology company.

- People management experience.

- Familiarity with international financial technology regulations and expectations, including MAS TRM, FCA, HKMA, DORA, ASIC, and FinCEN.

- Experience integrating GRC platforms, BI dashboards such as Tableau or Looker, and continuous compliance monitoring tools.

- Relevant certifications such as CISA, CISSP, CRISC, CISM, or AWS/GCP certifications.

You'll thrive here if

- You’re comfortable owning the roadmap yourself.

- You own the outcome and you don't wait for permission to fix what's broken.

- You're comfortable with ambiguity. Give you a problem, not a prescription, and you'll run with it.

- You say what you mean. You're direct, but you lead with respect.

- You simplify complexity rather than hiding behind it.

Learn more about your team

Risk is part of Regulatory & Compliance at Airwallex.

Regulatory & Compliance is where we build the trust, discipline, and operational resilience required to scale a generational financial platform.

As Airwallex grows across 30+ markets, this team turns regulatory complexity into strategic control. You'll lead compliance, enterprise risk, and regulatory engagement in a way that protects the business while letting it move with conviction. Our ambition goes beyond meeting expectations: we're building a risk posture that acts as a competitive moat, grounded in ownership, proactive regulatory partnerships, and frameworks that scale globally while respecting local nuance.

It's a team for strategic operators with sharp judgment, high standards, and the confidence to execute at pace in a high-stakes environment. You'll thrive here if you can balance rigor with progress and influence across functions.

If you want to architect the benchmark for trust and resilience in global finance, your work here will have a massive impact.

Applicant Safety Policy: Fraud and Third-Party Recruiters 

To protect you from recruitment scams, please be aware that Airwallex will not ask for bank details, sensitive ID numbers (i.e. passport), or any form of payment during the application or interview process. All official communication will come from an @ airwallex.com email address. Please apply only through careers.airwallex.com or our official LinkedIn page. 

Airwallex does not accept unsolicited resumes from search firms/recruiters. Airwallex will not pay any fees to search firms/recruiters if a candidate is submitted by a search firm/recruiter unless an agreement has been entered into with respect to specific open position(s). Search firms/recruiters submitting resumes to Airwallex on an unsolicited basis shall be deemed to accept this condition, regardless of any other provision to the contrary. 

Equal opportunity 

Airwallex is proud to be an equal opportunity employer. We value diversity and anyone seeking employment at Airwallex is considered based on merit, qualifications, competence and talent. We don’t regard color, religion, race, national origin, sexual orientation, ancestry, citizenship, sex, marital or family status, disability, gender, or any other legally protected status when making our hiring decisions. If you have a disability or special need that requires accommodation, please let us know.

title: IT Engineer
description:
Health can’t wait . 

Not for symptoms to get worse. Not for a six‑month appointment. Not for a system to catch up. But that’s exactly how healthcare works today. You wait, until you can’t.

Alan exists to end the wait.

Health is a universal right, and we believe this right can only become real when it’s coupled with prevention. We need to stop treating health as something we repair and start treating it as something we build, every day. It’s not solely a question of willpower. It’s the healthcare system itself that needs to work for everyone, in a sustainable way.

So we are building the new standard in prevention insurance. Alan is the first company that integrates insurance, prevention, and care into a single, acclaimed user experience.

We are on an incredible journey to build a global leading company, with a unique culture . We already partner with 40K+ companies of all sizes, serving more than 1M+ members, and have reached €800M+ in ARR.

Prevention as the new norm. That's what we're building with our team of 1000+ people. If it speaks to you: we're hiring across France, Spain, Belgium, and Canada. And beyond.

Mission 

Alan is scaling internationally (800+ employees, 100+ healthcare professionals, 5+ countries) and needs IT Engineers to build and own the internal technology platform every Alaner works on: identity and provisioning, endpoint and SaaS security, the tooling behind our clinics, and the automation that keeps IT from scaling linearly with headcount.

The scope below is what the team owns, not a checklist for one person. You'll be staffed on one or two of these areas at a time, according to your strengths and interests, and it will evolve through time based on company needs and personal appetite.

Staying close to users keeps us building the right things: you'll spend up to one day a week on IT support, seeing first-hand where friction lives and what's worth automating next.

Scope 

⚙️ Platform & automation 

- Own and extend automations on Alan Home, our internal provisioning engine

- Maintain, extend and improve helpdesk automation, SaaS provisioning flows, and onboarding/offboarding pipelines

- Own the meeting room AV and room-booking platform as a product, replicable across offices

🔑 Identity & access 

- Own the IT side of the employee lifecycle (onboarding, offboarding, mobility between jobs and countries) across Google Workspace, SSO/SAML and our SaaS ecosystem.

- Grow our role-based access model: extend it to more tools and refine the permission groups, so access is granted by role rather than case by case

- Make employee lifecycle events reliable, fast and auditable end-to-end

- Own access reviews and least-privilege models; produce and maintain the evidence our auditors rely on

- Own SaaS procurement and license management: vendor relationships, renewals, and cost optimization across our stack

🔒 Endpoint & SaaS security 

- Own the Mac fleet in Kandji: enrollment at scale, role-based blueprints, fleet compliance

- Cloudflare WARP, SaaS security controls

- Maintain and strengthen our ISO 27001 certification and drive ACPR and pentest remediation on the endpoint and platform scope

🩺 Health Professionals IT 

- The IT layer behind Alan's clinics: practitioner tooling, equipment, access

- Role and permission automation for healthcare professionals, and their support and escalation process

🌍 Internationalisation 

- Make international expansion something IT accelerates, not something it slows down: a repeatable process where every new market (Canada, KSA, Armenia...) launches on our standard stack from day one

- Bring acquired entities onto that same platform

Milestones 

First 3 months 

- Acquire technical knowledge on Alan's platform: Alan Home, Google Workspace/SSO, Kandji, Cloudflare WARP

- Take one project end-to-end and ship a first increment

- Join the IT oncall team as technical escalation

First 6 months 

- Own a workstream end-to-end

- Deliver one automation or hardening initiative end-to-end

- Take up documentation and automation on your scope and reduce significantly the bus factor on it

- Mentor IT teammates on your core expertise

First year 

- Deliver measurable IT toil reduction on your scope

- Set the technical standards on your domain: how we build, document and review it

- Build strong cross-functional partnerships (Engineering, Security, Workplace, Clinic, People, Audit)

- Contribute to hiring and onboarding new teammates

3 years 

- Lead major projects end-to-end across several communities

- Be the reference the team relies on across at least two domains

- Mentor the IT team and beyond, and scale IT without a linear increase in manual work

As the community grows, there is room to take on more responsibility: leading a crew, owning cross-community projects, mentoring, hiring.

What we're looking for 

Must-have - Technical/hard skills: 

- 3+ years in IT engineering, platform, systems or corporate engineering , with real ownership of production-facing systems

- Depth in at least one area (platform & automation, identity, endpoint & security) and demonstrated range beyond it. 

- You write code: not as a full-time software engineer, but Python, APIs and pull requests in a shared repo should feel normal

- Structured problem-solving: diagnoses methodically, asks the right clarifying questions, thinks about failure modes and rollback

- Comfort with regulated environments: health data, ACPR, ISO 27001, HDS

- Automation & AI appetite : uses AI tools smartly to accelerate their own delivery, with an instinct for what should be automated or delegated to AI rather than repeated

Must-have - Behavioral / soft skills: 

- Ownership & autonomy: drives topics forward without hand-holding, including when they cross into someone else's perimeter

- Written communication: Alan is written-first; decisions get argued in public documents and challenged by people outside your team

- Pragmatic judgment: balances "perfect" vs. "good enough", decides with incomplete information

- Documentation culture: reduces bus factor through clear documentation and knowledge sharing

Nice-to-have skills / Bonus points if you have: 

- Experience with an internal provisioning or IdP-driven automation platform

- Kandji or another MDM at scale

- Cloudflare Zero Trust / WARP, Datadog

- Audit remediation experience (ISO 27001, HDS)

- Multi-country rollouts, or IT integration after an acquisition

- Having mentored, coached or led a (small) crew

- Health or healthtech ecosystem familiarity

Languages: Fluent English & Professional French

Compensation: €53K – €70K • €26K – €67K Equity

title: Stage Data Consultant - Paris - H/F/X
description:
Qui sommes-nous ? 

Artefact est une société de conseil et d'ingénierie française spécialisée en data et IA, et leader en Europe, qui depuis plus de 10 ans est spécialisée dans la conception et le déploiement de technologies d’intelligence artificielle et de solutions data-driven. Basé à Paris, nous sommes aujourd’hui présents dans 27 pays sur tous les continents et comptons 2500 collaborateurs. 

Notre mission est d’aider les entreprises à exploiter tout le potentiel de l’IA et de la data en développant des solutions sur-mesure adaptées à leurs enjeux métiers. En tant que pionniers dans ce domaine, nous allions expertise technologique et excellence opérationnelle, en collaborant avec les plus grands acteurs du marché. Nos clients couvrent tous les secteurs clés de l’économie – industrie, retail, luxe, grande consommation, santé, finance – et incluent des grands groupes internationaux. 

En tant que Stagiaire Data Consultant , tu seras pleinement intégré(e) à une équipe de consultants. Ton rôle sera d'assister nos clients dans l'élaboration et la mise en œuvre de leur stratégie data, de la phase d'idéation jusqu'à l'implémentation. Tes missions pourront inclure :

- Cadrage / gestion des projets : interview clients et partenaires, mise en place de workshops, préparation des uses cases…

- Construction de roadmaps, d’analyses data-driven avec l’équipe projet et conception d'infrastructures en collaboration avec nos experts 

- Orchestration du bon déroulement du projet, en appliquant le cas échéant les méthodes agiles (sprints planning et reviews, backlog refinement, démos…) 

- Veille technologique et sectorielle : rester à l'affût des dernières tendances en matière de data et d'intelligence artificielle pour proposer des solutions innovantes.

- Communication : Préparer des présentations et des supports de communication pour les comités de direction et les équipes clientes.

Processus de recrutement 

Étape 1 : Entretien RH avec notre chargée de recrutement, Anouk. Le but de cet entretien est de faire votre connaissance, de nous parler de vos expériences professionnelles, vos envies et d'en savoir plus sur votre intérêt pour le conseil et Artefact (45 minutes)

Étape 2 : entretien de type business case avec un senior Data Consultant. Le but de cet entretien est de tester vos méthodes et capacités déductives, votre capacité à résoudre un problème et de confirmer votre intérêt pour Artefact (1 heure) 

Étape 3 : deuxième entretien de type business case avec un manager Data Consultant. Le but de cet entretien est de tester vos méthodes et capacités déductives, votre capacité à résoudre un problème et de confirmer votre intérêt pour Artefact (1 heure) 

Profil recherché 

- Formation : tu es étudiant(e) en dernière année de cycle ingénieur ou au sein d'une grand école de commerce avec une spécialisation en Data, Conseil, ou Management de l'Innovation et tu recherches ton stage de fin d'études à partir de Janvier 2027 

- Compétences : 

- Fort intérêt pour la Data Science et les technologies de la donnée. Tu n'es pas nécessairement un(e) expert(e) technique, mais tu comprends les concepts clés de l'IA, du machine learning, de la Business Intelligence, et du Big Data.

- Excellentes compétences analytiques et de synthèse.

- Maîtrise avancée de la suite Microsoft Office (en particulier PowerPoint et Excel).

- Une connaissance de SQL/Python ou d'un outil de visualisation de données (Power BI, Tableau) est un plus.

- Qualités personnelles : 

- Sens de la communication et du relationnel : Tu es capable de t'exprimer clairement et de t'adapter à différents interlocuteurs.

- Proactivité et autonomie : Tu es force de proposition et prends des initiatives.

- Rigueur et organisation : Tu es capable de gérer plusieurs tâches et de respecter les délais.

- Français courant pour travailler en équipe et anglais professionnel obligatoire pour nos clients internationaux 

Ce que nous offrons 

- Un stage de 6 mois basé à Paris.

- Un environnement de travail stimulant au sein d'une équipe dynamique et experte.

- L'opportunité de travailler sur des projets concrets avec des entreprises de premier plan.

- La possibilité d'être embauché(e) en CDI à la fin du stage.

Si tu es passionné(e) par la data et que tu souhaites développer une double compétence en conseil et en technologie, envoie-nous ta candidature !

Chez Artefact, nous recrutons nos collaborateurs uniquement en fonction de nos besoins et des qualités propres de chaque candidat. Nous assurons le développement de leurs compétences professionnelles et de leurs responsabilités sans discrimination d’aucune sorte. Le groupe s'engage à reconnaître et promouvoir tous les talents, quels que soient leurs croyances, âge, handicap, parentalité, origine ethnique, nationalité, identité de genre, orientation sexuelle, appartenance à une organisation politique, religieuse, syndicale ou à une minorité, ou toute autre caractéristique qui pourrait faire l'objet d'une discrimination.

title: Senior Data Engineer
description:
About Orakl Oncology 

At Orakl Oncology, we are accelerating the development of oncology treatments. Today, fewer than 5% of new cancer drugs succeed in clinical trials. Clearly, new methods are needed. We combine cutting-edge biology and AI to build the next generation of insight platforms with the world’s largest cohort of patient tumor avatars. These avatars fuel our AI-powered predictive engine , helping to anticipate clinical trial outcomes, validate therapies, and uncover new drug candidates. By generating multimodal, real-world data, we deliver insights that consistently outperform existing solutions.

Our mission is simple yet ambitious: to bring more effective treatments to patients who need them and to make drug development smarter, faster, and more personalized. We collaborate with top hospitals, research institutes, and pharmaceutical companies worldwide. Backed by leading investors, we are a fast-growing, mission-driven startup at the intersection of science and technology.

The role 

We are looking for a curious engineering mind to lead the scaling of Orakl’s omics data within the Computational Biology team.

Every organoid grown in our lab is sequenced (WGS and RNA-seq). Our pipelines turn the raw reads into processed molecular profiles, and our models turn those profiles into clinical trial predictions, patient segments and new target candidates. Your mission will be to make omics data available to computational biologists and research engineers in a form they can build on. You will gather their needs and, in coordination with the Data & Infra team, design the data representations, storage layouts and access patterns that make model training and experimentation fast and reproducible. As our biobank expands, this will become a massive omics corpus that must efficiently serve client contracts, strategic partnerships and internal R&D projects.

Starting from processed omics data, you will assess how it is stored and served today, propose solutions to scale it, and drive their implementation, so our scientists and models can rely on it. You will build this hand in hand with our data engineering team, keeping our omics infrastructure consistent with the rest of the company’s stack. You will report to the Head of Computational Biology.

Experience with omics data is a strong plus, not a prerequisite. If you come from the conventional tabular data world and want to master data that is massive, multi-layered and regularly reprocessed, this role is built for you.

What you will do

- Design and build the omics data architecture. Together with our data engineering team, define and evolve how omics data is stored as the corpus grows: what lives in a database, what stays in columnar files on S3, and how it all fits the company’s stack.

- Guarantee reliable ingestion. Make sure every new batch of processed omics data (variant calls, expression, CNV, QC metrics, sample and sequencing tracking) lands reliably and consistently with our data model definition.

- Build and maintain the omics data model. Maintain a curated reference layer as the single source of truth, keep model-ready datasets derived from it separate, and track lineage between the two so every model input can be traced back to its source.

- Make the data easy to use. Build and evolve the access layer so scientists and models get what they need for client contracts, strategic partnerships and internal R&D, without writing joins or asking someone.

What you bring

Must-haves 

- 4+ years as a data engineer, with ingestion pipelines you built running in production.

- Master’s in Computer Science, Software Engineering, Data Engineering (or equivalent experience)

- Hands-on experience setting up and maintaining CI/CD for data pipelines and code libraries.

- Strong data modeling experience: you have designed schemas that handle evolving identifiers, versioning and lineage.

- Deep relational database expertise: schema design, partitioning, indexing, query plans, migrations on a live database.

- Deep cloud infrastructure skills: AWS (S3 and core services), infrastructure as code (Terraform or equivalent) and containers (Docker), with sound judgment on what belongs in a database and what stays in files.

- Strong experience in Python and SQL; comfortable with Git, CI and the command line.

- You can propose architecture choices, defend them and converge with engineering peers.

- A real drive to understand omics, including how our data is processed, so you can step in for our Senior Bioinformatician when they are away.

Nice-to-haves 

- Omics experience: you have loaded VCF/MAF files or expression matrices. Familiarity with Nextflow / nf-core pipelines.

- Columnar formats and engines (Parquet, Arrow, DuckDB) and an orchestrator (Dagster, Airflow, Prefect).

- Metabase or another BI layer on top of a relational database.

- LIMS or biobank sample-tracking integration.

- A tech-bio background, or prior work next to bioinformaticians.

What we offer 

- Mission: work in a cutting-edge environment, on the forefront of cancer research.

- Role: be the engineer behind the data backbone of a distinctive oncology discovery platform — designing, with our data engineering team, how one of the world’s rarest PDO multi-omics and functional datasets is stored, served and scaled, so that scientists and models can build on it every day.

- Impact: take ownership of a critical piece of an early-stage, fast-moving company, with the opportunity to shape it; your engineering decisions will carry through to our science and, ultimately, to patient outcomes.

- Team: join a collaborative, multidisciplinary team where you’ll work alongside stellar clinicians, biologists, and engineers towards a common mission.

Interview Process 

- Hiring Manager Call: Getting to know each other, aligning on expectations and context.

- Technical Deep Dive: A deep conversation on your experience with production data pipelines, data modeling, and scientific data processing.

- Technical Case: A system-design and problem-solving exercise representative of the real wet-lab data challenges you'll face at Orakl.

- Reference Call: A conversation with one or two people you've worked with closely.

- Founder Interview: A final discussion with our founders on vision, culture fit, and mutual ambitions.

title: Director, Category Growth (General Manager)
description:
Headquarters: Remote, USA

Help empower our global customers to connect to culture through their passions. 

Why you’ll love this role: 

StockX has redefined the global marketplace for culture — where buyers and sellers transact with confidence on an always-on digital exchange. We are building the next frontier of creator-driven, culturally rich commerce that blends excitement, community, expertise, and transaction in one platform.

To power this next chapter, we are building a category-led organization where each major vertical operates with clear ownership, accountability, and cultural authority.

The Director, Category Growth (General Manager) is the business owner of a major category vertical. This leader is accountable for the full P&L and long-term trajectory of their category — including supply growth, liquidity, demand activation, monetization, and marketplace health.

You will operate as a true GM: setting vision, defining strategy, allocating resources, building a team, and driving cross-functional execution. You will represent your vertical at the leadership level and ensure that product, marketing, operations, and partnerships are aligned to unlock sustainable growth.

This role is both entrepreneurial and executive — suited for a leader who wants to build and scale a culturally driven business within a high-impact marketplace.

What you’ll own: 

Full-Stack Category P&L 

- Own revenue, contribution margin, liquidity, and growth targets for your vertical

- Develop annual and multi-year business plans, forecasts, and investment cases

- Allocate resources across acquisition, retention, and engagement to maximize ROI

- Drive pricing, incentives, and promotional strategies aligned to marketplace health

Vertical Strategy & Market Leadership 

- Define the long-term category vision, positioning, and competitive differentiation

- Identify expansion opportunities across adjacent segments, geographies, and seller tiers

- Establish scalable supply acquisition and retention strategies

- Continuously assess competitive dynamics and evolving cultural trends

Supply, Demand & Liquidity Engine 

- Architect the playbook for acquiring, activating, and retaining high-value sellers and creators

- Ensure balanced marketplace dynamics between supply depth and demand velocity

- Partner with Growth and Marketing to stimulate demand moments and category engagement

- Implement structural improvements that increase conversion, retention, and monetization

Cross-Functional Executive Leadership 

- Influence Product roadmap to improve seller tooling, pricing mechanics, discovery, and trust features

- Partner with Marketing to launch culturally relevant campaigns and high-impact moments

- Collaborate with Operations to optimize onboarding, seller support, and fulfillment performance

- Represent your vertical in executive planning, QBRs, and strategic reviews

Team & Organizational Build-Out 

- Hire and develop Category Managers and supporting roles as the vertical scales

- Establish operating cadence, reporting frameworks, and performance management systems

- Build repeatable GTM playbooks that can be deployed across additional categories

- Foster a culture of accountability, experimentation, and community authenticity

Ecosystem & Community Stewardship 

- Act as the senior face of StockX within your category’s ecosystem

- Build relationships with top sellers, shops, creators, and community leaders

- Ensure platform growth remains culturally credible and aligned with community norms

About you: 

- 10+ years of experience in marketplace leadership, category general management, business development, or growth roles within consumer tech or two-sided platforms

- Demonstrated ownership of revenue or P&L-level outcomes

- Proven track record of scaling a vertical, marketplace segment, or new business line

- Strong executive presence and experience influencing cross-functional roadmaps

- Deep fluency in marketplace mechanics: liquidity, take rate, CAC/LTV, cohort behavior, supply elasticity

- Experienced people leader with a track record of building high-performing teams

- Deep connection to culture-driven or enthusiast categories

Why this role is different: 

This is not a traditional category marketing or merchandising role. This is a vertical GM role with real business ownership.

You will:

- Build and scale a culturally driven marketplace vertical from early-stage to maturity

- Directly influence product, pricing, and growth strategy

- Operate with executive visibility and measurable business accountability

- Create the blueprint for how category-led growth powers the future of StockX

title: Senior iOS Engineer
description:
Our mission at Oura is to empower every person to own their inner potential. Our award-winning products help our global community gain a deeper knowledge of their readiness, activity, and sleep quality by using their Oura Ring and its connected app. We've helped millions of people understand and improve their health by providing daily insights and practical steps to inspire healthy lifestyles.

Empowering the world starts with living our values and empowering our team. As a quickly growing company focused on helping people live healthier and happier lives, we ensure that our team members have what they need to do their best work — both in and out of the office. 

Our engineering organization consists of many talented Android and iOS app developers distributed across the EU and US. All app developers collaborate closely on each platform, regardless of location or specific feature squad. For day-to-day feature work, our engineers are organized into smaller cross-functional feature squads or teams. Our squads have a great deal of autonomy and are responsible for the development and architecture of their features. Squads take full ownership of their code and handle everything from concepting, design and implementation to release, maintenance and bug fixes.

We are looking for Senior iOS Engineers (minimum 5 years of experience) to join one of our app development teams. There are several roles available covering different feature areas, such as activity and movement, women’s health, or new member onboarding. This is a remote US position with a preference for candidates based in the US-Pacific timezone. We have offices in San Francisco and San Diego for those who prefer hybrid or office settings. Oura employees in other major cities (like Boston and New York) occasionally gather informally at local co-working locations.

What you will do: 

- Design, build, and maintain high quality code for projects on the team’s roadmap

- Push projects forward by closely aligning with PMs and Designers

- Collaborate with other teams such as backend, firmware, data science, research, science, or QA to deliver complex mobile app features

- Work with iOS colleagues across the US and EU, to improve the health of the iOS codebase

- Contribute to technical discussions, code reviews, and platform level improvements

Requirements 

We would love to have you on our team if you have:

- Minimum 5+ years of professional development experience shipping iOS apps

- Proficiency in Swift programming, UIKit, modern iOS app architectures (MVVM, MVC, TCA, VIPER, etc.) and common third-party libraries and frameworks

- Experience with collaborative development on complex shared codebases with proficiency in git, branching, and standard code review workflows

- Focus on quality through unit tests and manual testing

- Strong computer science fundamentals and design patterns

- Ability to take ownership of projects, design technical solutions, drive implementation, and deliver results with limited guidance

- Ability to mentor other engineers and increase developer productivity across teams

- Experience with Agile or Scrum processes

We also appreciate if you have:

- 7+ years of professional development experience shipping consumer iOS apps or enterprise apps and SDKs

- Previous experience in tech lead or team lead roles

- Experience with any of the following: Swift structured concurrency, Combine, SQLite/GRDB, SwiftUI, CoreAnimation, CoreGraphics, PyTorch, TypeScript, Kotlin Multiplatform, BLE, SDK development

- Experience with functional programming

- Experience with systems architecture and performance optimization

- Experience working asynchronously across countries and time zones

- Experience working with firmware teams on projects involving hardware

- Experience with app release management and CI/CD

- Experience developing software related to health, wellness, fitness, women’s health, or wearable products

- Special bonus points if you have experience with ML algorithms, encryption, data privacy or familiarity with C++

Benefits 

At Oura, we care about you and your well-being. Everyone here at Oura has a ring of their own and we are continually looking to improve employee health and add to our benefits!

What we offer:

- Competitive salary and equity packages

- Health, dental, vision insurance, and mental health resources

- An Oura Ring of your own plus employee discounts for friends & family

- 20 days of paid time off plus 13 paid holidays plus 8 days of flexible wellness time off

- Paid sick leave and parental leave

- Amazing culture of collaborative and passionate coworkers

Oura takes a market-based approach to pay, which may vary depending on your location. US locations are categorized into tiers based on a cost of labor index for that geographic area. While most offers will be closer to the starting range, successful candidates' pay will be determined based on job-related skills, experience, qualifications, work location, internal peer equity, and market conditions. These ranges may be modified in the future.

- Region 1 $162,000- $203,000

- Region 2 $150,000- $187,000

- Region 3 $139,000- $174,000

A recruiter can determine your zones/tiers based on your US location.

We are not considering candidates residing in the following states: Alaska (AK), Delaware (DE), Iowa (IA), Mississippi (MS), Missouri (MO), Nebraska (NE), South Dakota (SD), Vermont (VT), West Virginia (WV), and Wisconsin (WI)

Oura is proud to be an equal opportunity workplace. We celebrate diversity and are committed to creating an inclusive environment for all employees. Individuals seeking employment at Oura are considered without regard to age, ancestry, color, gender (including pregnancy, childbirth, or related medical conditions), gender identity or expression, genetic information, marital status, medical condition, mental or physical disability, national origin, protected family care or medical leave status, race, religion (including beliefs and practices or the absence thereof), sexual orientation, military or veteran status, or any other characteristic protected by federal, state, or local laws. We will not tolerate discrimination or harassment based on any of these characteristics.

We will work to ensure individuals with disabilities are provided reasonable accommodation to participate in the interview process, to perform essential job functions, and to receive other benefits and privileges of employment.

Stay cautious and protect your personal details.

title: Stage Software Engineer - Paris - H/F/X
description:
Qui sommes-nous ? 

Fondée en 2014, Artefact est une société internationale de services autour de l'IA et de la data, spécialisée dans le conseil en IA, transformation data et en data & digital marketing. L’approche unique d’Artefact, qui fait le pont entre la donnée et le business, permet à nos clients d’atteindre leurs objectifs business de façon dédiée et efficace. Nos 2500 collaborateurs répartis dans 27 bureaux à travers le monde allient leurs compétences pluridisciplinaires au profit de l’innovation business des entreprises. 

La mission des Artefactors ? Transformer la data de nos clients en impact business. Dans ce sens, nous collaborons avec plus de 1000 clients, leaders de leurs industries (Orange, Carrefour, Samsung, AccorHotels, L’Oréal, LVMH, Decathlon) et sommes partenaires privilégiés de Google (GMP/GCP), AWS ainsi que Microsoft Azure. 

En tant que stagiaire Software Engineer, tu seras ammener à: 

- Participer activement à la conception et à l'implémentation de solutions techniques robustes et scalables.

- Architecture logicielle : Contribuer à la réflexion sur l'architecture de nos applications, en veillant à la performance et à la maintenabilité du code

- Déploiement et opérations (DevOps) : automatisation des tests et des déploiements cloud avec des pipelines CI/CD et une infrastructure en tant que code (ex : Terraform), packaging d'applications dans des conteneurs (ex : Docker), implémentation d'outils d'observabilité des données (ex : DBT)

- Déploiement de ton logiciel sur le cloud : GCP, AWS ou Azure 

- Déploiement d’une ou plusieurs expertises techniques suivantes : développement logiciel, ingénierie analytique, ingénierie ML, architecture cloud ou ingénierie de sécurité et de fiabilité des sites

- Veille technologique : Explorer de nouvelles technologies et outils pour optimiser nos méthodes de travail.

Profil recherché 

- Formation : Tu es étudiant(e) en dernière année de cycle ingénieur, Master 2, ou équivalent, avec une spécialisation en sotware engineering, génie logiciel, informatique, ou développement web et tu recherches ton stage de fin d’études à partir de Janvier 2027

- Compétences techniques : 

- Maîtrise d'un ou plusieurs langages de programmation comme Python, Java, JavaScript (Node.js), Go ou Scala.

- Connaissance des principes de la programmation orientée objet et/ou de la programmation fonctionnelle.

- Expérience avec des bases de données SQL ou NoSQL.

- Une familiarité avec le Cloud (GCP, AWS, Azure) et les conteneurs (Docker, Kubernetes) est un atout.

- Connaissance des outils de versioning, en particulier Git .

- Qualités personnelles : 

- Curiosité et proactivité : Tu as envie d'apprendre et de proposer de nouvelles idées.

- Rigueur et souci du détail : Tu es soucieux(se) de produire un code propre et de qualité.

- Esprit d'équipe : Tu es capable de travailler en collaboration et d'échanger avec des profils variés (Data Scientists, Consultants, etc.)

- Français courant pour travailler en équipe et anglais professionnel obligatoire pour nos clients internationaux 

Le processus de recrutement : pour rejoindre Artefact, nous te proposons un processus de recrutement en quatre étapes durant lequel tu auras l’occasion de parler de ton expérience et d'en apprendre davantage sur Artefact et le poste d'ingénieur logiciel.

- Entretien RH

- Entretien #1 – Test de codage avec un Senior Software Engineer 

- Entretien #2 - Test d'architecture et de pipeline avec un Senior Software Engineer 

- Entretien #3 - Entretien de motivation avec un Manager ou Directeur du pôle Data Engineering 

Processus d'onboarding : 

L'intégration comprend une formation sur des compétences transversales critiques telles que la gestion du temps, la communication orale et écrite. Un counsellor te sera également attribué qui te guidera dans ta familiarisation avec la culture et les méthodes de travail de l'entreprise. De plus, tu auras l'opportunité de travailler sur des projets internes pour acquérir une expérience pratique et perfectionner tes compétences. De plus, tu auras la possibilité d'obtenir des certifications sur les fournisseurs cloud avant de travailler sur des missions clients. Ce processus d'intégration est conçu pour te doter des connaissances et des compétences nécessaires pour devenir un ingénieur logiciel performant chez Artefact.

Ce que nous offrons 

- Un stage de 6 mois basé à Paris .

- Un environnement de travail stimulant, où tu seras encouragé(e) à prendre des initiatives.

- Un accompagnement par un mentor expérimenté pour te faire progresser rapidement.

- L'opportunité de travailler sur des projets variés et complexes.

- La possibilité d'être embauché(e) en CDI à la fin du stage.

Prêt à rejoindre l'aventure ? 

Si tu te reconnais dans cette description et que tu souhaites mettre tes compétences au service de projets concrets et impactants, envoie-nous ta candidature !

Chez Artefact, nous recrutons nos collaborateurs uniquement en fonction de nos besoins et des qualités propres de chaque candidat. Nous assurons le développement de leurs compétences professionnelles et de leurs responsabilités sans discrimination d’aucune sorte. Le groupe s'engage à reconnaître et promouvoir tous les talents, quels que soient leurs croyances, âge, handicap, parentalité, origine ethnique, nationalité, identité de genre, orientation sexuelle, appartenance à une organisation politique, religieuse, syndicale ou à une minorité, ou toute autre caractéristique qui pourrait faire l'objet d'une discrimination.

title: Director, AI-Enabled Fraud Prevention & Investigations
description:
Headquarters: Remote - USA

Clover Health is investing in our fraud detection and investigation capabilities and is seeking a Director, AI-Enabled Fraud Prevention & Investigations to join our Legal department as a senior individual contributor. This hybrid role combines: (1) managing hands-on investigations of potential provider fraud with (2) building AI-powered tools and processes to make investigations more efficient and help catch potential future fraud earlier. You will develop and pilot new AI-enabled investigatory processes for Clover’s Medicare Advantage business, and own resulting investigations, in collaboration with Clover’s Special Investigations Unit (SIU) and other stakeholders.

This is a non-attorney role. You will work hand-in-hand with Clover’s lawyers and SIU to ensure that new investigatory processes you develop, and the resulting investigations, comply with Clover policies and regulatory requirements. Success in this role requires someone sharp, creative, and technically hands-on—someone who does not just use existing analytics tools but builds their own. That might mean writing a script to automate repetitive work, pulling apart a dataset when a standard report falls short, or working with an LLM until it produces something genuinely useful—all with the goal of finding smarter, more effective ways to investigate potential provider fraud.

As a Director, AI-Enabled Fraud Prevention & Investigations, you will: 

- Build Your Own Investigative Tooling: Use AI to write the queries, scripts, and prompts that turn millions of claim lines and/or medical record data into a prioritized list of leads. Prototype detection logic yourself rather than waiting on a roadmap, and hand off what works to data science and engineering to productionize. We expect you to be the person who builds v1.

- Investigate Potential Fraud End-to-End With AI in the Loop: Own a portfolio of fraud investigations sourced using the tooling you develop, in collaboration with Clover’s SIU. Develop investigative plans, gather and analyze evidence (including claims data and medical records), and reach well-supported conclusions. Use LLMs and analytics to compress the parts of an investigation that have always been slow — reading unstructured data, triaging grievance narratives, and sizing exposure. 

- Build Defensible Documentation: Develop case files and memos that are factually complete, well-organized, and prepared with the evidentiary and procedural standards necessary for downstream enforcement, recoveries, or provider actions.

- Collaborate Across Functions: Work with Clover's clinical, compliance, claims, payment integrity, provider relations, revenue operations, and SIU teams to gather information, validate findings, and translate investigative outcomes into operational improvements, provider education, and member impact.

- Communicate Findings Clearly: Prepare concise written reports and oral briefings that translate complex investigative facts into clear narratives for senior leadership and other stakeholders.

Success in this role looks like: 

- In your first 90 days , you have embedded yourself as a trusted partner to both the Legal department and Clover’s SIU. You have built working relationships with key stakeholders across Clover's clinical, compliance, claims, payment integrity, revenue operations, and legal teams, and you have begun working through your initial portfolio of fraud investigations and ad hoc referrals.

- By 6 months , you are independently managing a steady caseload of fraud investigations with consistently high-quality work product, in collaboration with SIU. You have a clear working rhythm with Legal and SIU, and you have built at least one working tool — a script, a notebook, a dashboard, a prompt.

- By 12 months , you have a track record of strong investigations, successful recoveries and/or referrals, and effective cross-functional collaboration. Senior leaders across Clover view you as a trusted person to call when they have a hunch that something doesn't look right and want it examined.

You should get in touch if: 

- Knowledge of healthcare fraud schemes & investigative experience: You have experience in healthcare fraud investigations, program integrity, or SIU operations, ideally within Medicare Advantage or managed care. You understand healthcare fraud schemes and know how to use claims data, medical records, and provider documentation to build a defensible factual record.

We're looking for a Principal Researcher to be a strategic research leader for EMEA, shaping what DoorDash builds next. You'll combine deep expertise in qualitative and quantitative methods to find the unmet needs, behavioral shifts, and market openings that point to new products and new growth. You'll work as a peer to senior product, design, engineering, data science, and business leaders, and your work will directly inform roadmaps, investment decisions, and company-level strategy.

This role is built for a seasoned researcher who is equally comfortable in a living room interview, a survey dataset, and a leadership review, and who uses AI as a daily tool to move faster and see further, without giving up the judgment that makes research trustworthy. You'll also raise the bar for the wider research practice by mentoring researchers, sharing methods, and helping the team define what great looks like in an AI-enabled era.

What You'll Be Doing

Shape Product Strategy: Translate deep understanding of Consumers, Merchants, and Couriers into a clear point of view on where DoorDash should play and win. You'll frame the highest-stakes questions, bring evidence to roadmap and investment debates, and influence decisions at the director and executive level.

Detect New Opportunities: Proactively identify emerging needs, behavior changes, and white space that point to new products, new verticals, and new growth levers. You'll size and validate opportunities with a mix of foundational discovery, market and competitive context, and behavioral data, and turn them into concepts teams can act on.

Lead Mixed-Methods Research: Design and run rigorous research end to end, choosing the right method for the question: ethnography, in-depth interviews, diary studies, and usability testing alongside surveys, conjoint and MaxDiff, segmentation, experiment design, and behavioral and log analysis. You'll triangulate across sources so the "what," the "how much," and the "why" tell one coherent story.

Partner with Data Science and Experimentation: Work closely with data science and analytics to connect qualitative insight to A/B test design, metrics, and product outcomes, and to explain the "why" behind results. You'll help teams learn from what worked, what didn't, and what to test next.

Apply AI to the Research Craft: Use AI tools and LLMs in your daily workflow for synthesis, analysis, survey and discussion guide design, and scaling qualitative depth, and design human-in-the-loop checks that catch confident but wrong outputs. You'll help the team identify where AI accelerates research and where it should not be trusted, and contribute to shared prompts, workflows, and standards. You'll also study how people experience AI-powered features across DoorDash's products.

Influence and Communicate: Tell compelling, decision-ready stories that move partners from insight to action. You'll adapt depth and format to the moment, from a fast directional read that unblocks a team this week to a foundational body of work that anchors a multi-year strategy, and you'll follow through to see that findings change what gets built.

Lead Through Others: Serve as a thought partner and mentor to researchers across levels, review and elevate research quality, and help partners run good research on their own where that makes sense. You'll help set the team's research agenda, methods, and standards, and contribute to hiring and growing the team.

Operate Across Brands and Regions: Bring a global lens to your work, partnering across brands, markets, and cultures and adapting approaches to local context so that insights scale beyond a single market.

What We're Looking For 

- 10+ years of experience in user, market, or product research at a technology company (or equivalent depth), with a track record of leading ambiguous, high-visibility work at staff level or above

- Demonstrated impact on product strategy: examples where your research changed a roadmap, unlocked a new product or line of business, or redirected significant investment

- Proven ability to detect and shape new product or growth opportunities, from early signal through validated concept

- Expert command of both qualitative and quantitative methods, including interviews, ethnography, and usability testing as well as survey design, statistical analysis, and experimentation. Working knowledge of SQL, R, or Python for pulling and analyzing your own data is a plus

- Hands-on experience using AI and LLMs in research (for example, synthesis, analysis, prototyping, or scaling qualitative work), with sound instincts about where they help and where they mislead. Experience researching AI-powered products is a plus

- Experience in consumer, two-sided or multi-sided marketplace, logistics, commerce, or local services contexts is a plus

- Exceptional storytelling and executive presence, with the ability to influence senior stakeholders without authority and build trust across product, design, engineering, data science, and business teams

- A bias for speed and pragmatism: comfortable delivering directional insight quickly while knowing when a decision calls for deeper rigor

- Experience mentoring or coaching researchers and raising the quality of a research practice

- Advanced degree in HCI, Psychology, Sociology, Anthropology, Economics, Statistics, Survey Methodology, or a related field preferred, or equivalent practical experience

Why Join Us?

At Deliveroo, you'll do work that matters, solving real-world problems in a three-sided marketplace that's constantly evolving.

We're food lovers, problem solvers, community builders and more, brought together by a shared drive to make things better. Working here you can expect to:

​​💰 Share in the success you help create Competitive salary and equity options, so you're rewarded for the impact you make.

Diversity, Equity and Inclusion 

At Deliveroo, we know that a great workplace reflects the world around us and that true diversity and inclusion make us stronger, more creative, and better at what we do. We're committed to fostering an environment where everyone can do their best work and feel they belong.

title: Senior Software Engineer (Agentic Search) – Web Rendering (Chromium)
description:
About Nebius : 

Nebius is leading a new era in cloud infrastructure for the global AI economy. We are building a full-stack AI cloud platform that supports developers and enterprises from data and model training through to production deployment, without the cost and complexity of building large in-house AI/ML infrastructure.

Built by engineers, for engineers. From large-scale GPU orchestration to inference optimization, we own the hard problems across compute, storage, networking and applied AI.

Listed on Nasdaq (NBIS) and headquartered in Amsterdam, we have a global footprint with R&D hubs across Europe, the UK, North America and Israel. Our team of 1,500+ includes hundreds of engineers with deep expertise across hardware, software and AI R&D.

The Product 

In a rapidly evolving world, trust in AI depends on AI agents being grounded in fresh, verified real-world data. Search is the foundation that makes this possible. We are building an agent-native search platform designed specifically for AI systems rather than human users. Our product provides programmatic, low-latency, and observable search APIs that AI agents use to retrieve, filter, and reason over real-world information at scale.

The Role 

We are looking for a Senior Software Engineer to work on the rendering infrastructure of a novel search engine tailored for agentic AI consumption.

In this role, you will focus on loading modern web pages in a browser that we patch and build ourselves, so that content is rendered completely and reliably at a cost that works across billions of pages. You will work inside Chromium to remove what we do not need, make the rest faster and cheaper, and keep our build current as Chromium moves. Your work ensures that high-quality content is consistently available to the indexing and retrieval systems downstream.

In this position, your responsibility will be to 

- Change Chromium in its heavy core (Blink, the V8 integration, the compositor, the network service) to cut CPU, memory and startup cost per page

- Strip Chromium down for agent workloads: skip what nobody needs, such as image and media decoding, web font downloads, and rasterization and GPU work where no one needs pixels, while keeping what page scripts depend on to run correctly (style, layout, animation frames, observers), and work out what breaks, or renders differently, when you do

- Keep the browser compatible with the web: make sure that what we remove does not change how the sites we load behave or render

- Profile and tune fleets of browsers: the process model, memory per renderer, startup, isolation and crash handling

- Build the production system around it: how browsers are launched, pooled, recycled and monitored

You may be a good fit if you 

Have 5+ years of experience building production systems, and are an expert in several of the following areas.

Inside the browser 

- Strong C++ in a large, performance-critical codebase, ideally Chromium, Blink or V8, or a comparable browser engine (Rust is a plus)

- Chromium architecture: the process model, Mojo IPC, the rendering pipeline (DOM, style, layout, paint, compositing), and the network service

- Building, debugging and shipping custom Chromium builds: the build system, tracing, crash analysis, and maintaining patches across releases

Performance and systems 

- Profiling CPU, memory and I/O for browser fleets, with tools such as perf, tracing and flame graphs

- Linux process isolation and resource management, concurrency, and memory management

- Have run browsers in production, or built the infrastructure that does, and can describe where the time and memory went

Strong candidates may also have experience with 

- Contributions to Chromium, Blink, V8, Firefox, WebKit or another browser engine

- Building or maintaining a patched browser that you wrote the patches for

- Browser instrumentation, including the Chrome DevTools Protocol

- Working familiarity with how modern frontend frameworks render (SSR, CSR, streaming, hydration)

- Distributed systems, Kubernetes, and Go or Python

The kind of problems you will work on 

- Cut the cost of loading a page in half. Where do CPU and memory go, and what would you change in the browser?

- Turn off the GPU and image decoding for agent workloads. What breaks, and what changes in how pages load and render?

- A page runs a script that never yields. How do we detect and stop it without help from the page?

- Chromium ships a new version. How do we bring a large set of patches forward in days, not weeks?

- Decide when a page is finished, for pages with analytics beacons, long polling and endless scrolling.

We conduct coding interviews as part of the process.

- Competitive compensation

- Career growth and learning opportunities

- Flexibility and ownership

- Collaborative and innovative culture

- Opportunity to work on impactful AI projects

- International environment and talented teams

Fast moving - Bold thinking - Constant growth - Meaningful impact - Trust and real ownership - Opportunity to shape the future of AI

title: Security Architect
description:
Are you a security specialist in the OT space looking to expand your expertise into cloud solutions? Are you a cloud security champion passionate about bringing your expertise into OT/IoT space? At Priva Product Development Organisation we are looking for the Security Architect who will shape the security of our products. 

  

Security Architect in Priva Product Development – Why this role matters 

At Priva, we develop hardware products and software services for horticulture and building automation. Seeing the importance of our products for our customers, we recognize the need to continuously keep these secure in the ever evolving, fast-paced world. The security requirements in our landscape span four different areas: 

- Physical/embedded device security. 

- OT (operational technology) network security. 

- OT network to Priva-hosted cloud services communications. 

- Priva's hybrid on-prem/multi-cloud platform applications security, including applications, infrastructure, CI/CD pipelines. 

What makes this role truly unique is that our products contain long-lived hardware components that our customers run for years. Engineering future-proofed security solutions and maintaining a security posture at existing sites across all these areas having wide range of varying implementations and security needs creates a great challenge and a great fun. 

As part of the architecture team, you will play a key role in shaping the future of Priva's portfolio offered on the global market. You define security standards, security practices and security designs for our products that are used in tens of thousands of buildings and greenhouses. You work across product, engineering, and operations teams to ensure security controls and adhered to, implemented and tested as you have designed these. That’s real impact. 

What you will be doing 

As a Security Architect, you have a very simple mission: you see to it that Priva's hardware products and software (cloud) services are secured against known and emergent threats in lines with the industry standards and practices. You build upon your strong background in securing device/OT networks, cloud applications, and engraining the security practices in the daily work of Agile teams to achieve consistent security posture across all Priva products, designs, and customer deployments. 

 As a security architect, you are trusted counterpart of Priva Security, Quality, and Compliance officer to define, review, and execute controls arising from ISO9001 and ISO27001 standards and internal initiatives. You are responsible for presenting the necessary evidence of Priva’s compliance with these controls to the auditors. 

- Security standards, policies, and design patterns library 

- Security architecture review process 

- Risk register and residual risk acceptance documentation 

- Periodic product security implementation reviews, including maintaining non-compliance register 

- Defined requirements, products and work packages for security-focused projects with 3rd party service providers, reviewing and accepting their deliverables, and supervising the implementation of these deliverables in the Priva hardware products and software services. 

- Regulatory compliance (IEC 62443-4, ISO 27001, ISO 9001 or other standard that may be applicable in specific geographies) 

- Threat intelligence briefing relevant to OT/IoT threat landscape 

- Designing, implementing, and reviewing security controls applied at major customer sites. 

Above all, this is a hands-on role – occasionally writing code is included. You connect the industry’s best practices, ISO standards, product vision with the daily work of the product team. As a security architect, you practice what you preach. You explain, coach, and show by example the implementation of security as Secure SDLC in the developer’s daily work. 

To succeed in this role: 

- You are passionate about OT security; you have great interest in the application of our products in the field. You are curious to grasp how our products truly work for our customers to find the best balance between security, reliability, and cost. You share the opinion that "if I don't secure Priva’s applications, then no one else will". 

- You identify and eliminate issues in the development cycle that can jeopardize the security posture. You know and can show by example how to "test securely as well as test security " 

- You are a great collaborator who can be a valuable sparring partner with product managers to understand and refine customer's needs for security so that you define the right security designs for market segments. Engineering managers rely on your ability to steer security implementations within the product teams. 

- You are comfortable designing products that our customers will be running for years; comfortable providing guidance to LCM activities for existing customers to update hardware and software components to continuously stay secure. 

- You share the knowledge about security subjects; you explain why security practices exist and what they achieve in the long run. 

- You can translate security designs into engineering specifications, appraise implementation designs, conduct code reviews. This role with a strong hands-on component, not just a pure governance role. 

- You understand and can register, document, and communicate clearly risks and trade-offs between differen t project execution scenarios 

- You have had hands-on experience implementing security designs using modern programming language and frameworks, and you are able to coach product teams to increase their secure coding maturity e.g. by running threat modelling workshops with the engineering team. 

- You have vast experience with architecture roles with 3-5 years of experience specifically focusing on security. 

In addition, you have the following technical expertise: 

- Proven track record across at least two of the three domains: OT/IoT/embedded security, network security, cloud security 

- You are familiar with modern authentication and authorization frameworks (JWT, OpenID, SAML) and (REST) API security and protection approached 

- ISO 27001 and IEC 62443-4 understanding at a working level 

- Working knowledge with or excellent ability to apply the PKI and certificate lifecycle management at scale; also, with the vision how to implement this in OT/IoT deployment contexts 

- Solid network security understanding: firewall policy, micro-segmentation, DMZ design for IT/OT boundaries 

- Zero trust architecture principles

- Participate in environmental tests and launch campaigns.

- Degree in aerospace engineering, electrical engineering or comparable qualification

- Significant hands-on experience with electrical/electronic components and systems, ideally in spacecraft AIT or functional verification

- Demonstrated ability to independently plan and deliver electrical or functional tests for complex hardware, from requirements and interfaces through test execution and evidence review

- Electrical design and integration of test equipment, including instrumentation, cabling, connectors, and power and signal interfaces

- Physical assembly and commissioning of test equipment (building racks, routing cables, etc.)

- Familiarity with network configuration and network protocols (TCP/IP) used by test systems

- Ability to develop and review software for test equipment and automated functional tests in LabVIEW and/or VeriStand; experience with Python or similar is an asset

- Experience preparing hardware and test systems for controlled testing, including safety controls, configuration management and objective test records

- Ability to lead technical anomaly investigations, communicate uncertainty and risk, and agree evidence-based retest or closure actions

- Experience providing technical guidance, reviewing work or sharing good practice with colleagues

- Exposure to Mission Control Software platforms like CCS5, COSMOS or similar; experience with COSMOS is a plus

- Experience with communication and power test equipment is an asset

- Ability to read, understand and apply technical manuals, data reports, electrical schematics and design specifications

- Willingness to work hands-on with flight hardware

- Joy in embracing technical problems and the process of solving them

- Sense of responsibility and a clean and organized way of working

- Fuent in written and spoken English

- Willingness to travel worldwide for test and launch campaigns.

title: Senior Machine Learning Engineer, LLM Inference Optimization
description:
About Nebius : 

Nebius is leading a new era in cloud infrastructure for the global AI economy. We are building a full-stack AI cloud platform that supports developers and enterprises from data and model training through to production deployment, without the cost and complexity of building large in-house AI/ML infrastructure.

Built by engineers, for engineers. From large-scale GPU orchestration to inference optimization, we own the hard problems across compute, storage, networking and applied AI.

Listed on Nasdaq (NBIS) and headquartered in Amsterdam, we have a global footprint with R&D hubs across Europe, the UK, North America and Israel. Our team of 1,500+ includes hundreds of engineers with deep expertise across hardware, software and AI R&D.

The role

As a Senior Machine Learning Engineer on the Applied AI team at Nebius Token Factory, you will own model and endpoint optimization from model artifacts through production deployment. Your work will span model internals, quantization and model compression, speculative decoding, KV-cache optimization, inference engines, serving architecture, and benchmarking to improve latency, throughput, memory efficiency, GPU utilization, and cost per token while preserving quality and reliability.

You will work with kernel and platform engineers to investigate serving problems, compare configurations, and resolve performance and quality regressions. You will evaluate model- and engine-level optimizations together with distributed inference designs, including request routing, scheduling, prefill/decode coordination, and multi-node GPU execution. Your improvements will be validated through reproducible benchmarks and safe production rollouts under real-world workloads.

Your responsibilities

- Own optimization projects for specific model families, customer endpoints, or serving backends.

- Compare inference engines and recommend serving configurations suited to individual workloads.

- Diagnose model-quality and performance regressions during production rollouts.

- Improve LLM and VLM endpoint latency, throughput, memory efficiency, GPU utilization, quality, and cost per token.

- Deploy, configure, benchmark, and extend engines such as vLLM, SGLang, TensorRT-LLM, Triton Inference Server, and NVIDIA Dynamo.

- Develop production model-compression workflows covering quantization, quantization-aware training, distillation, low-bit serving, and accuracy recovery.

- Implement or integrate speculative decoding, draft-model approaches, KV-cache optimization, prefix caching, chunked prefill, continuous batching, and disaggregated prefill/decode serving. For prefill–decode disaggregation (PDD), evaluate KV-cache transfer, worker placement, and capacity balancing to determine which workloads benefit from the architecture.

- Design and improve LLM request routers and scheduling policies that balance worker utilization, queueing, request characteristics, and KV-cache locality while meeting latency and reliability targets.

- Scale dense and mixture-of-experts inference across multiple GPU nodes. Select and tune tensor, pipeline, data, and expert parallelism—including wide expert parallelism (WideEP)—with attention to hardware topology, expert load balance, and communication overhead.

- Build reproducible benchmark harnesses measuring TTFT, TPOT, tokens per second per GPU, p95/p99 latency, GPU memory, reliability, and cost per token. Validate architecture choices under representative traffic and consistent GPU budgets.

- Collaborate with GPU kernel and platform engineers to trace bottlenecks across model code, kernels, runtime, scheduler, gateway, and cluster layers.

- Produce design documents, performance reports, rollout plans, and customer-facing technical explanations.

Must-haves

- Strong engineering skills in Python and PyTorch.

- Hands-on experience deploying or optimizing LLM, VLM, or high-throughput transformer inference.

- Practical knowledge of at least one modern inference stack, such as vLLM, SGLang, TensorRT-LLM, Triton Inference Server, NVIDIA Dynamo, Ray Serve, KServe, or an equivalent internal system.

- A strong understanding of transformer inference bottlenecks involving KV cache, attention, memory bandwidth, batching, parallelism, and long-context serving.

- Ability to quantify trade-offs among latency, throughput, quality, utilization, and cost.

- Experience designing or optimizing distributed inference system architecture, with hands-on work in one or more areas such as request routing, distributed scheduling, PDD, multi-node inference, or expert parallelism.

- Strong communication and collaboration skills across research, kernel, infrastructure, product, and customer teams.

Nice-to-haves

- Experience with quantization-aware training, post-training quantization, FP8, INT8, INT4, NVFP4, MXFP4, AWQ, GPTQ, or SmoothQuant.

- Experience with distillation, speculative decoding, EAGLE, Medusa, multi-token prediction, or related inference acceleration methods.

- Experience supporting agentic workloads involving tool calling, structured outputs, streaming APIs, high concurrency, and multi-step orchestration.

- Familiarity with CUDA or Triton; the role does not require kernel engineering to be the candidate’s primary specialization.

- Contributions to open-source projects such as vLLM, SGLang, TensorRT-LLM, FlashInfer, LMCache, PyTorch, Triton, Ray, or KServe.

- Implementation experience with cache-aware request routing, PDD, or WideEP, including diagnosing communication bottlenecks and load imbalance.

- Familiarity with GPU communication libraries and interconnects, such as NCCL, NVLink, InfiniBand, or RoCE.

Benefits & Perks: 

- Competitive compensation

- Career growth and learning opportunities

- Flexibility and ownership

- Collaborative and innovative culture

- Opportunity to work on impactful AI projects

- International environment and talented teams

What's it like to work at Nebius: 

Fast moving - Bold thinking - Constant growth - Meaningful impact - Trust and real ownership - Opportunity to shape the future of AI

We do not discriminate on the basis of race, color, religion, sex (including pregnancy), national origin, ancestry, age, disability, genetic information, marital status, veteran status, sexual orientation, gender identity or expression, or any other characteristic protected by applicable law.

title: Cardog | Toronto, Canada or REMOTE | Full-time
description:
Cardog | Toronto, Canada or REMOTE | Full-time
https://cardog.app/careers We're the system of record for the Canadian vehicle: raw automotive data turned into facts that can be checked. Our open-source VIN decoder sits underneath a government vehicle registry. Some of what's interesting: - A government registry, a manufacturer's own filing, a listing site and an insurance record will describe the same truck four different ways, and nothing in any of those files says they're the same truck. Reconciling that, for every vehicle in the country, in a way that holds up when a regulator asks how you know, is most of the data work. - Seventeen characters on a door frame encode manufacturer, plant, model year and build attributes — badly, inconsistently, and differently per manufacturer. Public reference data covers some of it. The rest gets worked out from filings, recall documents, and patterns inferred across millions of vehicles. - We read vehicles directly over OBD-II now. Forty modules answered on a recent Hyundai, each reporting its own part number and installed software version. Nothing downstream of the VIN moves when a module is reflashed, so no registration, history report or dealer system knows what software is actually in a car. Hiring: VIN Decode Engineer, Data Platform Engineer, Infrastructure Engineer, Founding Engineer (dealer platform). TypeScript, Postgres, Cloudflare Workers. Full descriptions and apply: https://cardog.app/careers

Key responsibilities

What we are looking for

- Experience integrating PLCs with higher-level systems (MES, ERP, databases) via OPC UA or comparable interfaces.

- Understanding of machine safety and functional safety principles.

- The ability to debug live systems on the shop floor under time pressure.

Desirable experience

- SCADA/HMI design (e.g., WinCC, Ignition, TwinCAT HMI).

- Industrialisation : contribuer aux modèles de déploiement réutilisables (configurations types, Terraform, playbooks) pour accélérer les projets suivants.

Requirements 

Profil indispensable

Le poste demande d'être opérationnel sur le SASE dès les premières semaines. Sans expérience SASE en production, la candidature ne sera pas retenue.

- SASE en production : au moins 2 ans de déploiements Zero Trust / SASE chez des clients, sur Cloudflare One, Zscaler (ZIA, ZPA), Netskope, Palo Alto Prisma Access, Cato Networks ou Fortinet SASE.
- Expérience : 3 à 6 ans en sécurité réseau, intégration ou services professionnels.
- Fondamentaux réseau : TCP/IP, DNS, TLS et PKI, routage, VPN IPsec, proxies, pare-feu.
- Identité : SSO en SAML et OIDC, provisioning SCIM, Entra ID ou Okta.
- Poste de travail : déploiement d'agents à grande échelle, MDM et contrôles de posture.
- Relation client : capacité à animer seul un atelier technique et à rédiger une documentation claire.
- Langues : français courant, anglais professionnel (équipe internationale).
- Mobilité : déplacements réguliers chez les clients en France, ponctuellement en Europe.
Atouts

- Expérience directe de Cloudflare One, ou certification Cloudflare (sinon, à obtenir dans les 90 jours suivant l'arrivée).

- Connaissance des environnements OT et industriels.
- Connaissance des exigences NIS2 et DORA.

Évolution et ce que Brixio offre

Le poste démarre sur le SASE mais ne s'y limite pas. Il s'ouvre ensuite aux autres produits Cloudflare (sécurité applicative, API Shield, Workers, IA), selon la progression et l'intérêt de la personne. La sécurité de l'IA s'appuie largement sur Cloudflare One, ce qui fait de ce poste une porte d'entrée naturelle vers les projets IA de Brixio.

title: Blockchain Risk Control Lead
description:
Headquarters: Europe - Remote

About Us 

Established in 2018, Bybit is one of the world’s leading cryptocurrency exchanges and digital financial platforms, serving over 80 million users across more than 200 countries and regions. Powered by world-class technology and a user-first mindset, Bybit delivers a seamless ecosystem across trading, payments, wealth management, custody, institutional services, and Web3 — connecting users to the future of digital finance.
