Today, Bybit is recognized as one of the most trusted and transparent platforms in the digital asset industry, continuing to expand its global presence while building the infrastructure for the next generation of financial services.

Job Brief

We are expanding our focus to cover AI-augmented threat intelligence and post-quantum cryptographic (PQC) security. The ideal candidate will combine deep blockchain forensics expertise with working knowledge of machine learning techniques for anomaly detection, and awareness of quantum computing threats to current cryptographic foundations (ECDSA, RSA) used across blockchain ecosystems. We value candidates who can bridge academia and industry and build collaborative relationships with research institutions to accelerate the adoption of emerging cryptographic and AI-driven techniques within the company.

Main Responsibilities of a Blockchain Risk Control Analyst/Researcher

Your main responsibilities will include:

- 
Leveraging LLM techniques to drive the development of next-generation on-chain risk identification and threat intelligence systems, including autonomous agent workflows capable of continuous monitoring, self-triggered investigation, and automated operational responses — reducing manual intervention across the full risk lifecycle from detection to resolution;

- 
Leading forensic investigations on real crypto theft, fraud, and market manipulation cases, integrating AI-assisted pattern recognition to accelerate root cause analysis;

- 
Researching post-quantum cryptographic algorithms (NIST PQC: ML-KEM, ML-DSA, SLH-DSA, FALCON) and their implications for blockchain security; assessing quantum computing threats to existing cryptographic foundations (ECDSA secp256k1, hash functions) and evaluating migration paths;

- 
Partnering with internal teams and external stakeholders for incident response, and engaging with academic institutions to translate frontier research into deployable security tools;

Key Requirements

- 
You have a Master's or PhD's degree in Blockchain security, Computer Science, Data Science, or a related field.

- 
You are good at programming languages commonly used in blockchain analytics (e.g., SQL, Python, Javascript)

- 
Experience applying machine learning or AI techniques to blockchain data analysis, fraud detection, or threat intelligence

- 
A strong publication record in top-level industry or academic conferences is highly valued.

- 
You have experience with blockchain monitoring/forensic tools and analytics platforms.

- 
Familiarity with NIST PQC standards (ML-KEM, ML-DSA, SLH-DSA, FALCON) and lattice/hash-based cryptography fundamentals is a plus;

- 
Understanding of quantum computing threats to elliptic curve cryptography and implications for key management in Web3;

- 
You have security or risk control experience as a plus.

- 
You possess effective communication and collaboration abilities.

- 
English is essential, and proficiency in Mandarin can be an advantage.

Why Join Us 
At Bybit, we are committed to fostering a supportive and enriching work environment.

title: Staff Software Engineer, Enterprise Platform
description:
Discord has a highly engaged community of millions of daily active users who use the platform for many different reasons, but there’s one thing that nearly everyone does: play video games. Discord plays a uniquely important role in the future of gaming, and we are focused on making it easier and more fun for people to hang out before, during, and after playing games.

Discord's Enterprise Technology org is building a software engineering discipline from the ground up, and this is the founding engineering hire. There is no Enterprise Platform team yet. You will not be maintaining a status quo or joining an existing backlog: you will define the discipline, set the technical foundation, and build the platform that lets the internal systems enabling Discordians scale with the company.

Discord's mission is to cultivate belonging, and doing that at scale requires internal systems that move as fast as the product itself. The mission of this role is to turn our enterprise infrastructure into self-service software. Your job is to replace manual consoles and tickets with a platform of reusable primitives, building blocks like "provision a device" or "push an IAM policy or app integration through code," exposed through clean APIs and self-service portals. As a code-forward Staff engineer, you will design abstractions that hide the messy reality of Okta, Jamf, and Terraform (our identity, device management, and infrastructure-as-code tools) behind interfaces people actually want to use, operating with a platform-as-a-product mindset.

What You'll Do 

- Manage the device fleet as code: Move device configuration off consoles and into versioned, API-driven infrastructure for endpoint management and hardware provisioning.

- Automate the identity layer: Manage identity systems and their connections to downstream apps as code, from SSO and SCIM integrations to account workflows, so changes ship through version control and CI/CD instead of an admin console.

- Own app delivery and Infrastructure-as-Code (IaC): Build deployment pipelines and provisioning patterns that let internal systems be built and changed safely, establishing CI/CD standards.

- Build the self-service layer: Design and ship the APIs, CLIs, and portals that compose primitives into paved paths, like a new hire's first day, where software access and group memberships land in one automated, auditable flow.

- Set the foundation: Define the technical direction and architecture for the discipline, writing the RFCs and documentation that future hires will build on.

What You Should Have 

- 6+ years building and operating production software and systems at a technology company, with a track record of owning ambiguous projects end to end.

- Strong software engineering fundamentals. You write production code (we lean on Python, TypeScript and Rust), and design, test, and ship it. This is not a systems admin role.

- Deep, hands-on IAM experience (SSO, SCIM, OAuth/OIDC, RBAC) and fluency with infrastructure as code (Terraform) and CI/CD.

- Experience treating endpoint and fleet management as an API-driven engineering surface at scale.

- A platform-as-a-product mindset. You have built self-service tooling that people chose to adopt.

- Comfort with ambiguity and a founder's temperament; energized by building from scratch.

Bonus Points 

- Hands-on experience with Okta, Jamf, or Intune.

- Experience with identity and access governance for non-human, workload, or AI-agent principals.

- Background at a high-growth consumer tech company with a highly technical employee base.

Within the range, individual pay is determined by additional factors, including job-related skills, experience, and relevant education or training. Please note that the compensation details listed in role postings reflect the base salary only, and do not include equity, or benefits. 

Base Salary

$248,000—$310,000 USD

Why Discord? 

Discord plays a uniquely important role in the future of gaming. We're a multiplatform, multigenerational and multiplayer platform that helps people deepen their friendships around games and shared interests, and helps developers build and grow their businesses. We believe games give us a way to have fun with our favorite people, whether listening to music together or grinding in competitive matches for diamond rank. Join us in our mission! title: Applied Science - Time Series
description:
About Mistral 

Mistral provides full-stack AI solutions: from frontier models to developer tools, applications, and compute. We partner with enterprises tackling the hardest problems across high-stakes industries like finance, manufacturing, defense, healthcare, and the public sector, co-creating customized AI systems that they can run on their terms.

We are a dynamic, collaborative team passionate about AI and its potential to transform society. Our diverse workforce thrives in competitive environments and is committed to driving innovation. Our teams are distributed between Europe, North America, Asia and the Middle East. We are creative, low-ego and team-spirited.

About The Job

Mistral AI is seeking Applied Scientists and Research Engineers focused on time series. You will design, train, and deploy state-of-the-art time-series foundation models, and apply them to the most demanding forecasting problems in industry, from power grids and plants to trading desks.

Timestral, our family of time-series foundation models, ranked first on amongst all benchmarks at release ( tech report ). The role has two sides: building the next generations of Timestral with our Science team, and taking them into production with our industrial and financial clients, adapted to their data. Working cross-functionally with both external and internal science, engineering, and product teams you will deliver high-impact AI solutions. We are made of researchers, engineers, product builders, ex-founders who love tackling the most complex real world problems in the industry.

What you will do

- Run pre-training, post-training and deploy state of the art time-series foundation models on clusters with thousands of GPUs.

- Generate and curate large-scale time-series datasets, real and synthetic, and build evaluators and benchmarks for forecasting and other time-series tasks.

- Push the frontier of Timestral: architectures, training recipes, scaling, and new capabilities such as anomaly detection, classification and embeddings.

- Fine-tune and adapt Timestral on client data, in the cloud or on-premise, and benchmark it against the client's existing models.

- Develop the necessary tools and frameworks to facilitate data generation, model training, evaluation and deployment.

- Collaborate with cross-functional teams to tackle complex use cases, including agents that combine Timestral with Mistral LLMs.

- Manage research projects and communications with client research teams.

About you

- Fluent in English with excellent communication skills, at ease explaining complex technical concepts to both technical and non-technical audiences.

- Expert with PyTorch or JAX.

- Solid knowledge of modern deep learning and large language models: architectures, pre-training, post-training and evaluation.

- Experience pre-training or fine-tuning time-series foundation models or large transformer models at scale.

- Strong background in time-series modelling: probabilistic forecasting, multivariate series and covariates, and classical baselines (statistical models, gradient boosting).

- Not afraid of contributing to a big codebase; finds their way around independently with little guidance.

- Writes clean, readable, high-performance, fault-tolerant Python code.

- Doesn't need roadmaps: moves independently and is comfortable with uncertainty.

- Low-ego, collaborative and eager to learn.

- Track record of success through personal projects, professional projects or academia.

Nice to have

- Ex-founder or builder

title: API Engineer (H/F)
description:
Chez Withings, nous souhaitons redonner aux individus le contrôle de leur santé.

Nous avons l’obsession de créer des produits beaux et intuitifs, afin que chacun puisse les utiliser facilement au quotidien; nos balances connectées, montres hybrides, tensiomètres, moniteurs de sommeil et tous les dispositifs de notre gamme sont aujourd’hui utilisés par des millions d’utilisateurs.

Nous créons des objets connectés et des applications pour aider chacun à prendre soin de sa santé au quotidien. Au cœur de cet écosystème, l' équipe API est le pont qui connecte nos produits, nos services et nos partenaires.

Vos Missions 
Rattaché(e) directement au Lead Developer API, vous êtes le garant technique de nos API. Vous êtes un(e) développeur(se) Backend ou Fullstack (avec au moins une expérience significative en développement API) souhaitant concilier la pratique du code avec un rôle central dans l'évaluation fonctionnelle, la conception d'architecture et la rédaction de spécifications techniques.

1. Conception d'architecture et spécifications techniques (40%)

- Analyser et challenger les spécifications fonctionnelles des PMs.
- Modéliser les bases de données, définir les endpoints et concevoir les contrats d'API.
- Rédiger les spécifications techniques.
2. Développement & debugging (40%)

- Développer de nouveaux endpoints et maintenir les services existants (framework PHP interne performant, front React).
- Résoudre les problèmes techniques, déboguer et optimiser les requêtes SQL.
- Accompagner les équipes internes lors de la livraison et participer aux revues de code.
3. Productivité, LLM & Suivi technique (20%)

- Intégrer les LLM au quotidien pour automatiser ou améliorer la documentation, les tests, la revue de code et l'outillage interne.
- Participer aux réflexions techniques avec les développeurs.
- Surveiller et améliorer le suivi des erreurs et des performances des APIs.
Requirements 

- Formation : Vous êtes issu d'une formation Bac+5 en informatique 
- Expérience : Vous justifiez d'une première expérience significative en tant que développeur Backend ou Fullstack. Vous avez déjà été confronté aux réalités de la production, à la conception d'APIs et aux cycles de livraison logicielle.
- Techniques : Vous maîtrisez au moins un langage Backend et êtes prêt(e) à vous approprier un framework PHP interne robuste.Vous avez des connaissances sur React pour la partie web.
- Esprit d'analyse : Face à un document de spécifications, vous aimez creuser et chercher la petite bête pour éviter les pièges techniques avant le premier commit.
- Sens du collectif : Vous aimez échanger avec des profils variés (PM, Devs, Ops). Vous savez écouter, questionner et vulgariser.
- Sensibilité LLM / IA : Vous utilisez déjà des outils comme Copilot, ChatGPT ou Claude au quotidien et vous êtes prêt(e) à trouver des solutions pour intégrer l'utilisation des IA génératives dans nos processus existants.
- Précision : Ce rôle n'est ni un poste de Product Owner ni de gestion de projet fonctionnelle ; vous lisez des logs, concevez des architectures logicielles et écrivez du code.
Benefits 

Rejoindre l’aventure Withings, c’est :

- Intégrer un des pionniers et leaders mondiaux de la santé connectée, plusieurs fois primé au Consumer Electronic Show
- Contribuer à des projets innovants et ambitieux pour la santé de demain dans un environnement agile et en constante évolution
- Intégrer une entreprise internationale, membre de la FrenchTech 120, dont les équipes sont basées à Issy-les-Moulineaux, Boston, Hong-Kong et Shenzhen
- Participer à l’amélioration continue de nos produits et services en les bêta-testant avant leur sortie, notamment lors de nos nombreuses sessions sportives entre collègues
- Bénéficier de nombreux avantages : Stock Options, smartphone et ordinateur de votre choix, réductions pour des activités culturelles et sportives, restaurant d’entreprise, et bien plus encore
- Participer à la Withings Med Academy en assistant à des conférences de professionnels de santé afin de renforcer ses connaissances dans le domaine médical
- Collaborer avec des collègues passionnés et célébrer ensemble chacune de nos réussites !
Toutes les candidatures reçues sont étudiées indépendamment de l’origine ethnique, des croyances, de la religion, du genre, de l’orientation sexuelle ou de la santé des candidats. Withings aspire à offrir et garantir l’égalité des chances aux candidats et seules les personnes habilitées (RH et Management) auront accès aux informations concernant votre candidature.

title: Abuse Research Engineer
description:
Headquarters: Remote from the US

Who we are

About Stripe

Stripe is a financial infrastructure platform for businesses. Millions of companies—from the world’s largest enterprises to the most ambitious startups—use Stripe to accept payments, grow their revenue, and accelerate new business opportunities. Our mission is to increase the GDP of the internet, and we have a staggering amount of work ahead. That means you have an unprecedented opportunity to put the global economy within everyone’s reach while doing the most important work of your career. 

About the team

Abuse Research Group (ARG) handles proactive threat hunting and adversary behavior analysis across Stripe products. Rather than reacting to alerts, the team maps end-to-end fraud and abuse paths, validates novel attack vectors, and identifies product conditions that enable fraud. Using agentic automated testing and simulation tools, ARG translates research into actionable threat advisories, strategic control recommendations, and regression scenarios to systematically eliminate vulnerabilities.

What you’ll do

As an Abuse Research Engineer in the Abuse Research Group, you will play a critical role in safeguarding Stripe’s financial ecosystem by proactively hunting for advanced threats, dissecting complex fraud vectors, and extracting actionable adversary intelligence. Rather than relying solely on reactive alerts, you will develop and execute hypothesis-driven threat hunting operations across internal telemetry and external sources to uncover fraudulent tools, tactics, and techniques (TTPs) before they impact Stripe’s platform. Central to this work is FT3 (Fraud Taxonomy 3.0), Stripe’s multi-layered taxonomy that decomposes monolithic fraud into structured kill chains. Collaborating cross-functionally with Fraud Ops, Strategy, Risk, Onboarding, and Security, you will integrate threat intelligence, build agentic simulation workflows, and systematically eliminate product vulnerabilities.

Responsibilities

- Proactive Threat Hunting & Kill Chain Analysis: Formulate hypotheses and conduct iterative threat hunting operations across Stripe systems and external data.

- FT3 Taxonomy: Apply and enrich the FT3 framework across empirical datasets and incidents, standardizing threat intelligence across kill chain phases and targeted API endpoints. 

- Threat Intelligence & Signal Expansion: Partner with teams like Fraud Intelligence to integrate, curate, and automate threat feeds into engineering workflows. 

- Cross-Functional Advisories & Strategic Controls: Translate raw research and retrospective findings into actionable threat advisories and control recommendations (policy, technical systems, support workflows, and detection mechanisms) for stakeholders across Fraud, Risk, Onboarding, and Security. 

- Agentic Testing & Adversary Simulation: Utilize agentic automated testing frameworks to simulate adversary TTPs, validate whether deployed controls interrupt empirical kill chains, and generate regression scenarios to exercise controls. 

Who you are 

We’re looking for someone who meets the minimum requirements to be considered for the role. If you meet these requirements, you are encouraged to apply. The preferred qualifications are a bonus, not a requirement. 

Minimum requirements

- 5+ years of experience conducting threat intelligence, threat hunting, or technical incident response within cyber security, product abuse, or trust domains. 

- 5+ years of experience analyzing large, complex datasets using data analytics tools to identify anomalies, map behavioral trends, and solve complex fraud problems. 

- B.S. or M.S. in Computer Science, Cybersecurity, or a related technical field, or equivalent practical experience. 

- Expert proficiency in Python and SQL, with demonstrated experience using code and scripting to automate workflows, build investigative tools, or query big data pipelines. 

- Hands-on experience in log analysis (e.g., application logs, API route telemetry, network security events), digital forensics, and cyber investigation methodologies. 

- Strong communication skills with a proven ability to translate complex technical research into clear, actionable recommendations and advisories for cross-functional partners.

Preferred qualifications 

- Deep technical understanding of threat actor motivations, infrastructure, and TTPs specific to financial fraud (e.g., ATO, Card Testing, Credential Stuffing). 

- Familiarity with standardized taxonomies such as FT3 or MITRE ATT&CK. 

- Proficiency with engineering, data processing, and analysis platforms such as Databricks, Trino, PySpark, Pandas, or Scikit-Learn. 

- Proven background utilizing Threat Intelligence Platforms (TIPs), tactical threat feeds, OSINT, and breach intelligence. 

- Demonstrated capability building or leveraging agentic LLM tools, automated testing systems, or control validation frameworks to model adversary behavior at scale. 

- Participation in industry conferences, webinars, or threat-sharing groups, alongside relevant professional certifications (e.g., GCTI, GCFA, OSCP).

title: Deployment Strategist
description:
Headquarters: Remote - India

About the Team 

The FDE (Forward Deployed Engineering) team is a new, strategic initiative sponsored from the CEO and Founders down. Our mission is to win C-suite-sponsored, high-value AI opportunities by selling and delivering outcomes , not just a platform.

You will be part of the founding team, embedded with our most strategic customers from the very first sales call, all the way through to a production-ready solution. You will be the "product manager" for the customer's problem, responsible for the "why" and "what," while our FDEs (Engineers) will be your partners responsible for the "how."

Role Description 

As a Deployment Strategist (DS), you are the critical bridge between a customer's multi-million-dollar business problem and Databricks' technical solution. You are a product manager for the field, owning the technical and product direction of the engagement from initial discovery through production launch and adoption.

You will build C-suite trust, perform deep discovery to map the customer's political and technical landscape, and scope the value. You will define the Minimum Viable Product for a pilot, write the PRD that guides the engineering team, and manage the project to a successful landing. You will also lead technical discovery, shape solution architecture with FDEs, and ensure that each proposed solution can move from prototype to production.

This role requires a rare combination of executive presence, deep product thinking, technical depth, and a hands-on delivery mindset.

The impact you will have 

- C-Suite Scoping & Value Definition: Partner with Sales to perform deep discovery, map the customer's organization, quantify the business value of $10M+ problems, and define the pilot, including its MVP, success criteria, and timeline.

- End-to-End Product Ownership: Author the PRD, prioritize the engineering backlog, manage scope, and act as the primary hands-on QA tester. Translate business requirements into clear data, integration, security, and operational requirements that engineers can build against.

- Technical Solution Leadership & Delivery: Drive the FDE build team through an agile delivery process, manage stakeholders from the C-suite to individual engineers, and unblock technical or organizational issues. Lead technical discovery and design reviews. Understand the customer's data flows, integrations, platform constraints, and operational environment; pressure-test architecture choices; and identify technical risks early.

- Solution Launch & Landing: Own the "Day 0" launch, manage the war room, and drive the solution from launch to full adoption by capturing user feedback, iterating, and proving the defined business value. Own production readiness across data quality, testing, security, performance, and operations. Work with the team to diagnose issues and drive them to resolution.

- Strategic Handoff & Growth: Scope the ongoing maintenance plan, create customer documentation/training, and leverage your trusted advisor status to identify the next high-value FDE engagement. Codify reusable solution patterns and bring field insights back to Product and Engineering.

What we look for 

- Executive Presence & Communication: You are a trusted advisor with strong executive presence and excellent communication skills. You are confident and humble, can build rapport quickly, and can help senior stakeholders make difficult decisions.

- Product Judgment & Delivery: You can define what to build and why, write strong product requirements, prioritize engineering work, manage scope, and lead complex agile software projects from an ambiguous problem to a measurable outcome.

- Technical Fluency & Architecture Judgment: You understand modern data and AI architectures, including cloud platforms, data pipelines, data models, distributed systems, APIs, security and governance, machine learning, and generative AI application patterns. You can lead architecture discussions, evaluate trade-offs, and pressure-test technical decisions.

- Hands-on Technical Ability: You are proficient in at least one language such as Python, Java, or SQL. You can explore data, work in notebooks, read and review code and pipelines, build or adapt prototypes, and contribute meaningfully to troubleshooting.

- Relevant Experience: Typically 7+ years of experience delivering complex, customer-facing data, analytics, AI, or software engagements, or equivalent experience as a founder or technical builder. You have helped deliver data, machine learning, or generative AI systems into production and understand the integration, operational, and adoption challenges that appear in real environments. Experience in a high-growth technology company, forward-deployed organization, or leading consultancy is valuable. You enjoy working onsite with customers (often 25-50%, sometimes higher) to drive delivery.

About Databricks 

Databricks is the Data and AI company. More than 20,000 organizations worldwide — including adidas, AT&T, Bayer, Block, Mastercard, Rivian, Unilever, and 70% of the Fortune 500 — rely on the Databricks Data + AI Platform to build and scale data and AI apps, analytics and agents. Headquartered in San Francisco with 30+ offices around the globe, Databricks offers a unified platform that includes Genie, Lakebase, Agent Bricks, Lakeflow, Lakehouse, and Unity Catalog. To learn more, follow Databricks on LinkedIn , X , YouTube , and Instagram .

Benefits

At Databricks, we strive to provide comprehensive benefits and perks that meet the needs of all of our employees. For specific details on the benefits offered in your region click here .

Our Commitment to Diversity and Inclusion 

At Databricks, we are committed to fostering a diverse and inclusive culture where everyone can excel. We take great care to ensure that our hiring practices are inclusive and meet equal employment opportunity standards. Individuals looking for employment at Databricks are considered without regard to age, color, disability, ethnicity, family or marital status, gender identity or expression, language, national origin, physical and mental ability, political affiliation, race, religion, sexual orientation, socio-economic status, veteran status, and other protected characteristics.

Compliance 

If access to export-controlled technology or source code is required for performance of job duties, it is within Employer's discretion whether to apply for a U.S. government license for such positions, and Employer may decline to proceed with an applicant on this basis alone.

title: Lead AI engineer
description:
About Mirakl: 

Founded in 2012, Mirakl has been at the forefront of marketplace innovation, empowering every business to compete in the platform economy.

Today, Mirakl's operating system combines an enterprise marketplace solution (Mirakl Platform) that enables retailers and B2B organizations to launch, scale, and operate marketplaces and dropship, AI-powered multichannel selling (Mirakl Connect), retail media (Mirakl Ads) and an agentic commerce infrastructure (Mirakl Nexus).

With dual headquarters in Boston and Paris, Mirakl helps a global ecosystem of 450+ marketplaces (B2C and B2B) and a network of over 100k third-party marketplace sellers. Brands like Macy's, Decathlon, Carrefour, Asos, and Airbus Helicopters use Mirakl to grow their businesses in new and remarkable ways.

For more information: www.mirakl.com .

Mirakl in Numbers: 

- 🗓️ Founded in 2012 | Member of French Tech Next40

- 👥 750+ employees in 9 offices worldwide: Paris, Barcelona, Bordeaux, Boston, London, Munich, New York, Sydney, Tokyo

- 🇫🇷 350+ Mirakl Tech teams members mainly based in France

- ⚙️ 5 Saas Solutions

Our Values: 

Working at Mirakl means accelerating your career alongside ambitious, passionate, and supportive colleagues. We're proud of the diversity of backgrounds, perspectives, and experiences that make our teams unique.

Our 5 values guide how we collaborate:

- 💡 Work Hard Together: Teamwork and collaboration are the foundation of our success

- 🏆 Get Things Done: We prioritize action and efficiency for impactful results

- 🚀 Go Above & Beyond: We tackle challenges proactively and always aim for excellence

- 🎓 Succeed Through Expertise: Knowledge sharing and continuous learning are core to our culture

- 🤝 Satisfy & Empower Clients: We're committed to our clients' success

About the job 

Lead the design, development, and adoption of AI systems within a strategic business domain.

You will combine deep AI engineering expertise with product and business understanding to identify high-impact opportunities, define roadmaps, and deliver measurable outcomes.

As the AI technical lead for your domain, you will drive architecture decisions, engineering excellence, and AI adoption across teams and stakeholders. Examples of domains include: Sales, GTM and Marketing or Finance & Legal

This is a permanent position (CDI) based in Paris or Bordeaux, with 4 days on-site per week.

Annual gross salary range (package): €90,000 – €100,000

This range is provided for transparency purposes and reflects our internal compensation grid for this role level. The final offer will be determined based on your experience, skills, and the scope of responsibilities involved.

Why Now, Why Mirakl 

Generative AI and AI Agents are fundamentally reshaping commerce software and the way our teams work on a day to day basis.

At Mirakl, AI is becoming a core part of our product strategy. From Catalog Transformer and content generation to AI Agents and Agentic Commerce, we are building the next generation of commerce software. And we have the same ambition for our teams around AI products and adoption.

We are looking for a Lead AI Engineer to transform cutting-edge AI technologies into reliable, scalable, and measurable products used by leading enterprises worldwide.

You won't be joining a company that's thinking about AI. You'll be joining one that's already building it.

What You'll Do 

1. Own Tech Strategy for Your Domain 

- Identify high-value opportunities with Business leaders

- Define the Tech vision and own the agent product roadmap for your domain

2. Lead AI System Development 

- Design and build production-grade AI systems

- Drive architecture decisions

- Ensure scalability, reliability, and maintainability

3. Drive Adoption & Business Impact 

- Work closely with end users

- Measure adoption and outcomes

- Accelerate AI transformation across your domain

4. Establish Technical Excellence 

- Promote best practices for evaluation, testing, guardrails, and observability

- Review designs and mentor engineers

- Raise the quality bar across initiatives

5. Grow AI Capability 

- Mentor AI Engineers and Agent Builders

- Share knowledge and reusable components

- Build AI expertise within your organization

Success Metrics 

- Business impact delivered by AI initiatives

- Adoption within the domain

- Technical quality and reliability

- Team capability growth

Our stack and tools 

- Languages: Python and SQL

- AI Stack: OpenAI, Anthropic, Gemini, Mistral and Open-source models

- Agentic & Retrieval: LangGraph, LangChain, LlamaIndex, MCP and Vector Databases

- Infrastructure: AWS or GCP, Docker and Kubernetes

You'll Love This Job If you have 

- 7+ years in Software Engineering, ML Engineering, or Applied AI

- Strong experience with LLMs, RAG, AI Agents, evaluation, and production systems

- Ability to influence Product and Business decisions

- Proven leadership on complex cross-functional initiatives

Feel free to add a link to your GitHub in your CV so we can understand what you have worked on!

Want to join us? Here is our process 

- A 30-40 min phone conversation with one of our Tech recruiters. This will be an opportunity to discuss your background, expectations, and discover what Mirakl can offer you in return.

- An initial 1 hour technical discussion with a member of the Data Science team and Engineering Team, which will allow you to delve into the more specific aspects of your expertise and discover how your skills can be integrated into our projects.

- 2 x 45-minute "STAR" interviews with future Mirakl colleagues to discuss our values and company culture.

We welcome collaborators with their diverse perspectives and experiences to power us forward. These often far exceed conventional job requirements and help us create a culture of continuous learning. If you're ready to join a global leader powering digital transformation for 450+ of the world's most innovative retailers and B2B organizations. 

As part of our recruitment process, Mirakl processes your personal data to review and manage your application and, where appropriate, to consider your profile for future opportunities. You can exercise your data protection rights at any time, and as further detailed in our policies. For more information about how we process your personal data and your rights, please consult our Recruitment Privacy Notice, here in English and here in French. 

We may use Artificial Intelligence (AI) solutions to help streamline our hiring process, including screening applications, analyzing resumes, and assessing responses. While AI helps us work efficiently, all final hiring decisions are made by humans. For more information, visit our AI Guidelines for Candidates and Interviews .

title: Research Engineer, Content Understanding
description:
Exa is an applied AI lab building a search engine unlike the world has ever seen. We build massive-scale infra to crawl the entire web, train state-of-the-art embedding models to process it, and design super high performant vector databases to retrieve over it. We now power search for Cursor, Cognition, HubSpot, and over 400,000 developers and have raised $350m from Lightspeed, Benchmark, and a16z.

Our ultimate goal is to build perfect search over all the world's information, far beyond Google. If you want to build massive-scale ML systems that will define the way the new AI world consumes information, this is the place for you.

As a backend engineer, you'd play a critical role in our search architecture. We're pretty flexible on what projects people work on based on their skills and interests.

Search quality is bounded by what we understand about a page. Before anything can be retrieved, something has to work out what the page actually says. That means parsing it into the parts that are content and the parts that are furniture, classifying what kind of page it is and what it is about, telling whether the page is usable at all, extracting when it was published, judging how good it is and whether it can be trusted, and working out whether it says anything that a page we already have does not. All of this has to work on every page on the web, in every language, in every shape the web comes in.

Some of this is classic document understanding. Some of it is much more open. Credibility and misinformation, AI-generated and machine-spun content, and pages written to be found rather than read are all unsolved, and search results are only as trustworthy as our answers to them.

We are looking for a research engineer to work on this. There is a lot of room to do it well.

Desired Experience 

- Graduate-level ML experience (Master’s or PhD with at least 2 years of relevant experience), or an exceptionally strong undergrad

- You can build a transformer from scratch in PyTorch, and you have trained models that then had to be cheap enough to run everywhere

- You like building large-scale datasets and living in the data. Most of the wins here are in the supervision rather than the architecture

- You are comfortable with problems where the ground truth does not exist yet and defining it is part of the job

- You care about the problem of finding high quality knowledge and recognize how important this is for the world

Example Projects 

- Make parsing work on the pages where it currently does not, and prove the improvement rather than assert it

- Teach a model to judge page quality, and get everyone to agree on what quality means well enough to supervise it

- Work on credibility and misinformation as a modelling problem: what a page claims, whether it is a reliable source of it, and whether it was written for a reader or for a crawler

- Decide whether two documents are semantically the same or genuinely different, so we can deduplicate the web without collapsing pages that a user would want to see separately

- Build classification and extraction that is accurate at web scale and cheap enough to run on all of it

- Design the supervision for something nobody has labels for, and find out whether it is learnable at all

- Trace a bad search result back to the page-level prediction that caused it, and fix it at the source

description:

At Harvey, the future of professional services is being written today — and we’re just getting started.

Role Overview 

Harvey's Finance Engineering team is the investment-side counterpart to our Legal Engineering team: former investment professionals who bring real deal experience to Harvey's prospects and customers. Forward Deployed Finance Engineers lead discovery, demos, pilots, trainings, onboarding, and custom builds alongside our AEs and CSMs. They translate real investment work into Harvey solutions, serving as the trust layer across the entire customer lifecycle, from the first pilot to the most complex, custom-built workflow.

Finance Engineers work on Harvey Deals, a new product built off of Harvey's acquisition of Benchmark. Harvey Deals is where investment teams run their deals — screening, underwriting, diligence, and committee materials — built in the firm's own templates and formats, with every figure traceable back to the document it came from. Harvey works with 150+ asset management firms and analyzes 178M+ documents each month; the Finance Engineering team is how that capability meets the way deal teams actually work.

Finance Engineers understand how investors think and work, and use that expertise to design, build, and refine solutions that hold up under live deal pressure. In doing so, they don't just drive adoption; they shape Harvey's product roadmap, ensuring every release is grounded in what investment teams actually need. This role is the first Finance Engineer dedicated to private credit. You will build the credit playbook — demo library, workflow templates, use cases — while running live pilots, and lead the credit practice as the team grows.

You may be asked to travel around 2–3+ times per month. Travel is always for a significant business need and typically is for 1–3 days at a time.

What You'll Do 

Forward Deployed Finance Engineers on the private credit team are former credit investors who left the desk to help build the future of how credit gets underwritten. Working closely with Account Executives, they engage with direct lenders, opportunistic and specialty finance managers, BDC managers, and insurer credit arms throughout the pre-sales process and stay with them well past it — leading pilots on live opportunities, guiding lenders through what's possible with AI, and sitting down with credit teams to build screening, underwriting, and credit committee workflows in the firm's own templates and formats.

The work is the work they did on the desk: lender presentation and CIM review; QoE read-throughs and data pack analysis; cash flow and leverage modeling; sizing and structuring; covenant and credit agreement review; credit memo drafting; and comps. What You Have

- Strong command of the documents and data that drive a credit decision — lender presentation and CIM, QoE and data pack, model, credit agreement and intercreditor, compliance certificates — and an instinct for where the numbers and the paper disagree.

- Advanced Excel and financial modeling, comfort with prompting and agentic AI workflows, and a builder's instinct for turning a repeated manual process into a repeatable automation. Python, SQL, or experience building internal tools is a plus.

- Executive presence and relationship-building skills, with the ability to establish credibility from analysts and associates through to partners and credit committee members.

- Customer-facing or commercial experience (LP or investor relations, capital formation, banking coverage, business development) and/or hands-on experience using AI tools in an investment setting are pluses.

title: R&D - Software Engineer
description:
About Us 

QuantWare is building the world’s most powerful quantum processors to solve humanity's greatest challenges. We do this with our unique VIO™ technology, the only QPU architecture that breaks the hardware barriers that have held quantum computing back, unlocking the path to MegaQubit quantum processors.

With VIO, we are paving the way for the hyper-scale quantum computers that will change the world. And delivering on that vision demands people who don’t shy away from tackling the hardest challenges of our time. That’s where you come in! 

We are looking for an R&D Software Engineer to bring production-grade software and data practices into our R&D measurement work. As we scale up VIO, our measurement data, metadata, and codebase are growing fast. You will take our existing measurement software and data practices to the next level, making them robust and maintainable, and building on how we organize data so it supports analysis, yield, and root cause investigations at scale. As channel counts grow, PCMs and test vehicles multiply, and test setups become more varied, you will standardize our experimental workflows so measurement throughput never becomes the bottleneck.

You will also be the link between R&D, the software team in Product, and the data team in Operations, so our efforts stay aligned.

What you’ll be doing 

- Data management: Develop and maintain how R&D measurement data and metadata are stored, linking each device to its related tests, components, and setup history, so cross-device comparisons and yield questions become a quick query.

- Measurement software: Turn measurement prototypes from experimental physicists and RF test engineers into robust, tested, maintainable code, and maintain the R&D measurement codebase for VIO devices, their components, and PCM test vehicles.

- Code architecture & quality: Review, refactor, and maintain modular Python code following modern software practices (automated testing with PyTest, CI/CD, documentation, version control).

- Collaboration: Work day-to-day with experimental physicists, RF test engineers and electrical engineers to improve their measurement code, and connect R&D with the software team in Product to bring in best practices.

- Ownership: Own R&D software functionality through validation, review, and integration.

Your Profile 

- MSc in Computer Science, Electrical/Computer Engineering, or similar, plus 3+ years of industry experience (must).

- Experience building software that interacts with hardware, such as in the context of manufacturing companies, test and measurement systems, lab or factory automation, or control systems (must). 

- Hands-on experience in control of test and measurement equipment is a plus, and experience in a quantum device foundry or test facility is a strong plus.

- Strong Python, with a track record of improving and maintaining code for data acquisition, automation, or scientific pipelines.

- Experience working with databases and cloud computing suites like GCP and AWS for technical or experimental data.

- Working knowledge of best practices, including object-oriented design, Git, code review, and testing frameworks.

- Strong drive to eliminate manual measurement and analysis overhead.

- Comfortable in a multidisciplinary scale-up, translating between experimental hardware teams and production software, and aligning with other teams working on data and software (Ops, Product).

Don't tick every box? Apply anyway! Research shows women often self-select out if they don't meet every requirement. Here's our take: nobody ticks every box. This is a description of our ideal candidate, not a filter. If most resonates and you're keen to learn the gaps, apply. We hire for trajectory, not perfection. 

What We Offer: 

At QuantWare, you’ll be part of a high-performing team of world-class experts in an ambitious, fast-moving environment. From day one, you’ll have the trust, tools, and support to do your best work. Here’s what you can expect:

Competitive salary - A salary that reflects the impact and importance of the role (and of course 8% holiday allowance)

Pension that’s built to last - A generous and future-proof pension plan that includes partner and dependent coverage.

Flexibility built on trust - We focus on outcomes. Work flexibly, in a hybrid setup, with an open vacation policy that lets you manage your time

Personal growth - We invest in your L&D, with a budget available to each team member, dependent on their individual ambitions, development needs, and performance

A connected team - We make space to celebrate wins together, with team events, offsites, and spontaneous moments that bring us closer

Diversity & Inclusion at QuantWare 

We’re an ambitious company, not only for our goals but also to become an even more diverse and inclusive team. We know great candidates don't always follow a straight path, and we value diverse experience, perspectives, and ways of thinking. We know this helps us make better decisions, drives more innovation, and strengthens our culture.

title: Senior Stack Scientist
description:
Senior Stack Scientist 

About EH Energy Engineering 

EH Energy develops fuel cell technology for heavy-duty mobility and large-scale stationary power. Our redesigned fuel cell is more compact, has higher power density and costs less to produce. We build high-performance, cost-effective fuel cell solutions to help address climate change and the move toward decentralised energy.

As Senior Stack Scientist, you will own the scientific understanding of how our stacks perform and age. You will connect cell-level electrochemistry with stack-level design, operating conditions and manufacturing, and turn that understanding into stacks with higher power density, longer life and repeatable performance.

Key Responsibilities 

- Lead stack-level performance and durability investigations, from short stacks to full-size stacks.

- Define and run stack test campaigns: polarisation, EIS, cell voltage monitoring, durability and accelerated stress tests under realistic duty cycles.

- Analyse water management, thermal behaviour, gas distribution and cell-to-cell uniformity, and identify what limits performance.

- Investigate stack degradation and failure modes, including post-mortem analysis, and lead root-cause work with the materials, process and design teams.

- Develop and validate stack models (electrochemical, thermal, fluidic) to guide design choices and operating strategies.

- Set the operating windows, conditioning and break-in procedures, and the diagnostic methods used in development and production.

- Translate results into clear requirements for flow fields, bipolar plates, MEAs, sealing and compression.

- Mentor junior scientists and engineers, and present results to internal stakeholders and partners.

Skills and Experience Required 

- PhD or MSc in electrochemistry, chemical engineering, mechanical engineering, materials science, physics or a related field.

- 12+ years of experience in fuel cell stack development or testing (PEM preferred).

- Strong grasp of stack physics: water and heat management, reactant distribution, contact resistance and compression.

- Hands-on experience with stack test benches, cell voltage monitoring, EIS and durability/AST protocols.

- Solid understanding of MEA, GDL and bipolar plate degradation mechanisms.

- Experience with modelling and data analysis tools (e.g. Python, MATLAB, COMSOL or similar).

- Ability to turn complex data into clear, actionable recommendations.

- Team player who can also work autonomously in a fast-moving environment.

- Management experience

- English is mandatory; French or German is a plus.

Start date: Immediately

title: Associate Data Scientist
description:
Description

Machine Learning Maestro: You donât just work with data - you decode it, predict the future with it, and turn it into action. Your models donât just sit on a shelf - they shape strategy, optimize efficiency, and fuel company growth. You thrive on uncovering hidden patterns, validating hypotheses, and embedding machine learning models into real-world AI applications. If that sounds like you - read on.

AlgaeCal is looking for a top-tier Associate Data Scientist who can turn raw information into strategies that drive measurable results.

This job will give you ALL the feels:

At AlgaeCal, weâre driven by a single idea. To end the fear of bone loss. In the United States, an estimated 54 million people have low bone density.

The good news? AlgaeCal has the worldâs only clinically-backed natural solution to this problem. We give hope to everyone worried about bone loss. If that excites you, youâll find no better place to continue your career than at AlgaeCal.

This job might be for you if youâve gotâ¦

- Experience as a Data Scientist (or a similar role) and can back it up with a resume that shows real results. Youâve built predictive models, optimized AI applications, and refined data architectures that have had a measurable impact. You donât just analyze numbersâyou translate data into actionable insights that drive business decisions.
- Serious coding skills in Python or R. You know how to build and refine machine learning models that actually work. Youâve used statistical modeling and data science tools to solve complex problems and unlock growth opportunities.
- Expertise in SQL and relational databases. Writing efficient queries? Optimizing data structures? Your resume is packed with quantifiable examples thatâll make us drool with desire! You know how to work with large datasets, ensuring data is organized, accessible, and primed for analysis.
- A deep understanding of machine learning algorithms. Whether itâs regression, clustering, or neural networks, you know how to choose the right approach for the right challenge. You donât just apply modelsâyou understand how they work under the hood.
- Hands-on experience with data warehouses. BigQuery or similar? Check. You understand how to design, maintain, and optimize scalable data storage solutions that support robust analytics.
- A knack for standardizing and improving data models. Youâve worked with data at scale, refining schemas and improving architectures to ensure efficiency, accuracy, and usability across the organization.
- A laser-sharp eye for detail. Youâre the kind of person who spots trends, outliers, and opportunities that others miss. Your ability to catch anomalies helps ensure our models and analytics are always on point.
- An entrepreneurial approach to data. You donât just crunch numbersâyou think strategically about how data can be leveraged to create business value. Youâre proactive in identifying new ways AI and machine learning can drive efficiency, sales, and profitability.
- Industry know-how that adds value. If youâve got experience in consumer packaged goods, e-commerce, or the health/supplement industry, thatâs a huge plus. You understand how data can shape customer experience, optimize operations, and maximize ROI.
Now, time to be honest: is this really you? If youâre nodding your head and feeling that flutter of excitement, then we canât wait to meet you.

Other Qualities Youâll Need

At AlgaeCal weâre going to insist that you have these 3 qualities:

- Youâre humbleââyou put the team and othersâ needs ahead of your own
- Youâre hungry to learn more
- Youâre people smartââin the sense that youâre a great teammate
The truth is, if you donât have these qualities you wonât last long at AlgaeCal. So if youâre missing one of them, be honest. Save yourself a lot of headaches and skip to a job posting that is a better fit for you.

What Will You Earn?

We believe in rewarding top talent. Letâs talk about salary once weâve had the chance to get to know you better. Rest assured, weâre generous and offer above-market pay for the right person. If you bring the skills and experience, weâll make sure the compensation reflects that.

Youâll also enjoy the following benefits:

- Monthly team events and activities
- Weekly team lunches
- Casual dress code
- Incredible dog friendly, Yaletown office one block from SkyTrain
- Remote working is okay with us too.
And above all, youâll join a team that youâll never want to leave. Culture is everything to us. Yes, we work extremely hard to change as many peopleâs lives as possible. But we know how to have fun and reward ourselves too.

How To Apply

So, do you have what it takes to become the next member of team AlgaeCal?

Job opportunities like this donât come along often, and weâve got a lot to offer our successful applicant. So, to make sure our future Associate Data Scientist is the real-deal, will be a great fit, and will thrive at AlgaeCal, we ask a little more than your run-of-the-mill job application:

If this sounds like a position for you, please respond to this advertisement with your resume and cover letter. Please, read carefully:

1. Write a cover letter addressing:

- Why are you the best Associate Data Scientist for this role? Give quantifiable examples of related achievements.
- Describe why you fit perfectly with our values. Read them here: https://drive.google.com/file/d/1deCCJZ6tiDiOSlr_W0UdCuM_V_ahzPBs/view
- What's the toughest challenge youâve ever overcome in your life? How did you overcome it?
- What are the last three books youâve read?
- What do you do for fun?
2. Explain what youâre doing now for a job:

- If you donât have one, explain why.
- If you have one, explain why youâre looking elsewhere.
3. Upload your cover letter and resume

- Ensure that your cover letter and resume are saved and sent as one file.
Yes, our hiring process is challenging, but itâs our way of selecting the best--and your way of ensuring your AlgaeCal teammates are tops.

Click the âApply Nowâ button on this page and upload your cover letter and resume.

***Note: Please include your cover letter WITH your resume in one document. Applications without a cover letter will not be read!***

We are looking to hire as soon as we find the right person, so act quickly and you can also expect a prompt response.

title: Hardware Test Engineer
description:
Optics11 is a fast-growing high-tech company based in Amsterdam, developing advanced fiber optic sensing systems for the most demanding environments. Our technology detects the earliest signs of failure in critical assets – from high-voltage energy infrastructure to subsea and defense applications – and gives our customers precise, real-time data they can act on.

Within our Underwater Security business we develop sensing technologies that help detect and monitor underwater threats. Our solutions include OptiBarrier, designed for immediate, over-the-horizon threat detection, and OptiArray, our low-power optical thin-line towed array for unmanned underwater vehicles and submarines.

Role Overview

As a Hardware Test Engineer at Optics11, you play a key role in ensuring the quality, reliability, and performance of our fiber-optic sensing systems. You develop and execute hardware tests at board and sub-system level, identifying potential issues early and helping our engineers deliver robust, production-ready solutions.

Combining hands-on hardware engineering with test automation, you build test setups, analyze results, support prototype development, and help transfer testing processes from R&D to production.

You will be part of our Sensing Platform Team, working closely with multidisciplinary engineering teams, production, and external partners.

What You'll Do

Hardware Testing & Automation 

- Develop and execute test plans and procedures for electronic boards, assemblies, and sub-systems.

- Design and maintain test setups, fixtures, and jigs for functional, electrical, and optical testing.

- Perform environmental, stability, and robustness testing, including thermal cycling, vibration, and EMC/ESD pre-compliance.

- Develop Python-based test automation for instrument control, data logging, and analysis.

- Document test procedures, results, and findings, ensuring clear traceability and reproducibility.

Prototyping & Production Support 

- Support prototype assembly, soldering, rework, cable assembly, and fiber handling and splicing.

- Develop and improve production and Factory Acceptance Test (FAT) setups, procedures, and test jigs.

- Support troubleshooting, repairs, and root-cause investigations during development and production.

- Maintain an organized, safe, and well-equipped R&D laboratory, including equipment calibration and materials management.

Technical Analysis & Continuous Improvement 

- Analyze test results to evaluate hardware performance, identify risks, and support engineering decisions.

- Investigate hardware failures and collaborate with design engineers on corrective actions.

- Contribute to design-for-test and design-for-manufacturing improvements.

- Identify opportunities to improve test methods, automation, and product reliability.

Collaboration & Delivery 

- Work closely with Electronics, Photonics, Embedded Software, Mechanical Engineering, IVVQ, and production teams.

- Support the handover of tested hardware and documentation to integration, validation, and production teams.

- Independently plan and execute assigned activities, communicating progress, risks, and dependencies.

- Share technical knowledge, contribute to design reviews, and support continuous improvement across the team.

What we offer 

- Join one of Europe’s fastest-growing deep-tech scale-ups.

- Real impact: your work directly shapes our growth and success.

- A great team in an international organization with colleagues from more than twenty nationalities.

- A competitive salary and benefits package.

- 30 days of holiday per year.

- Fresh team lunches five times a week, plus regular team activities and company events.

Qualifications 

- BSc (HBO) in Electrical Engineering, Electronics, Mechatronics, Applied Physics, or a related technical discipline, or equivalent experience.

- 2+ years of relevant experience in hardware testing, test engineering, prototyping, or lab work on electronic or electro-optical products.

- Hands-on experience with laboratory instruments such as multimeters, oscilloscopes, power supplies, signal generators, and data loggers; experience with optical power meters is an advantage.

- Experience executing test plans and procedures, logging and analyzing measurement data, and documenting results in clear test reports.

- Good soldering and rework skills for through-hole and SMD components, including building custom cables and harnesses, and the ability to read schematics, PCB layouts, wiring diagrams, and assembly drawings.

- Experience with or good understanding of environmental testing (e.g. temperature, thermal cycling, vibration) and of EMC/ESD principles.

- Python skills for test automation, instrument control, and data analysis; experience with LabVIEW, embedded Linux or similar tools is advantageous.

- Awareness of ESD-safe working practices and lab safety, including laser safety, or willingness to be trained.

- A structured, practical, and hands-on working style, and real enjoyment of testing, finding problems, and getting hardware to work.

- Good communication skills in English and a collaborative working style.

- Eligible for EU/NATO security clearance.

Preferred 

- Experience with fiber handling, connector cleaning and inspection, and fusion splicing.

- Experience with EMC pre-compliance measurements (e.g. EN 55032/CISPR 32 emissions, IEC 61000-4-x immunity) or environmental test standards (e.g. IEC 60068, MIL-STD-810).

- IPC certification (e.g. IPC-A-610 or IPC J-STD-001) or experience with ESD control programs (IEC 61340-5-1).

- Experience developing production test setups, test jigs, or programming fixtures, or supporting NPI and production transfer with electronics manufacturing partners.

- Experience in multidisciplinary high-tech product development (e.g. sensing, photonics, instrumentation, defence, or subsea).

Screening 

You will work with clients in the defense and security sectors. Obtaining a Certificate of No Objection issued by the AIVD, the Dutch General Intelligence and Security Service, is mandatory. This means you will need to undergo a security screening. We will explain the process and guide you through the applicable requirements.

title: Ditto | Engineering & Product | Remote (US: Atlanta, Austin, SF, Seattle) + APAC | Full-time
description:
Ditto | Engineering & Product | Remote (US: Atlanta, Austin, SF, Seattle) + APAC | Full-time
https://jobs.ashbyhq.com/ditto https://docs.ditto.live/home/about-ditto I've been obsessed with CRDTs since I first saw them at Strange Loop years ago, and I still can't quite believe I now get to work on them for a living — in some of the most challenging environments there are: disconnected, degraded, contested, out where the cloud isn't. If that's your kind of problem, come build with us. Ditto is the edge-native data platform that keeps distributed systems in sync when the network doesn't cooperate — an offline-first, CRDT-based layer syncing any device (phone, vehicle, sensor, server) over Bluetooth LE, P2P Wi-Fi, LAN, and tactical radio, with or without connectivity. Same core, commercial to defense; operationally deployed and network-agnostic. The problems are the fun kind: conflict-free replication with no server and no synchronized clock, multi-transport routing that never drops the connection, moving a coherent picture over links as thin as an HF radio shot, and human-in-the-loop robotics/autonomy where a detection may have to be physically carried by a moving node. Concept to field in days, not months. Most roles are open to anyone authorized to work in the U.S.; Public Sector and forward-deployed roles require U.S. person status. Remote in the U.S. (hubs: Atlanta, Austin, SF, Seattle) unless noted. Product — Senior PM: Cloud Database & Integrations; Cloud Infrastructure & Platform Engineering — Engineering Manager, Data Sync Public Sector (U.S. persons) — Senior SWE: Autonomy · Systems FDE · Portal (ATL/remote) · FDE (SF, on-site); SWE, Public Sector Application Core Technologies — Senior SWE: Rust · Data Sync · Database · Networking · Bluetooth · React Native SDK · Android (ATL) Cloud Services — Senior SWE, Cloud (x2) Infrastructure — Staff SWE, Platform; Senior Platform Engineer, Operator; Senior SRE; Senior SRE, APAC (remote) If interested apply above and mention Hackernews.July.26

title: Software Development Engineer II (Remote @ Colombia)
description:
Headquarters: Remote @ Colombia

About the role: 

The OfferUp Connect team builds the moments that turn a listing into a sale. Every chat between buyers and sellers, every offer notification, and every saved-search alert runs through services we own, from messaging and notifications to location, meetups, and the subscriptions sellers pay for. We run high-volume Java microservices and streaming pipelines, integrate with partners like Braze, Amazon Pinpoint, Apple, and Google, and use experimentation to decide what ships.

We also take on high-visibility work beyond our domain. Connect built OfferUp's video infrastructure for listing videos and LLM-powered catalog enrichment on Amazon Bedrock, both company priorities that changed what buyers see every day. The roadmap is wide open for someone who wants to help shape it.

As a Software Development Engineer II, you'll own features from concept to rollout: designing and writing well-tested code, launching experiments, and measuring results with Product, Design, and Data partners. You'll raise the quality of the code around you and get the chance to join the next project like video or catalog enrichment.

Here’s more of what you will get to do: 

- Design, build, and deploy backend services and event-driven pipelines for messaging, notifications, location, and subscriptions

- Improve the reliability, latency, and delivery rates of high-volume messaging and notification systems, including retries, rate limiting, and frequency capping

- Integrate with and operate third-party platforms such as Braze, Amazon Pinpoint, Apple and Google push services, and app store billing

- Own features end-to-end: plan, design, develop, deploy, measure, and iterate

- Break down complex engineering problems into achievable tasks and deliver them within committed timeframes

- Work collaboratively with cross-functional teams (Product, Design, Data Science, Marketing, and iOS, Android, and web engineers) to design and implement new features

- Contribute to A/B tests and use experimentation results to decide what ships

- Actively participate in code reviews and enforce good patterns, testing, and edge-case handling

- Coach and mentor junior team members, new hires, and interns

- Create shared components, utilities, and services that improve team velocity across the stack

- Maintain and improve the runbooks, alerting, and monitoring for the features you ship

- Participate in a reasonable on-call rotation with the rest of the team

- Use AI coding tools (Claude Code, Gemini, and similar) to increase your daily development velocity and code quality

- Become a subject matter expert in one or more of the team's sub-domains: messaging, notifications and campaigns, location, or subscriptions and promotions

You’ll thrive in this role if you have: 

- 2+ years of professional software engineering experience

- Demonstrated ability to own the delivery of multiple features end-to-end (plan, design, develop, and deploy) with high efficiency, including breaking down engineering problems into achievable tasks

- Strong coding skills in Java, with a working understanding of microservices and distributed-systems fundamentals

- Good knowledge of data structures and object-oriented design

- Working knowledge of asynchronous, event-driven systems (queues, pub/sub, or streams), including retries and idempotent processing

- Hands-on experience using AI coding tools (Claude Code or similar) in a real engineering workflow, and a point of view on when they help and when they don't

- A habit of following good coding patterns, writing appropriate tests, considering trade-offs, and seeking out edge cases

- Comfortable giving and receiving feedback in code reviews

- A bias toward shipping, learning from production, and iterating quickly

- An insatiable desire and ability to learn

- BS or MS in Computer Science, or equivalent practical experience

Helpful, but not required: 

- Fluency in another modern object-oriented programming language

- Experience with TypeScript and Node.js

- Experience with Agile development

- Experience building and integrating with REST APIs

- Experience with AWS services such as DynamoDB, SQS, SNS, Lambda, and ElastiCache (Redis)

- Experience with notification and engagement platforms (Braze, Amazon Pinpoint, APNs, FCM) or in-app subscription billing (App Store, Google Play)

- Experience with stream processing frameworks such as Apache Flink or Kafka Streams

- Experience with A/B testing platforms (Statsig, LaunchDarkly, Optimizely) and analytics warehouses (BigQuery, Snowflake)

- Experience consuming or integrating LLM-based APIs (e.g., Bedrock, Vertex AI, OpenAI)

- Familiarity with Kubernetes, Helm, and CI/CD pipelines

About OfferUp: 

OfferUp is dedicated to creating the simplest and most trusted way for people to buy, sell, and connect in their local communities. One of the top local marketplace apps for local buyers and sellers in the U.S., OfferUp makes it easy for people to discover more of what they need—from great deals and secondhand goods to jobs, services, home rentals, and more—right in their own communities. Our trusted platform empowers millions to connect, thrive, and move life forward. 

Available on iOS and Android, OfferUp has consistently ranked among the top shopping apps. title: Support Engineer (EMEA)
description:
The AI orchestration of your wildest imagination. 

n8n is the open workflow orchestration platform built for the new era of AI. We give technical teams the freedom of code with the speed of no-code, so they can automate faster, smarter, and without limits. Backed by a fiercely inventive community and 500+ builder-approved integrations, we’re changing the way people bring systems together and scale ideas for impact.

Since our founding in 2019, we’ve grown into a diverse team of over 260 - working across Europe and the US, connected by a shared builder spirit and with our centre of gravity in Berlin. Along the way, we’ve:

- Cultivated a community of more than 650,000 active developers and builders

- Earned 190K+ GitHub stars, making us one of the world’s Top 40 most popular projects

- Backed by top investors, from Sequoia’s first German seed to our SAP's recent strategic investment - bringing us to a $5.2bn valuation

That’s the company we’ve built. Now we’d love to see what you can build. If you’re applying, try n8n out - whether you’re technical or not - and share a screenshot of your first workflow with us. The easiest place to start is here: app.n8n.cloud/register .

We’re in a defining moment of an incredible journey. Come and build with us.

Your main goal as a front line Support engineer will be to help n8n scale exceptional customer support by solving everyday customer challenges and automating repetitive requests, ensuring we deliver a great experience as our customer base grows.

You'll make this happen by combining hands-on customer support with smart automation and close collaboration across teams:

Deliver Outstanding Customer Support

- Own and resolve helpdesk tickets for non-enterprise customers, representing approximately 65% of your time.

- Initially focus on non-technical questions related to account management, account access, plans, subscriptions, and billing.

- Provide clear, helpful, and timely responses that solve customer problems while gradually expanding your expertise into more technical topics.

Automate and Scale Support Operations

- Identify opportunities to automate repetitive, non-technical ticket categories and reduce manual support work.

- Build and improve automations that help Team Delta handle growing ticket volumes efficiently without compromising the customer experience.

- Continuously spot opportunities to streamline support workflows and make it easier for customers to get the answers they need.

Strengthen Product Alignment and Knowledge Sharing

- Collaborate with Product to share recurring customer questions, highlight friction points, and identify opportunities for improvement.

- Create and maintain documentation that enables customers to self-serve and helps the team resolve common issues more efficiently.

- Participate in team meetings and cross-functional discussions to share insights, align on priorities, and improve the support experience.

REQUIREMENTS

Must-haves 

- Technical Support Expertise: You have 3+ years in technical support, solutions engineering, or similar roles

- n8n Experience: You have hands-on experience building and debugging n8n workflows in production environments

- APIs & Integrations: You’re comfortable debugging APIs, webhooks, authentication, and data flows

- Cloud & Infrastructure: You’re familiar with AWS, GCP, or Azure and have basic Linux fundamentals for troubleshooting

- Networking & Databases: You understand networking basics (DNS, SSL/TLS, HTTP/HTTPS) 

- Communication: You explain technical issues clearly and document troubleshooting steps effectively

- Containerization: You can work with Docker or Kubernetes to deploy and debug automation environments

- Knowledge Sharing: You actively share knowledge and best practices with teammates, whether through team discussions, presentations, documentation, or contributions to internal playbooks and tools.

Nice-to-haves 

- Automation & AI Mindset: You have a basic understanding of AI concepts and a passion for automation, with some hands-on experience using tools like n8n, Zapier, Make, or Airflow to simplify tasks and improve workflows.

- Observability: Familiarity with tools like Grafana, Prometheus, Datadog, OpenTelemetry, or Sentry

- Authentication Protocols: Knowledge of OAuth2, OIDC, SAML, or JWT flows

- JavaScript: You have a working knowledge of JavaScript, including reading and debugging code, working with JSON data, and making small code changes to troubleshoot workflows and integrations.

- SQL & Databases: You have a foundational understanding of relational databases, such as PostgreSQL, including tables, relationships, and basic SQL queries to investigate and troubleshoot issues.

Why join us? 

At n8n, you'll do more than answer support tickets. You'll play a key role in helping us scale our customer support operations, shaping how we use automation to resolve common issues and creating a better experience for our growing customer base. You'll have the opportunity to make a tangible impact on Team Delta's efficiency, collaborate closely with Product, and progressively deepen your technical expertise.

You'll join one of Europe's fastest-growing startups, working with a supportive, remote-first team that values autonomy, experimentation, and continuous improvement.

Sound like a challenge you're excited to take on?

Apply now — and help us build the future of automation.

n8n is an equal opportunity employer and does not discriminate on the basis of race, religion, colour, national origin, gender, sexual orientation, gender identity, age, marital status, veteran status, or disability status. 

We can sponsor visas to Germany; for any other country, you need to have existing right to work. 

Our company language is English. 

You care about diversity and inclusion? We do too! Check out our Diversity, Inclusion and Belonging initiatives at n8n ( https://www.notion.so/n8n/Diversity-inclusion-and-belonging-n8n-c1bec2fff536422d868b1a438d990e35 ). 

Location disclaimer: If you see multiple job postings for the same role, it is most likely because we're hiring remotely for this role and posting in different locations to make sure every potential candidate can see the role. Please apply to the location you're the most likely to work from in the future. 

Benefits 

- Competitive compensation 💸 – We offer fair and attractive pay.

- Ownership 💪 – Our core value is to “empower others,” and we mean it—you’ll get a slice of n8n with equity.

- Work/life balance 🏖️ – We work hard but ensure you have time to recharge:

- Europe: 30 days of vacation, plus public holidays wherever you are.

- US: 20 vacation days, 8 sick days, plus public holidays wherever you are.

- Health & wellness 🩺 –

- Europe: We provide benefits according to local country norms.*

- US : Multiple low-premium, low-deductible medical plans with coverage for individuals and families—plus a no-cost premium HDHP option with a pre-seeded HSA—along with dental and vision coverage.

- Future planning 💰 –

- Europe: We provide pension contributions according to local country norms.*

- US: 401(k) retirement plan with a 4% employer match.

- Financial security 🛡️ –

- Europe: We provide benefits according to local country norms.*

- US: Company-paid short-term and long-term disability insurance, plus life insurance to support you and your loved ones.

- Career growth 📈 – We hire rising stars who grow with us! You’ll get €1K (or equivalent) per year to spend on courses, books, events, or coaching to level up your skills.

- A passionate team 🤩 – We love our product, and we prove it with regular hackathons where we see who can build the coolest thing with it!

- Remote-first 🌏 – Our team works remotely across Europe, with regular off-sites for team bonding. Some roles, like sales in the US, are hybrid—please check the job description.

- Giving back 🤝 – We're big fans of open source, and you'll get $100 per month to support projects you care about.

- Transparency 🙏 – We all know what everyone’s working on, how the company is doing—the whole shebang.

*Country and/or State specific details provided in your employment agreement. 

Find more English Speaking Jobs in Germany on Arbeitnow
